13.ShortUpgradeDescription: Palmer heals himself and the blessed allied heroes.

20.Description: Palmer alternates between using Admonitions and Precepts. Admonitions damages an enemy for #.PlusRatio.Per# of Palmer's Attack Rating and reduces the target's Attack Rating by #.SArg0.Per# for #.SArg1#s, prioritizing the enemy hero with the highest Attack Rating. Precepts targets the allied hero with the highest Attack Rating other than himself. If the target's Energy is lower than #.SArg2#, they recover #.SArg3# Energy; otherwise they deal #.SArg4.Per# more damage for #.SArg5#s. This buff can stack up to #.SArg6# times. Sacred Scripture is considered as Palmer's normal attack.
20.ShortDescription: Palmer alternates between using Admonitions and Precepts. Admonitions damages the enemy and reduce their Attack Rating; Precepts recovers the allied hero's Energy or increases the damage they dealt.

21.UpgradeDescription: Increases the damage dealt by Admonitions to #.PlusRatio.Per# of Palmer's Attack Rating.
21.ShortUpgradeDescription: Increases the damage dealt by Admonitions.

22.UpgradeDescription: Increases the energy restored by Precepts to #.SArg3# points.
22.ShortUpgradeDescription: Increases the energy restored by Precepts.

23.UpgradeDescription: Increases the damage dealt by Admonitions to #.PlusRatio.Per# of Palmer's Attack Rating.
23.ShortUpgradeDescription: Further increases the damage dealt by Admonitions.

31.Description: Palmer begins a prayer over time at the start of battle, making him immune to control effects. Every #.SArg0#s, Palmer heals nearby allied heroes for #.SArg1.Per# of his Attack Rating and gains #.SArg2# stack of Faith (up to #.SArg5# stacks), each increasing the nearby allied heroes' Attack Rating and Defense Rating by #.SArg3.Per# and #.SArg4.Per# of Palmer's initial Attack Rating and Defense Rating respectively. The prayer ends when Faith reaches its max stacks, the total damage Palmer takes during the prayer exceeds #.SArg6.Per# of his max health, or there are no other surviving allied heroes. After his first prayer ends, the attribute buffs of Faith begin to take effect on all allied heroes.
31.ShortDescription: Palmer begins a prayer over time and stacks Faith at the start of battle, healing nearby allied heroes and granting them Attack Rating and Defense Rating bonuses that increase over time. After his first prayer ends, the attribute buffs begin to take effect on all allied heroes.

32.UpgradeDescription: Palmer now heals nearby allied heroes for #.SArg1.Per# of his Attack Rating during his prayer.
32.ShortUpgradeDescription: Increases the health healed when praying.

33.UpgradeDescription: When his prayer ends, Palmer heals nearby allied heroes for #.SArg7.Per# of their lost health.
33.ShortUpgradeDescription: Palmer heals nearby allied heroes when his prayer ends.

34.ShortUpgradeDescription: Unlocks Orison's skill upgrade: Reduces the cooldown for healing and gaining Faith. Increases his maximum number of Faith stacks.

41.Description: During the battle, if there are at least #.SArg0# allied heroes alive, the allied hero with the lowest health percentage takes #.SArg1.Per# less damage. The damage reduction is evenly distributed among the other allied heroes. This damage cannot kill them. #.SArg2.Per# of the distributed damage is recovered over the next #.SArg3#s. The first time an allied hero dies, the other allied heroes immediately recover all of the remaining distributed damage and take #.SArg4.Per# less damage for the next #.SArg5#s.
41.ShortDescription: The allied hero with the lowest health percentage takes less damage. The damage reduction is distributed among the other allied heroes and slowly recovers by a percentage. The first time an allied hero dies, the other allied heroes immediately recover all of the remaining distributed damage and take less damage.

42.UpgradeDescription: The first enemy hero to kill an allied hero will be punished by the Divine Light, reducing their Attack Rating and Energy Recovery Rate by #.SArg6.Per# and #.SArg7.Per# respectively for #.SArg8#s. This effect cannot stack.
42.ShortUpgradeDescription: The first enemy hero to kill an allied hero will be punished by the Divine Light, reducing their Attack Rating and Energy Recovery Rate.

43.UpgradeDescription: #.SArg2.Per# of the health lost from distributed damage will be recovered over #.SArg3#s.
43.ShortUpgradeDescription: Increases how much health lost from distributed damage is recovered.

44.UpgradeDescription: The first #.SArg9# enemy hero(es) to damage allied heroes in battle will be punished by the Divine Light.
44.ShortUpgradeDescription: The first #.SArg9# enemy hero(es) to damage allied heroes will be punished by the Divine Light.

81.Description: After Faith reaches its max stacks, Palmer increases the Crit Rating of all allied heroes by #.SArg0# points + #.SArg8.Per# of his initial Crit Rating.
81.ShortDescription: After Faith reaches its max stacks, Palmer increases the Crit Rating of all allied heroes.

82.ShortUpgradeDescription: After Faith reaches its max stacks, Palmer heals all allied heroes every #.SArg1#s.

84.ShortUpgradeDescription: If Palmer's prayer ends and his Faith is not maxed out yet, he may pray again in #.SArg7#s.

92.ShortUpgradeDescription: Sacred Scripture will cast automatically when Palmer prays or uses his Ultimate.

11.Description: Passive: Veithael gains #.SArg0# Energy per second if he is not being controlled, but loses #.SArg1# Energy per second if he is being controlled. Active: Veithael spends #.SArg2# Energy to swing his sword, damaging nearby enemies for #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating. 32.ShortUpgradeDescription: Increases skill damage.

33.ShortUpgradeDescription: Increases healing.

92.ShortUpgradeDescription: When Veithael receives excess healing, it increases his max health. His health percentage remains unchanged.

11.Description: Mulan enters cavalry mode and charges across the battlefield #.SArg0# time. She will chart a path with the most enemy heroes, damaging all enemies in her path for #.SArg1.Per# of her Attack Rating and briefly knocking them airborne. Mulan then gallops to the area with the most enemy heroes, exits cavalry mode, and leaps off her horse, damaging nearby enemy heroes for #.PlusRatio.Per# of her Attack Rating and knocking them airborne. While in cavalry mode, Mulan is immune to damage and control effects.

12.ShortUpgradeDescription: While in cavalry mode, Mulan continuously recovers health.

13.ShortUpgradeDescription: When leaping down from her horse, Mulan deals additional damage to her targets equal to a percentage of her max health.

She then teleports and unleashes another flurry of slashes, damaging enemies in front of her #.SArg1# times for #.SArg2.Per# of her Attack Rating. While using this skill, Mulan is immune to direct damage and control effects, but the amount of damage negated will be recorded. After the skill ends, she will lose health equal to #.SArg3.Per# of the negated damage. This damage cannot kill her.
20.ShortDescription: Mulan slashes repeatedly with her sword, damaging enemies in front of her #.SArg0# times. She then teleports and unleashes another flurry of slashes, damaging enemies in front of her #.SArg1# times. While using this skill, Mulan is immune to damage, but after the skill ends she will lose health equal to a portion of the negated damage.

21.UpgradeDescription: After this skill ends, Mulan will be healed for #.SArg4.Per# of the damage it dealt.
21.ShortUpgradeDescription: Mulan will be healed for a part of the damage this skill deals.

22.UpgradeDescription: After this skill ends, Mulan will lose health equal to #.SArg3.Per# of the damage it negated. This damage cannot kill her.

23.UpgradeDescription: The second flurry of slashes after Mulan teleports will knock enemies airborne.
23.ShortUpgradeDescription: The second flurry of slashes after Mulan teleports will knock enemies airborne.

31.Description: Active: Mulan fly-kicks enemies in front of her, damaging them for #.SArg0.Per# of her Attack Rating and knocking them airborne. Passive: If Mulan is about to receive damage that exceeds #.SArg1.Per# of her max health or would reduce her to less than #.SArg2.Per# health, she will parry the attack with her sword and damage enemies in front of her for #.PlusRatio.Per# of her Attack Rating. Parrying reduces the damage she takes from an attack by #.SArg5.Per#. She can parry #.SArg4# times over the next #.SArg3#s, after which the cooldown for this skill's active effect will be reset and Mulan will be unable to parry again for the next #.SArg6#s.

32.ShortUpgradeDescription: After fly-kicking, Mulan's movement speed is increased.

33.UpgradeDescription: When parrying, the damage Mulan receives is reduced by #.SArg5.Per#.
33.ShortUpgradeDescription: When parrying, the damage Mulan receives is further reduced.

34.ShortUpgradeDescription: Before fly-kicking, Mulan destroys all of the targets' shields and renders them temporarily unable to acquire a new shield.

41.Description: Whenever Mulan knocks an enemy hero airborne, she hits them with a follow-up attack, damaging them for #.SArg0.Per# of her Attack Rating. Each follow-up attack increases the damage of the next follow-up attack by #.SArg1.Per# of Mulan's Attack Rating, up to #.SArg2.Per#. If the target is a Boss, Mulan will still launch a follow-up attack even if she fails to knock them airborne.
41.ShortDescription: Whenever Mulan knocks an enemy hero airborne, she hits them with a follow-up attack. The damage of her follow-up attacks increases over time.

42.UpgradeDescription: When Mulan knocks an enemy airborne to the edge of the battlefield, she damages the target and nearby enemies for #.PlusRatio.Per# of her Attack Rating. This effect can be triggered for each enemy hero once every #.SArg3#s.
42.ShortUpgradeDescription: When Mulan knocks an enemy airborne to the edge of the battlefield, she deals additional damage to the target and nearby enemies.

43.ShortUpgradeDescription: Once the damage of Mulan's follow-up attacks maxes out, subsequent follow-up attacks will deal extra damage equal to a portion of the target's max health.

44.ShortUpgradeDescription: Control and limitation effects inflicted by Mulan's allied heroes can also trigger follow-up attacks.

84.ShortUpgradeDescription: Mulan can also parry control effects that are about to be inflicted on her. While parrying, she is immune to control effects.

92.ShortUpgradeDescription: At the start of battle, Mulan enters cavalry mode and rides towards the enemy directly opposite her. She then leaps off her horse and exits cavalry mode, damaging nearby enemies and knocking them airborne.

If Belinda uses this skill while already possessed, it will extend the possession by #.SArg0#s and deal extra AoE damage equal to #.SArg3.Per# of her Attack Rating to all enemy heroes.
11.ShortDescription: Belinda summons the Divine Flame to cleanse the battlefield, damaging all enemies. She is then possessed by the Divine Flame for #.SArg0#s, increasing her Attack Rating every second. If Belinda uses this skill while already possessed, it will extend the possession by #.SArg0#s and deal extra AoE damage to all enemy heroes.

12.ShortUpgradeDescription: If Cleansing Flame damages an enemy multiple times within #.SArg4#s, the damage will increase each time.

21.UpgradeDescription: When a burned enemy takes damage, they will lose health equal to #.SArg2.Per# of Belinda's Attack Rating over the next #.SArg1#s.

23.ShortUpgradeDescription: When Blinding Blaze damages an enemy, it will also dispel one of their buffs.

42.ShortUpgradeDescription: Flame damage is increased further.

43.ShortUpgradeDescription: After Belinda has been possessed by the Divine Flame for a total of #.SArg5#s, the duration of her possession will be extended.

51.ShortDescription: All attribute buffs and Energy recovery Belinda receives from her allies are increased. When an ally helps Belinda recover Energy, she will grant them the Blaze of Glory effect for #.SArg2#s. Whenever an ally with this effect uses an active skill, it will trigger a Cleansing Flame, damaging the target and nearby enemies. Every few times Blaze of Glory is used, Belinda will become possessed by the Divine Flame, or have her current possession extended by #.SArg4#s, and the divine damage she deals will be permanently increased.

11.Description: Tamrus spins around violently #.SArg5# times. Each spin damages nearby enemies for #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating, stuns them, and drags them towards Tamrus. 51.Description: Allied heroes that are not Dimensionals or Celestials will be regarded by Maetria as Hypogeans and receive Hypogean factional bonuses as in-combat buffs (these in-combat buffs will be based on the number of Hypogeans in your formation, including heroes regarded as Hypogeans because of this skill). These in-combat buffs will not affect any factional bonuses in effect at the start of battle. The affected heroes will also gain a #.SArg1.Per# damage bonus against Celestials and #.SArg0# Proficiency points in this battle.
51.ShortDescription: Allied heroes that are not Dimensionals or Celestials will be regarded by Maetria as Hypogeans, receiving Hypogean factional bonuses as in-combat buffs, plus a damage bonus against Celestials. Affected allied heroes will also gain increased Proficiency for this battle.

11.Description: Passive: At the start of battle, Crassio will begin protecting the hero positioned below him. Active: If the protected hero is alive and there are enemies around them, Crassio damages all enemies near him for #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating, then teleports to the protected hero and damages all enemies near them for #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating. Otherwise, Crassio will only slash at the enemies near himself twice, damaging them for #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating per slash.
11.ShortDescription: Passive: At the start of battle, Crassio will begin protecting the hero positioned below him. Active: If the protected hero is alive and there are enemies around them, Crassio damages all enemies near him, then teleports to the protected hero and damages all enemies near them. Otherwise, Crassio will only slash at the enemies near himself, damaging them twice.

12.UpgradeDescription: Crassio receives #.SArg0.Per# more healing and shields from his protected hero.
12.ShortUpgradeDescription: Crassio receives #.SArg0.Per# more healing and shields from his protected hero.

13.UpgradeDescription: If the skill Dagger Dash has been unlocked, if this skill damages Crassio's Quarry they will lose #.SArg2.Per# Attack Rating and #.SArg1.Per# Defense Rating for #.SArg3#s.
13.ShortUpgradeDescription: If this skill damages Crassio's Quarry, it reduces their Defense Rating and Attack Rating.

20.Description: Crassio targets the enemy hero that has dealt the most damage to his protected hero, marking them as his "Quarry". This skill's effects depend on Crassio's distance from his Quarry. If his Quarry is near him, he slashes twice, damaging all enemies near him for #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating per slash. If his Quarry is far away, he throws a dagger at them, damaging all enemies near the Quarry for #.PlusRatio.Per# of Crassio's Attack Rating. He then teleports to catch the dagger, damaging all nearby enemies for #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating.
20.ShortDescription: Crassio targets the enemy hero that has dealt the most damage to his protected hero, marking them as his "Quarry". If Crassio's Quarry is near him, he slashes at all nearby enemies, damaging them twice. If his Quarry is far away, he throws a dagger at them, damaging all enemies near them. He then teleports to catch the dagger, damaging all nearby enemies again.

21.UpgradeDescription: Increases damage to #.PlusRatio.Per# of hero's Attack Rating.

22.UpgradeDescription: When this skill deals damage to Crassio's Quarry, it deals extra damage equal to #.SArg1.Per# of the Quarry's max health (up to #.SArg2.Per# of Crassio's Attack Rating).
22.ShortUpgradeDescription: This skill deals additional damage to Crassio's Quarry based on their max health.

23.UpgradeDescription: When this skill deals damage to Crassio's Quarry, it destroys the Quarry's shield if the shield's remaining shield value is below #.SArg3.Per# of Crassio's Attack Rating.
23.ShortUpgradeDescription: This skill destroys the shields of Crassio's Quarry.

31.Description:
Passive: Whenever Crassio or his protected hero take a single round of damage exceeding #.SArg0.Per# of Crassio's max health, he reduces the damage by #.SArg1.Per# then damages the attacker and all enemies near them for #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating. This effect can trigger up to #.SArg2# times.
Active: Crassio inflicts damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating on enemies in front. If there are passive triggers remaining, the enemies will be dealt damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of Crassio's Attack Rating equivalent to the remaining passive triggers. After "Lethal Deflection" is cast, the number of passive triggers is refreshed.
31.ShortDescription:
Passive: Whenever Crassio or his protected hero take massive damage, he reduces the damage then damages the attacker and all enemies near them. This effect can trigger up to #.SArg2# times.
Active: Damages all enemies in front of Crassio and resets the passive effect's remaining triggers.

32.UpgradeDescription: Increases damage to #.PlusRatio.Per# of hero's Attack Rating.
32.ShortUpgradeDescription: Increases skill damage.

33.UpgradeDescription: The triggering damage is now reduced by #.SArg1.Per#.
33.ShortUpgradeDescription: The triggering damage is further reduced.

34.UpgradeDescription: Unlocks Lethal Deflection's skill upgrade: The skill's passive effect can now trigger up to #.SArg2# times.
34.ShortUpgradeDescription: Unlocks Lethal Deflection's skill upgrade: The skill's passive effect can now trigger up to #.SArg2# times.

41.Description: When the target for protection is attacked at close quarters, Crassio teleports back to the target's side, dealing damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating to surrounding enemies and knocking them back, while granting the target a shield worth #.SArg1.Per# of his Attack Rating that lasts for #.SArg2#s. This skill can trigger up to #.SArg4# time every #.SArg3#s. After this skill is used, the cooldown of "Dagger Dash" is refreshed immediately.
41.ShortDescription: Whenever Crassio's protected hero is attacked at close range, Crassio teleports to the hero, damaging and knocking back all enemies near them. He then grants the protected hero a shield. Using this skill instantly resets the cooldown of the Dagger Dash skill.

42.UpgradeDescription: Enemies hit by this skill deal #.SArg6.Per# less damage for #.SArg5#s.
42.ShortUpgradeDescription: Enemies hit by this skill deal reduced damage.

43.UpgradeDescription: If an attacker breaks the shield granted by this skill, they will be stunned for #.SArg7#s.
43.ShortUpgradeDescription: If an attacker breaks the shield granted by this skill, they will be stunned.

44.UpgradeDescription: Unlocks Repelling Smash's skill upgrade: At the start of battle, Crassio uses this skill on the area around the enemy hero with the highest Attack Rating. He then grants himself a shield equal in value to the shield he would grant his protected hero. This effect will not trigger this skill's cooldown.
44.ShortUpgradeDescription: Unlocks Repelling Smash's skill upgrade: Crassio will use this skill on the enemy formation at the start of battle.

81.Description: Every #.SArg0# times Crassio deals damage to his Quarry, he gains #.SArg1# points of Crit Rating and #.SArg2# points of Tenacity until the end of battle. This effect can stack up to #.SArg3# times.
81.ShortDescription: Every #.SArg0# times Crassio deals damage to his Quarry, his Crit Rating and Tenacity are increased.

82.UpgradeDescription: Every #.SArg0# times Crassio deals damage to his Quarry, he gains #.SArg1# points of Crit Rating and #.SArg2# points of Tenacity until the end of battle. This effect can stack up to #.SArg3# times.
82.ShortUpgradeDescription: Increases Crit Rating and Tenacity bonuses.

83.UpgradeDescription: If Crassio kills his Quarry, the cooldown of Dagger Dash will be reset and he will gain #.SArg4# points of Crit Damage Amplification until the end of battle. This effect can stack up to #.SArg5# times.
83.ShortUpgradeDescription: If Crassio kills his Quarry, the cooldown of Dagger Dash will be reset and his Crit Damage Amplification will be increased.

84.UpgradeDescription: Whenever Crassio deals damage to his Quarry with his skills or normal attacks, he deals additional damage to them for #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating. The damage from this effect cannot trigger this additional damage. This effect can trigger up to #.SArg6# time(s) per battle.
84.ShortUpgradeDescription: Crassio deals additional damage whenever he deals damage to his Quarry.

91.Description: As long as his protected hero is still alive, Crassio gains #SArg0.Per# Attack Rating. Every time the total damage taken by the protected hero reaches #SArg1.Per# of their max health, Crassio's Attack Rating bonus is reduced by #SArg2.Per#. If the protected hero dies, Crassio will lose his Attack Rating bonus.
91.ShortDescription: As long as his protected hero is alive, Crassio's Attack Rating is increased. The more damage the protected hero takes, the lower his Attack Rating bonus. If the protected hero dies, Crassio will lose his Attack Rating bonus.

92.UpgradeDescription: The first time Crassio's protected hero takes fatal damage, he will become invulnerable for #.SArg4#s and consume #.SArg3.Per# of his own health to heal them. He will heal them for #.SArg5.Per# of their max health plus the health he consumed. If the protected hero dies within the next #.SArg4#s, Crassio will recover the health he consumed. He will also gain a #.SArg6.Per# bonus to Attack Rating and #.SArg7# points of Life Leech for #.SArg8#s.
92.ShortUpgradeDescription: The first time Crassio's protected hero takes fatal damage, he will become briefly invulnerable and consume his own health to heal them. If the protected hero dies within the next few seconds, Crassio will recover the health he consumed and gain a bonus to Attack Rating and Life Leech.

11.DisplayName: Essence of the Spiritual Arts User
11.Description: Emilia cannot gain Energy by attacking, getting attacked or through any other method. She starts the battle with #.SArg0# Energy and will immediately cast her Ultimate to summon Puck to assist her. Using her Ultimate skill does not cost Energy, but while Puck is present, Emilia will lose #.SArg1# Energy per second. When her Energy reaches 0, Puck goes to sleep. While Puck is summoned, it will continuously fire ice crystals at the area with the most enemies, dealing damage equal to #.SArg2.Per# of Emilia's Attack Rating to all targets and inflicting the Frost effect on them for #.SArg7#s. Each time a target with the Frost effect takes damage, they suffer extra health loss equal to #.SArg3.Per# of Emilia's Attack Rating. Each enemy can only trigger this effect once every #.SArg6#s. While Puck is asleep, Emilia recovers #.SArg4# Energy every time an allied hero uses their Ultimate, until she uses her Ultimate to summon Puck again.
11.ShortDescription: Emilia cannot gain Energy by attacking, getting attacked or through any other method. She starts the battle with full Energy and will immediately cast her Ultimate to summon Puck to assist her. While Puck is present, Emilia will lose Energy. When her Energy reaches 0, Puck goes to sleep. While Puck is summoned, it will continuously fire ice crystals at the area with the most enemies, dealing magic damage to all targets and inflicting the Frost effect on them for some time. Each time a target with the Frost effect takes damage, they suffer extra health loss. Each enemy can only trigger this effect once every few seconds. While Puck is asleep, Emilia recovers Energy every time an allied hero uses their Ultimate, until she uses her Ultimate to summon Puck again.

12.DisplayName: Essence of the Spiritual Arts User
12.UpgradeDescription: Increases health loss triggered by Frost to #.SArg3.Per# of Emilia's Attack Rating.
12.ShortUpgradeDescription: Increases health loss triggered by Frost.

13.DisplayName: Essence of the Spiritual Arts User
13.UpgradeDescription: Freezes an enemy for #.SArg6#s if they have suffered extra health loss triggered by Frost for #.SArg5# times.
13.ShortUpgradeDescription: Enemies that have taken extra health loss from Frost for a certain number of times become frozen briefly.

20.Description: Emilia calls upon the mana in the air and freezes all enemies for #.SArg0# to #.SArg1#s. The lower the current health of an enemy, the longer they will be frozen for.
20.ShortDescription: Emilia freezes all enemies for a period of time. The lower the current health of an enemy, the longer they will be frozen for.

21.UpgradeDescription: Enemies are now frozen for #.SArg0# to #.SArg1#s.
21.ShortUpgradeDescription: Enemies are now frozen for longer.

22.UpgradeDescription: Enemies are now frozen for #.SArg0# to #.SArg1#s.
22.ShortUpgradeDescription: Enemies are now frozen for longer.

23.UpgradeDescription: If an enemy is immune to control effects or is already frozen, they will instead take damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of Emilia's Attack Rating.
23.ShortUpgradeDescription: Targets that are immune to control effects or are already frozen will instead take magic damage.

31.Description: Emilia receives a lesser spirit's blessing and creates a blessed zone for #.SArg3#s. Allied heroes in the zone will recover health equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of Emilia's Attack Rating and #.SArg0# Energy per second.
31.ShortDescription: Emilia creates a blessed zone that lasts for a certain duration. Allied heroes in the zone recover a certain amount of health and Energy per second.

32.UpgradeDescription: The blessed zone is expanded.
32.ShortUpgradeDescription: The blessed zone is expanded.

33.UpgradeDescription: Allied heroes in the zone gain #.SArg1# points of Haste.
33.ShortUpgradeDescription: Allied heroes in the zone gain increased Haste.

34.UpgradeDescription: Allied heroes outside the zone will receive its effects at half strength.
34.ShortUpgradeDescription: Allied heroes outside the zone will receive its effects at half strength.

41.Description: If Emilia dies, Puck goes on a rampage, "freezing" all characters on both sides and damaging everyone for #.PlusRatio.Per# of Emilia's Attack Rating, plus additional damage equal to #.SArg0.Per# of the health lost by all enemies (up to #.SArg1.Per# of Emilia's Attack Rating). Allied characters will only take #.SArg2.Per# of the damage after a #.SArg3#-second delay. If Emilia is the only surviving allied hero, she will become immune to fatal damage and invincible for #.SArg4#s, and this effect will trigger immediately. This effect can only trigger #.SArg5# time per battle. Emilia is immune to any damage dealt by Puck while he is on a rampage.
41.ShortDescription: If Emilia dies, Puck goes on a rampage, "freezing" all characters on both sides and dealing magic damage, with additional magic damage based on the health lost by all enemies (up to a certain limit). Allied characters will take only part of the damage after a delay. If Emilia is the only surviving allied hero, she will become immune to fatal damage and invincible for a brief period, and this effect will trigger immediately. This effect can only trigger #.SArg5# time per battle. Emilia is immune to any damage dealt by Puck while he is on a rampage.

42.UpgradeDescription: Base damage is increased to #.PlusRatio.Per# of Emilia's Attack Rating.
42.ShortUpgradeDescription: Base damage is increased.

43.UpgradeDescription: Additional damage is increased to #.SArg0.Per# of the health lost by all enemies and the maximum damage is increased to #.SArg1.Per# of Emilia's Attack Rating.
43.ShortUpgradeDescription: Additional damage and maximum damage limit are increased.

44.UpgradeDescription: When the Great Spirit Puck goes on a rampage, allied heroes no longer take damage from this skill. If Emilia is the only surviving allied hero, she will recover all her health.
44.ShortUpgradeDescription: When the Great Spirit Puck goes on a rampage, allied heroes no longer take damage from this skill. If Emilia is the only surviving allied hero, she will recover all her health.

81.Description: The Defense Rating of frozen enemies is reduced by #.SArg0.Per#.
81.ShortDescription: The Defense Rating of frozen enemies is reduced.

82.UpgradeDescription: Frozen enemies lose #.SArg1# Energy per second.
82.ShortUpgradeDescription: Frozen enemies lose Energy over time.

83.UpgradeDescription: After coming out of being frozen, an enemy's Defense Rating is permanently reduced by #.SArg2.Per#. This effect can stack up to #.SArg3# times.
83.ShortUpgradeDescription: After coming out of being frozen, an enemy's Defense Rating is permanently reduced. This effect can stack up to 2 times.

84.UpgradeDescription: When an allied hero other than Emilia deals damage to a frozen enemy, the allied hero recovers #.SArg4# Energy points. This effect can only be triggered by each ally once every #.SArg5#s.
84.ShortUpgradeDescription: When an allied hero other than Emilia deals damage to a frozen enemy, the allied hero recovers Energy. This effect can only be triggered once every few seconds.

91.Description: Emilia's Energy consumption while Puck is summoned is reduced to #.SArg0# points per second.
91.ShortDescription: Emilia's Energy consumption while Puck is summoned is reduced.

92.UpgradeDescription: When both the enemy and allied hero use their Ultimate while Puck is asleep, Emilia's gained Energy is increased to #.SArg1# points.
92.ShortUpgradeDescription: When both the enemy and allied hero use their Ultimate while Puck is asleep, Emilia gains Energy points.

11.Description: Rem enters her demon form for #.SArg0#s (she will not exit demon form while other skills are being used) and swings her Morning Star multiple times, damaging nearby enemies for #.PlusRatio.Per# of her Attack Rating per hit. In demon form, Rem deals #.SArg5.Per# more damage and drains #.SArg1# Energy from all enemy heroes every #.SArg6#s. If Rem uses her Ultimate while already in demon form, the duration of her demon form will be reset, and the effect of her current Morning Star swings will be enhanced, dealing damage multiple times each equal to #.SArg2.Per# of her Attack Rating and knocking targets airborne.
11.ShortDescription: Rem enters her demon form for a duration and swings her Morning Star several times, damaging nearby enemies multiple times. In demon form, Rem deals extra damage and drains Energy from all enemy heroes every #.SArg6#s. If Rem uses her Ultimate while already in demon form, the effect of her current Morning Star swings will be enhanced, increasing their damage and knocking their targets airborne.

12.UpgradeDescription: While in Demon Form, Rem's normal attack speed is increased by #.SArg3# points, and #.SArg4.Per# of the damage she deals will be converted into healing for herself.
12.ShortUpgradeDescription: While in Demon Form, Rem's normal attack speed is increased, and part of the damage she deals will be converted into healing for herself.

13.UpgradeDescription: The Energy Rem drains from all enemy heroes is increased to #.SArg1# points every #.SArg6#s.
13.ShortUpgradeDescription: Increases the amount of Energy drained every #.SArg6#s.

20.Description: Rem uses her Morning Star to smash the enemy who has dealt the highest total damage, damaging the enemy for #.PlusRatio.Per# of her Attack Rating, knocking them back, and reducing their Energy by #.SArg1# points. If the enemy is knocked to the edge of the battlefield, they will take additional damage equal to #.SArg0.Per# of her Attack Rating and be stunned for #.SArg2#s.
20.ShortDescription: Rem uses her Morning Star to smash the enemy who has dealt the highest total damage, damaging the enemy, knocking them back, and reducing their Energy. If the enemy is knocked to the edge of the battlefield, they take additional physical damage and are stunned for a duration.

21.UpgradeDescription: The damage of the initial smash is increased to #.PlusRatio.Per# of Rem's Attack Rating.
21.ShortUpgradeDescription: The damage of the initial smash is increased.

22.UpgradeDescription: The damage of the initial smash is increased to #.PlusRatio.Per# of Rem's Attack Rating.
22.ShortUpgradeDescription: The damage of the initial smash is increased.

23.UpgradeDescription: The Energy reduction is increased to #.SArg1# points.
23.ShortUpgradeDescription: The Energy reduction is increased.

31.Description: Rem uses healing mana to heal the allied hero with the lowest health for #.SArg4.Per# of their max health. The allied hero also receives a shield worth #.SArg0.Per# of Rem's Attack Rating. The healing mana's effects linger for #.SArg1#s, increasing the allied hero's Vitality by #.SArg2# points and healing them for #.SArg3.Per# of Rem's Attack Rating every second.
31.ShortDescription: Rem uses healing mana to instantly heal the allied hero with the lowest health and grant them a shield. The healing mana's effects linger for a time, increasing the allied hero's Vitality and healing them every second.

32.UpgradeDescription: The initial healing is increased to #.SArg4.Per# of the allied hero's max health.
32.ShortUpgradeDescription: The initial healing is increased.

33.UpgradeDescription: The initial healing is increased to #.SArg4.Per# of the allied hero's max health.
33.ShortUpgradeDescription: The initial healing is increased.

34.UpgradeDescription: The healing mana's effects now linger for #.SArg1#s and heal the allied hero for #.SArg3.Per# of Rem's Attack Rating per second.
34.ShortUpgradeDescription: The healing mana's effects linger for longer and heal the allied hero for more health per second.

41.Description: Rem's Attack Rating permanently increases the more her allies take damage. For every #.SArg0.Per# of their max health an ally loses, Rem's Attack Rating is increased by #.SArg1.Per# (up to #.SArg2.Per# of Rem's initial Attack Rating).
41.ShortDescription: Rem's Attack Rating permanently increases the more her allies take damage, up to a certain limit.

42.UpgradeDescription: The limit is increased to #.SArg2.Per# of Rem's initial Attack Rating.
42.ShortUpgradeDescription: The maximum bonus to Attack Rating is increased.

43.UpgradeDescription: For each allied hero that dies, Rem permanently gains #.SArg3# points of Haste.
43.ShortUpgradeDescription: For each allied hero that dies, Rem's Haste is permanently increased.

44.UpgradeDescription: For each allied hero that dies, Rem permanently gains #.SArg4.Per# damage reduction.
44.ShortUpgradeDescription: For each allied hero that dies, Rem's damage reduction is permanently increased.

81.Description: All damage Rem deals with her Morning Star is increased by #.SArg0.Per#.
81.ShortDescription: All damage Rem deals with her Morning Star is increased.

82.UpgradeDescription: All damage Rem deals with her Morning Star is increased by #.SArg0.Per#. #.SArg1.Per# of this additional damage ignores enemy shields.
82.ShortUpgradeDescription: All damage Rem deals with her Morning Star is further increased. A portion of this additional damage ignores enemy shields.

83.UpgradeDescription: All damage Rem deals with her Morning Star is increased by #.SArg0.Per#. #.SArg1.Per# of this additional damage ignores enemy shields.
83.ShortUpgradeDescription: All damage Rem deals with her Morning Star is further increased. A portion of this additional damage ignores enemy shields.

84.UpgradeDescription: While Rem is in Demon Form, #.SArg2.Per# of the damage dealt by her Ultimate ignores enemy shields.
84.ShortUpgradeDescription: While Rem is in Demon Form, a portion of the damage dealt by her Ultimate ignores enemy shields.

91.Description: When an allied hero takes fatal damage, they will immediately receive the effects of the Healing Mana skill and become immune to damage for #.SArg0#s. This effect can only be triggered by each ally once per battle.
91.ShortDescription: When an allied hero takes fatal damage, they will immediately receive the effects of the Healing Mana skill and become immune to damage for a brief period. This effect can only be triggered by each ally once per battle.

92.UpgradeDescription: The Healing Mana skill triggered when an allied hero takes fatal damage also restores their Energy by #.SArg1# points.
92.ShortUpgradeDescription: The Healing Mana skill triggered when an allied hero takes fatal damage also restores their Energy substantially.

11.Description:
Athalia descends from the heavens and creates a Judgment Sphere that lasts for #.SArg0#s targeting the enemy hero with the highest Attack Rating, dealing damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of her Attack Rating to the target while knocking back all other enemies within range to the edge of the sphere. Then, she uses all her Sacred Blades to attack the target, with each blade dealing damage for #.SArg1.Per# of her Attack Rating to the target. When a Judgment Sphere is active, the target cannot move and Athalia prioritizes attacking them, while the Judgment Sphere continues to knock back enemies other than the target.
A battlefield can only have one Judgment Sphere, which disappears when its target dies.
11.ShortDescription: Athalia creates a Judgment Sphere targeting the enemy hero with the highest Attack Rating, dealing damage to the target while knocking back all other enemies within range. Then, she uses all her Sacred Blades to additionally damage the target.

12.UpgradeDescription: The cooldown time of the skill "Ripping Slash" is reset immediately after her Ultimate is used.
12.ShortUpgradeDescription: The cooldown time of the skill "Ripping Slash" is reset immediately after her Ultimate is used.

13.UpgradeDescription: When a Judgment Sphere is created, most of the target's buffs will be dispelled. While a Judgment Sphere exists, the skill "Ripping Slash" will only attack the target, with multiple slashes.
13.ShortUpgradeDescription: When a Judgment Sphere is created, most of the target's buffs will be dispelled. While a Judgment Sphere exists, the skill "Ripping Slash" will only attack the target, with multiple slashes.

20.Description: Athalia traverses the battlefield at high speed, slashing #.SArg7# enemy heroes with the highest Attack Rating for #.SArg0# times, dealing damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of her Attack Rating to the target and enemies in her path. When the skill ends, Athalia teleports to the enemy hero with the highest Attack Rating. During the skill, Athalia is invincible and untargetable.
20.ShortDescription: Athalia traverses the battlefield, slashing #.SArg0# enemy heroes with the highest Attack Rating for #.SArg0# times.

21.UpgradeDescription: When an enemy suffers multiple slashes, each round of damage they receive from the skill this time is increased by #.SArg1.Per#.
21.ShortUpgradeDescription: When an enemy suffers multiple slashes, each round of damage they receive from the skill this time is increased.

22.UpgradeDescription: A slash from this skill deals additional damage equal to #.SArg2.Per# of the health already lost by the target, up to #.SArg3.Per# of Athalia's Attack Rating.
22.ShortUpgradeDescription: A slash from this skill deals additional damage.

23.UpgradeDescription: The number of slashes this skill can inflict is increased by #.SArg4# time.
23.ShortUpgradeDescription: The number of slashes this skill can inflict is increased by #.SArg4# time.

24.UpgradeDescription: After Athalia kills an enemy hero, the cooldown time of this skill is reduced by #.SArg5.Per# and she immediately gains #.SArg6# Sacred Blades.
24.ShortUpgradeDescription: After Athalia kills an enemy hero, the cooldown time of this skill is reduced and she immediately gains #.SArg6# Sacred Blades.

31.Description:
Passive: All damage and health loss suffered by Athalia from behind is reduced by #.SArg0.Per#.
Active: Athalia deals damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of her Attack Rating to enemies within a certain range #.SArg6# times, while the skill's passive effects mitigate damage and health loss from all directions for #.SArg5#s. During the skill, Athalia is immune to control effects.
31.ShortDescription:
Passive: All damage and health loss suffered by Athalia from behind is reduced by #.SArg0.Per#.
Active: Athalia deals damage to enemies within a certain range multiple times, while the skill's passive effects mitigate damage and health loss from all directions. During the skill, Athalia is immune to control effects.

32.UpgradeDescription: This skill dispels most of Athalia's debuffs. After the skill ends, Athalia will deal additional magic damage equal to #.SArg2.Per# of her Attack Rating for the subsequent #.SArg1# times she deals damage.
32.ShortUpgradeDescription: This skill dispels most of Athalia's debuffs. After the skill ends, Athalia will deal additional magic damage for the subsequent #.SArg1# times she deals damage.

33.UpgradeDescription: The lower Athalia's health percentage, the higher the Damage Reduction from the skill's passive effects, which can go up to #.SArg4.Per#.
33.ShortUpgradeDescription: The lower Athalia's health percentage, the higher the Damage Reduction from the skill's passive effects.

41.Description:
For every #.SArg0# times Athalia has dealt damage, she receives 1 Sacred Blade. This effect can only trigger up to #.SArg2# times every #.SArg1#s, and Athalia can hold up to 6 Sacred Blades.
Damage dealt by Athalia is increased based on her and her target's current health percentage. The greater the difference between her and her target's current health percentage, the more the damage increase, by up to #.SArg3.Per#.
41.ShortDescription:
For every #.SArg0# times Athalia has dealt damage, she receives 1 Sacred Blade. She can hold up to 6 Sacred Blades.
Damage dealt by Athalia is increased based on her and her target's current health percentage.

42.UpgradeDescription: When allied heroes use their Ultimate, Athalia gains #.SArg4# Sacred Blade(s). This effect can only be triggered once every #.SArg6#s by each allied hero. When an enemy hero dies, Athalia gains #.SArg5# Sacred Blade(s).
42.ShortUpgradeDescription: When allied heroes use their Ultimate, Athalia gains #.SArg4# Sacred Blade(s). This effect can only be triggered once every #.SArg6#s by each allied hero. When an enemy hero dies, Athalia gains #.SArg5# Sacred Blade(s).

43.UpgradeDescription: When Athalia gains a Sacred Blade, she deals damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of her Attack Rating to the enemy with the highest Energy, ignoring the target's Defense and reducing their current Energy by #.SArg7.Per# or at least #.SArg8# Energy points.
43.ShortUpgradeDescription: Each time Athalia gains 1 Sacred Blade, Athalia deals damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of her Attack Rating to the enemy with the highest Energy, ignoring the target's Defense and reducing their current Energy by #.SArg7.Per#.

51.Description: For every #.SArg5# Sacred Blade(s) Athalia gains, she permanently increases the damage dealt by allied heroes by #.SArg0.Per# and their Physical Pierce by #.SArg1# points. This effect can stack up to #.SArg2# time(s). When allied heroes are inflicted with control effects, the attacker takes damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of Athalia's Attack Rating and is unable to recover Energy for the next #.SArg3#s. This effect can only be triggered once every #.SArg4#s by each allied hero.

11.Description:
Dracula summons a Blood Moon to the battlefield for #.SArg0#s. While the Blood Moon is active, Dracula is immune to controls.

21.ShortUpgradeDescription: Targets attacked by Eternal Decree are afflicted with a Crimson Specter.

Dracula transforms into several bats and teleports to the target, dealing damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of Attack Rating while silencing them for #.SArg0#s and afflicting them with a Crimson Specter for #.SArg1#s. Each enemy hero can be afflicted by up to #.SArg2# Crimson Specters at a time.
When an allied hero damages a target afflicted by a Crimson Specter, the attacker recovers health equal to #.SArg4.Per# of Attack Power for every #.SArg3# point of Life Leech they have.

Dracula transforms into bats and teleports to the target, dealing damage while silencing the target and afflicting them with a Crimson Specter.
When an allied hero damages a target afflicted by a Crimson Specter, the attacker recovers health.
When Dracula uses this skill, she prioritizes attacking enemy units that have not been afflicted by a Crimson Specter.

32.UpgradeDescription: Damage is increased to #.PlusRatio.Per# of Attack Rating, while health recovery is increased to #.SArg4.Per# of Attack Power.
32.ShortUpgradeDescription: Damage and health recovery are increased.

33.ShortUpgradeDescription: When an allied hero attacks a target afflicted by a Crimson Specter, they will inflict increased damage and health loss based on how much their Life Leech exceeds the target's Life Leech. Each attack will also restore Energy to them.

34.UpgradeDescription: When an allied hero attacks a target afflicted by a Crimson Specter, for every #.SArg5# points that the allied hero's Life Leech exceeds the target's Life Leech, the damage and health loss the attacker deals will be increased by #.SArg6.Per# (capped at a max increase of #.SArg7.Per#), while each attack will also restore #.SArg8# Energy to them.
34.ShortUpgradeDescription: When an allied hero attacks a target afflicted by a Crimson Specter, they will inflict increased damage and health loss based on how much their Life Leech exceeds the target's Life Leech. Each attack will also restore Energy to them.

41.Description:
For each point of Life Leech Dracula has, her Vampiric Chalice gains #.SArg0# Blood per second.
When an allied hero attacks a target afflicted by a Crimson Specter, each attack adds #.SArg1# Blood to the Vampiric Chalice for every point of Life Leech the attacker has.
The Vampiric Chalice will be filled once it contains #.SArg2# Blood. Each time the chalice is filled, Scarlet Overflow will be triggered, dealing damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of Dracula's Attack Rating to all enemies while reducing their Attack Rating by #.SArg3.Per# and Defense Rating by #.SArg3.Per# for #.SArg4#s.
41.ShortDescription:
For each point of Life Leech Dracula has, her Vampiric Chalice gains #.SArg0# Blood per second.
When an allied hero attacks a target afflicted by a Crimson Specter, each attack adds Blood to the Vampiric Chalice.
The Vampiric Chalice will be filled once it contains #.SArg2# Blood. Each time the chalice is filled, Scarlet Overflow will be triggered, dealing damage to all enemies while reducing their Attack Rating and Defense Rating.

42.UpgradeDescription: Dracula gains 1 point of Life Leech for every #.SArg5# points of Magic Pierce she has.
42.ShortUpgradeDescription: Dracula gains Life Leech for every point of Magic Pierce she has.

Dracula absorbs #.SArg6# Energy per second from the Bloodbound Servant. If they lack sufficient Energy, then Dracula absorbs #.SArg7.Per# of their health instead (capped at #.SArg8.Per# of Dracula's Attack Rating). Lasts for #.SArg9#s.

When Scarlet Overflow is triggered, Dracula transforms the enemy hero with the highest Energy into a Bloodbound Servant, causing them to continuously use normal attacks to attack random enemy units.
Dracula absorbs Energy from the Bloodbound Servant every second. If the servant lacks sufficient Energy, she absorbs their health instead.
If the target dies while in Bloodbound Servant form, the Vampiric Chalice immediately gains Blood.

81.Description: Each time Scarlet Overflow is triggered, all allies permanently gain #.SArg0.Per# max health and #.SArg1# points of Life Leech. While Blood Moon is active, the damage Dracula deals to enemy units per second is increased by #.SArg2.Per# (capped at #.SArg3# increases).

92.UpgradeDescription:

The effects of the Vampiric Chalice and Crimson Specters take effect as normal, and the next time Scarlet Overflow is triggered, Dracula will be revived with #.SArg1.Per# health.
While Dracula is in bat form, the duration of all Crimson Specters on the battlefield will be increased by #.SArg2#s. The cooldown for triggering the bat transformation is #.SArg3#s.

When Dracula takes fatal damage, she does not die, but transforms into a bat instead. While in bat form, she cannot be targeted or attacked.
The effects of the Vampiric Chalice and Crimson Specters take effect as normal, and the next time Scarlet Overflow is triggered, Dracula will be revived.
While Dracula is in bat form, the duration of all Crimson Specters on the battlefield will be increased.

11.Description:
After joining battle, Judy immediately uses Opening Night and cannot be knocked back or knocked into the air in the battle.
Opening Night: Judy enters Backstage and summons Punch to assist in battle. Punch is immune to control effects. Punch's max health is #.SArg0.Per# of the sum of all allied heroes' initial max health, but no less than #.SArg8.Per# of Judy's initial max health. Punch slams the ground every #.SArg1#s, dealing damage equal to #.SArg2.Per# of Judy's Attack Rating to nearby enemy units and knocking them into the air. While in Backstage, Judy is invincible and untargetable and recovers #.SArg4# Energy every #.SArg3#s.
Curtain Call: Judy restores #.SArg9.Per# of Punch's max health and commands him to use a powerful pull, dealing damage equal to #.SArg10.Per# of Judy's Attack Rating to all enemy units in range and knocking them into the air toward Punch.
While Judy is in Backstage, Opening Night is replaced with Curtain Call.
11.ShortDescription:
After joining battle, Judy immediately uses Opening Night and cannot be knocked back or knocked into the air in the battle.
Opening Night: Judy enters Backstage and summons Punch to assist in battle. Punch is immune to control effects. Punch slams the ground every several seconds, dealing damage to nearby enemy units and knocking them into the air. While in Backstage, Judy is invincible and untargetable and recovers Energy every several seconds.
Curtain Call: Judy restores Punch's health and commands him to use a powerful pull, dealing damage to all enemy units in range and knocking them into the air toward Punch.
While Judy is in Backstage, Opening Night is replaced with Curtain Call.

23.ShortUpgradeDescription: Whenever Stage Rift deals damage, for every certain number of points that Judy's Magic Pierce exceeds the target's Magic Resist, the damage is increased.

31.ShortDescription: Passive: Every certain number of times an enemy unit takes damage from Judy or Punch, a Stage Rift is created below that unit, dealing damage to enemy units in range.

82.ShortUpgradeDescription: Every certain number of times an enemy unit takes damage from Shadow Theater, most of its buffs are removed.

84.ShortUpgradeDescription: Enemy units in range of Shadow Theater deal reduced damage, while allied units in range deal increased damage.

11.Description:
Athena dazzles the battlefield, launching 6 attacks against all enemies, with each attack dealing damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of her Attack Rating. Creates a Divine Shield worth #.SArg0.Per# of Athena's Defense for #.SArg1#s. This shield absorbs damage for all allied heroes. This skill can be triggered once every #.SArg7#s. The damage absorbed by the Divine Shield is stored up. When the shield disappears, the stored damage is converted into divine damage that Athena deals to all enemies.

Athena dazzles the battlefield, launching multiple strikes of damage against all enemies and creating a Divine Shield that absorbs damage for all allied heroes.
Divine Shield: Allied heroes gain increased Tenacity. Whenever an allied hero inflicts damage or health loss, it is increased based on how much the allied hero's Tenacity exceeds the enemy's Tenacity.

Whenever Kikoru Shinomiya deals damage with Number One - Falling Thunder, enemy units hit will be unable to recover Energy for a certain duration.
When Kafka Hibino transforms into Kaiju No. 8, Kikoru Shinomiya gains 1 bar of Unleashed Combat Power.

Kikoru Shinomiya's critical strikes deal #.SArg0.Per# more damage to enemy units with shields.
Once Kikoru Shinomiya's Unleashed Combat Power reaches max, her critical strikes will destroy enemy shields and deal bonus damage equal to #.SArg1.Per# of her Attack Rating.
81.ShortDescription:
The bonus damage that Kikoru Shinomiya's critical strikes deal to enemy units with shields is increased.
Once Kikoru Shinomiya's Unleashed Combat Power reaches max, her critical strikes will destroy enemy shields and deal extra damage.

82.ShortUpgradeDescription: Once Kikoru Shinomiya's Unleashed Combat Power reaches max, she becomes immune to being knocked back or knocked into the air.

84.ShortUpgradeDescription: When Kikoru Shinomiya gains immunity to being knocked back or knocked into the air, she immediately uses Number Six - Daruma Dropper once.

31.Description: Demonic Nemora summons a Dreaf once every #.SArg0#s until there are a total of #.SArg1# Dreafs on the battlefield, with each new Dreaf that is summoned being larger and stronger than the previous one. The Dreafs crit ratings will also be increased the lower their health falls, up until it reaches a maximum of #.SArg2.Per#.

41.Description: 橡木贤者召唤闪电肆虐战场，闪电对附近的敌人造成伤害(不用翻译)

11.Description: Shemira summons snowfall #.SArg0#s into the battle which falls heavier every #.SArg1#s. While there is light snow fall, all of her enemies will be unable to recover any health. While there is heavy snowfall, her enemies will also be dealt periodic damage. Each time Shemira summons snowfall or increases the severity of the snowfall she will receive a layer of frost armor which, when active is immune to all damage that is lower than #.SArg2.Per# its total value.

21.Description: Ice Shemira prioritizes her attacks against two frontline enemies, channeling her glacial beams to deal multiple instances of damage over time to the enemies. The glacial beams also possess a freezing quality which stacks over time, reducing the enemies' Haste.

31.Description: Ice Shemira creates an expanding shockwave of ice that damages all enemies. Enemies that possess less than #.SArg1.Per# of their max health will become frozen.

11.Description: When the Burning Brute's health falls below #.SArg0.Per# and #.SArg1.Per# it falls asleep for #.SArg2#s. If the Brute is dealt damage that exceeds #.SArg3.Per# of its total health it will awaken and use a more ferocious method of attacking its enemies. (The Brute will awaken naturally on its own after a certain duration of time if it is not triggered by damage.)

21.Description: The Brute breathes fire out of its mouth, inflicting damage on its enemies. Once the Brute awakens from its "Doze" state it receives a new type of skill that causes the ground below its enemies' feet to burn, dealing AoE damage to them.

31.Description: The Brute summons a fiery barrier around itself at the beginning of battles that is able to reduce the damage of all incoming attacks which come from outside of the shield by #.SArg0.Per#. Shield is deactivated while the Brute's "Doze" skill is being used.

11.Description: Increases allies' Haste by #.SArg1# points and Crit Rating by #.SArg2# points for #.SArg0#s each time Dreaf is re-summoned.

198.Description: Increases all allies' Haste by #.SArg1# points and CRIT by #.SArg2# points for #.SArg0# seconds.

20.Description: Produces a high-value shield around the ally with the lowest amount of energy. While protected by the shield, the affected ally will quickly recover energy.

199.Description: Demonic Nemora cannot be attacked. Instead, she summons #.SArg0# Dreafs to fight for her. Dreafs are considered to be boss units, and when they receive damage, Demonic Nemora suffers the same damage as well.

31.Description: Nemora cannot be attacked. Whenever there are no surviving summoned Dreafs on the battlefield Nemora will summon #.SArg0# Dreafs. Summoned Dreafs will receive attribute increases when in an "Enraged" state and any damage that they receive will also be received by Nemora.

11.Description: When Shemira has stacked #.SArg0# layer of the "Enraged" effect, a "Blizzard" will occur on the battlefield. While there is a blizzard occurring, enemies are unable to recover health. Once Shemira has stacked #.SArg1# layer of the "Enraged" effect, the blizzard's damage will be increased and also have a knock-back effect on enemies.

Shemira then unleashes a "Frost Nova" that deals damage to all enemies on the battlefield, freezing any enemies that have health lower than #.SArg1.Per#.

41.Description: Each time "Blizzard" is used, Shemira receives a shield that is able to mitigate damage for #.SArg0#s. Damage mitigated by the shield is equal to #.SArg1.Per# of the damage required to stack another "Enraged" layer. Each stacked "Enraged" layer will increase the shield's value by #.SArg3.Per#. Damage dealt to Shemira that is less than #.SArg2.Per# of the shield's total value is completely negated.

199.Description: During battle, the rate at which allied heroes recover Energy is increased, and the highest damage-dealing allied hero receives an additional #.SArg2# Energy points every #.SArg1#s.

11.Description: Kane's dragon breathes fire on enemies, dealing #.PlusRatio.Per# AoE damage to them.

31.Description: At #.SArg0#, #.SArg1# and #.SArg2#s into the battle, the enemy that has dealt the highest amount of damage will be annihilated by Kane.

41.Description: Deals multi-stage damage. The first stage deals #.SArg0.Per# damage to all enemies, destroying all protective shields that they may be using. The second stage deals #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to all enemies on the battlefield.

11.Description: When the Brute has stacked #.SArg0# or #.SArg1# layers of the "Enraged" effect, it will doze off for #.SArg2#s. When the Brute awakens for the first time, it acquires a new method of attack that allows it to target enemies positioned behind itself by smashing the ground ferociously. The second time the Brute awakens causes its frontal attacks to become more ferocious.

21.Description: The Brute breathes fire on his enemies, inflicting damage upon them. After the Brute awakens from its slumber for the first time, it acquires a new attack method that causes fire to erupt from below its enemies' feet, dealing damage to them and AoE damage to any other enemies surrounding the original enemy target.

31.Description: The Brute summons a fiery barrier around itself at the beginning of battles that is able to reduce the damage of attacks which originate from outside it by #.SArg0.Per#. Barrier is deactivated while the Brute's "Doze" skill is being used.

11.Description: When used passively, a singular lightning bolt is cast upon a random enemy every #.SArg0#s. When used actively, #.SArg1# bolts will be cast successively on multiple enemies. Enemies that are struck by lightning bolts will lose the majority of buffs from which they are currently benefiting.

21.Description: Arden uses this skill twice, respectively at #.SArg0#s and #.SArg1#s into battles. Arden entangles his enemies with his vines one by one based on their battlefield locations until all enemies are entangled. Entangled enemies are unable to move and will gradually lose health over time. The entangling vines disappear #.SArg2#s after Arden has finished casting this skill.

31.Description: Arden's skills can be interrupted by control effects that last for a duration #.SArg1#s or more. When Arden is unaffected by any enemy control effects, he utilizes a passive shield that is able to reduce the damage he receives by #.SArg0.Per#.

131.Description: Passive. Arden creates a shield that protects himself, reducing the damage he receives by #.SArg0.Per#.

199.Description: During battle, allied heroes' Crit Ratings are increased and they receive #.SArg1# Haste points after dealing a Critical Strike.

31.Description: Azmonath reaves the soul of an enemy whose health is currently lower than #.SArg0.Per#, causing them to immediately die. Each time Azmonath uses this skill, the damage he receives is decreased by #.SArg1.Per# until the end of the battle.

11.Description: 普攻(不用翻译)

Skill is activated #.SArg0#s, #.SArg1#s and #.SArg2#s respectively in battles.
Ainz begins a chant, #.SArg3#s into his chant, Ainz deals high damage to all enemies on the battlefield. When Ainz begins his chant, he is granted a shield which exists for #.SArg3#s. The first time the shield is used allows Ainz to mitigate #.SArg4# damage, the second time #.SArg5# damage and the third time #.SArg6# damage shall be mitigated. If the shield is broken during the chanting phase, Ainz shall end his chant.

21.Description:
Ainz's normal attacks are changed to the following skills, which are used in a cycle:
Call Greater Thunder: Deals high damage to a single enemy target.
Gravity Maelstrom: Deals AoE damage to the enemy target and other nearby enemies.
True Dark: Deals low damage to a single enemy target and prevents them from using their ultimate skill for #.SArg0#s.

31.Description: Damage from Support or Mage heroes is reduced by #.SArg0.Per#.

41.Description:
Skill only becomes active after Albedo's death.
During battle Ainz' Attack Speed is increased by #.SArg0# points. When using the skill "Fallen Down", Ainz will use Cash Items to complete his chanting more quickly, and the value of Ainz' shield generated after chanting is increased by #.SArg1.Per#.

12.Description: Shemira summons a blizzard that deals damage to nearby enemies over #.SArg0#s.

11.Description: Ezizh unleashes fire around Abyssal Totems, instantly dealing damage to nearby enemy targets. The fire exists for a duration, dealing damage periodically. Enemies standing upon the burning ground have their Attack Ratings reduced by #.SArg0.Per#, and enemies with health lower than #.SArg1.Per# shall suffer from interruptive effects. This skill can only be used when Ezizh is not restricted.

102.Description: 挣脱(不用翻译)

31.Description: Ezizh lets out an abyssal roar. If Ezizh is restricted, his enemies will be unable to use their ultimate skills for #.SArg0#s, and will continuously lose health. If Ezizh is unrestricted, his enemies are directly dealt damage, and are terrified for #.SArg1#s.

103.Description: 变身狂吼(不用翻译)

11.Description: Skill is triggered once after the first #.SArg0#, #.SArg1#, #.SArg2#s of battle. Safiya begins chanting for #.SArg3#s, after which she deals #.SArg4.Per# damage to all enemy targets. While chanting, Safiya is granted a shield which exists for #.SArg3#s, that is able to mitigate up to #.SArg5# damage. Safiya will cease chanting if her shield is destroyed.

21.Description: Safiya shoots a magic orb at a single enemy target, dealing #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to them, stunning them for #.SArg1#s. The orb then splits into #.SArg0# weaker, separate orbs that strike other nearby enemies.

31.Description: Safiya casts a spell on herself, that allows her to deal #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to nearby enemies every second over #.SArg0#s.

11.Description: Gorvo roars angrily, dealing #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to all enemies. Gorvo's roar is able to taunt enemies within a certain radius into targeting him with normal attacks for #.SArg0#s. Gorvo is also able to deflect #.SArg1.Per# of the damage he receives back at his enemies while this skill is active.

21.Description: Gorvo charges his war hammer up every #.SArg1#s, causing the following attack to become a critical strike that deals AoE damage to nearby enemies, leaving them stunned for #.SArg0#s.

31.Description: After entering the battlefield Gorvo casts a shield around himself that is equal to #.SArg0.Per# of his maximum health which lasts for #.SArg1#s. The shield is also activated every time Gorvo uses his ultimate skill.

11.Description: Vurk runs up and down the battlefield for #.SArg0#s while he fires bolts at multiple enemies. Bolts may pierce enemies, and all enemies struck by the bolt are dealt #.PlusRatio.Per# damage.

21.Description: When using Normal Attacks, Bolts fired from Vurk's crossbow are able to penetrate enemies, dealing #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to all enemies standing in a straight line.

31.Description: Vurk lobs a poison vial at an enemy, which poisons them for #.SArg0#s. The poisoned enemy will have their energy recovery rate decreased by #.SArg1.Per# and Attack Rating decreased by #.SArg2.Per#, in addition, the enemy target shall lose #.SArg3.Per# max health every second. Poison effects cannot be stacked, and if an already poisoned enemy is targeted again by this skill, the duration of the poison's effects shall be extended.

11.Description: Hendrik smashes the ground with his shield, dealing #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to surrounding enemies, leaving them stunned for #.SArg0#s. Every #.SArg1.Per# of Hendrik's maximum health that is lost will extend the skill's stun effect by #.SArg2#s, which can be extended up to a total of #.SArg3#s.

21.Description: Hendrik uses his shield to knock back the enemy in front of him, dealing #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to them, also stunning them for #.SArg0#s. Once the stun effect has worn off, the affected enemy will deal #.SArg2.Per# less damage over the next #.SArg1#s.

31.Description: This skill is triggered once after #.SArg0# and #.SArg1#s of battle respectively, at which time Hendrik places his shield into the ground and assumes a defensive stance, allowing him to become immune to control effects, also reducing the damage he receives by #.SArg2.Per# for a duration of #.SArg3#s.

11.Description: Lyca shoots an arrow that deals #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to all enemy targets which it passes through, knocking them backwards in the process.

21.Description: Lyca shoots off 3 arrows in quick succession, with each arrow dealing #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to the enemy target.

31.Description: When Lyca deals damage to an enemy, their Defense is reduced by #.SArg1.Per# and their Crit Block Rate is reduced by #.SArg2.Per# for #.SArg0#s. This skill cannot be stacked.

11.Description: Belinda uses her divine power to attack a large area of enemies #.SArg0# times, with each hit dealing magic damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of her Attack Rating.

21.Description: Belinda fires an orb of divine energy towards her enemies that explodes on impact with the first enemy it reaches, dealing #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to nearby enemies. Enemies that are damaged by this skill will lose #.SArg0# Accuracy points.

31.Description: Crit Rating is increased by #.SArg0.Per#.

20.Description: Khazard fires #.SArg0# "Glacial Shards" in multiple directions. Each glacial shard deals #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to the enemies which are struck, also causing them to lose #.SArg3# Haste points for #.SArg2#s. Any enemies that are struck by multiple ice shards will be dealt #.SArg1.Per# less damage by subsequent shards after the second glacial shard.

31.Description: Khazard fires an icy beam at an enemy which deals #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to them and causes them to become frozen for #.SArg0#s.

41.Description: While there is "Frozen Mist" present on the battlefield, Khazard's "Frost Serpent" attacks an enemy with its ice breath, dealing #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to them, causing them to become frozen for #.SArg0#s.

11.Description: Zaphrael teleports to the edge of the battlefield that has the most enemies on it and fires #.SArg0# powerful bolts of lightning across the battlefield. Each bolt deals damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating to enemies it passes through.

20.Description: Zaphrael summons a thundercloud for #.SArg0#s. Every #.SArg1#s, the cloud strikes the enemy nearest to Zaphrael, dealing damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating and briefly stunning them.

31.Description: Zaphrael teleports behind the enemy closest to the allied side, knocking them down and damaging nearby enemies for #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating. He also gains a shield that can absorb damage for #.SArg1.Per# of his Attack Rating for #.SArg0#s. Zaphrael uses melee normal attacks while the shield is active. When the shield wears off, Zaphrael teleports back to his original position.

41.Description: During battle, enemies damaged by Zaphrael will be electrified for #.SArg0#s. When electrified enemies are dealt damage that exceeds #.SArg1.Per# of their max health, the electric shall be transferred to the next closest enemy, causing the nearby enemy to lose health that is equal to #.SArg2.Per# of the initial attack's damage.
