31.Description: Rigby drinks himself into a drunken frenzy which reduces all the damage he receives by #.SArg0.Per# and also increases his Haste by #.SArg1# points. The effects of 'Drunken Frenzy' can be stacked up to 3 times, with the third time causing Rigby to become even more enraged, further increasing his Haste by #.SArg3# points for #.SArg2#s, after which he returns to his normal state.
31.ShortDescription: Rigby drinks himself into Drunken Frenzy, reducing all the damage he receives while having his Haste increased. The effects of Drunken Frenzy can be stacked up to 3 times, with the third time causing Rigby to become even more enraged, further increasing his Haste for the next #.SArg2#s, after which he returns to his normal state.

41.Description: After the effects of 'Drunken Frenzy' have worn off, Rigby will recover #.SArg0.Per# of his max health per second for #.SArg1#s.
41.ShortDescription: After the effects of Drunken Frenzy have worn off, Rigby will recover his health every second for #.SArg1#s.

11.Description: Ulmus immediately recovers #.SArg2.Per# of his max HP and roots himself to the ground until the end of the battle. While rooted to the ground, Ulmus is immune to all control effects and his normal attack turns into a ranged attack that increases his Attack Rating by #.SArg0.Per#. If Ulmus possesses enough energy while he is rooted, he will use #.SArg1.Per# of his maximum energy to grant his normal attack more AoE damage and a stun effect during this period.
11.ShortDescription: Ulmus recovers his health and roots himself to the ground until the end of the battle. After rooting, Ulmus is immune to all control effects, and his normal attack turns into a ranged attack with a higher Attack Rating. He will also use #.SArg1.Per# of max Energy to grant his normal attack more AoE damage and a stun effect during this period.

20.Description: Ulmus uses his roots to entangle nearby enemies, causing #.SArg0.Per# damage to them. Enemies that are entangled cannot use any attacks or casting.
20.ShortDescription: Ulmus uses his roots to entangle the closest and nearby enemies, causing damage to them. The entangled enemies cannot use any attacks or casting.

31.Description: Ulmus casts a shield around his ally with the lowest health percentage, mitigating up to #.SArg0.Per# of the damage they receive.
31.ShortDescription: Ulmus casts a shield on the ally with the lowest health percentage.

41.Description: Grows periodically.
41.ShortDescription: Ulmus recovers his health every second.

21.Description: Clawlossus summons a massive wave, dealing several rounds of damage to all enemies and knocking them back. The wave destroys the targets' shields and stuns them for #.SArg1#s if they are knocked to the edge of the battlefield. Each use of Drowning Deluge will increase its damage and knockback distance.

31.Description: Clawlossus waves its soul lamp, launching deathly flames at the enemies in the back, dealing AoE damage and reducing the Attack Rating and Defense Rating of hit enemies by #.SArg0.Per# and #.SArg1.Per# respectively until the end of battle. This effect can stack up to #.SArg2# times. Hit enemies will become Soulless, immobilizing them and dealing continuous damage to their nearby allies. Soullessness lasts for #.SArg3#s and cannot stack or be dispelled.

41.Description: After an enemy hero is knocked back to the edge of the battlefield by Drowning Deluge or becomes Soulless due to Spirit Snatcher, Clawlossus will deal #.SArg1.Per# extra damage and take #.SArg2.Per# less damage for #.SArg3#s. This effect cannot stack. The cooldown of Drowning Deluge and Spirit Snatcher decreases the more times they are used.

11.Description: Theowyn splits herself into multiple Specters and flies in all directions, during which time she cannot be attacked nor receive any active effects from her allies' skills. Each Specter that passes through an enemy inflicts #.PlusRatio.Per# damage upon them. Afterwards, the Specters converge on the weakest enemy target currently on the battlefield, after which Theowyn re-manifests herself next to the target. Damage dealt to enemies during the skill's convergence phase is equal to the skill's initial attack damage.

20.Description: Theowyn enters spectral form to enshroud an enemy target and prevent them from recovering any health. While the enemy is enshrouded, Theowyn deals #.PlusRatio.Per# damage per second for a total duration of up to #.SArg0#s. Once Theowyn has finished enshrouding the enemy, she deals an additional #.SArg1.Per# damage to the target. During the enshroud phase, Theowyn cannot be attacked nor receive any active effects from her allies' skills.

31.Description: Theowyn enters spectral form and charges ahead, cursing every enemy that she passes through, damaging them for #.PlusRatio.Per# of her Attack Rating. If an enemy is already cursed, the curse is removed and Theowyn instead deals damage equal to #.SArg0.Per# of the enemy's max health, ignoring their Defense Rating. Damage dealt cannot exceed #.SArg1.Per# of Theowyn's Attack Rating.

41.Description: The physical damage and magic damage taken by Theowyn is reduced by #.SArg0.Per#.

11.Description: Framton throws all enemies in front of him into the air. After a brief delay, he and the enemies crash down onto the nearest enemy, dealing damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of Framton's Attack Rating to all affected enemies while stunning them for #.SArg0#s. For each enemy Framton throws into the air, his Attack Rating is increased by #.SArg1.Per# of that enemy's Attack Rating for #.SArg2#s (capped at #.SArg3.Per# of his current Attack Rating). Bosses and enemies with control immunity will not be thrown by this skill.

20.Description: Framton's normal attack turns into a quick flurry of successive strikes, dealing damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating per strike to enemies in front of him. The final strike knocks enemies into the air and temporarily stuns them, while dealing damage for #.SArg0.Per# of his Attack Rating in the process. Passive: When this skill fails to deal any damage, damage is increased by #.SArg1.Per# the following time it is used. Damage can be stacked up to #.SArg2.Per#, but when an enemy is knocked into the air, the stacked damage bonus is lost.

31.Description: At the start of the battle, Framton teleports to the enemy farthest from him and attacks them, dealing high damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating. If the target is not killed, the cooldown of this skill will be shortened by #.SArg5#s. While the skill is being cast, Framton is immune to control effects.

41.Description:
Passive: Framton is immune to control effects, and he accumulates Blaze Points every time he deals damage using one of his skills:

Blazing Meteor: #.SArg2# Blaze Points
Burning Vengeance: #.SArg4#/#.SArg4#/#.SArg4#/#.SArg5#/#.SArg5#/#.SArg6# Blaze Points
Fists of Fire: #.SArg3# Blaze Points

Once Framton has accumulated #.SArg0# Blaze Points, he triggers this skill: Framton is temporarily immune to all damage and control effects, and deals damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating to all nearby enemies once, preventing them from recovering health for the next #.SArg1# seconds. For every Blaze Point received, Framton's Attack Rating is increased by #.SArg7.Per#.

11.Description: Passive: Canisa & Ruke launch their Normal Attacks separately. Active: Canisa & Ruke jump to the area with the most enemies and both deal damage to nearby enemies equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# and #.SArg0.Per# of their Attack Rating, respectively. Enemies hit by both attacks will be chained for #.SArg1#s. Canisa & Ruke will evenly distribute #.SArg2.Per# of the direct damage they take among chained enemies. The distributed damage cannot exceed #.SArg3.Per# of Canisa & Ruke's Attack Rating.
11.ShortDescription: Passive: Canisa & Ruke launch their Normal Attacks separately. Active: Canisa & Ruke jump to the area with the most enemies and both deal damage to nearby enemies. Enemies hit by both attacks will be chained. Canisa & Ruke will evenly distribute part of any direct damage they take among chained enemies.

20.Description: Canisa & Ruke let out a howl that damages nearby enemies for #.PlusRatio.Per# of Canisa & Ruke's Attack Rating, knocks them back, and stuns them for #.SArg0#s. In addition, Canisa & Ruke gain a shield that lasts for #.SArg1#s, worth #.SArg2.Per# of their max health.
20.ShortDescription: Canisa & Ruke let out a howl that damages nearby enemies, knocks them back, and stuns them for #.SArg0#s. Canisa & Ruke also gain a shield for #.SArg1#s.

41.Description: Canisa & Ruke forge a flaming cage around themselves that lasts up to #.SArg0#s. Every #.SArg1#s, the cage damages enemies within it for #.SArg6.Per# of Canisa & Ruke's Attack Rating, and reduces the enemies' Defense Ratings by #.SArg2.Per# (up to #.SArg4.Per#) for #.SArg3#s. Enemies moving to the edge of the cage are periodically knocked back to the center and stunned for #.SArg5#s.
41.ShortDescription: Canisa & Ruke forge a flaming cage around themselves. While the cage is active, it periodically damages enemies within it and reduces their Defense Ratings (up to #.SArg4.Per#). Enemies moving to the edge of the cage are periodically knocked back to the center and stunned for #.SArg5#s.

11.Description:
Passive: Lady Simona's normal attack drains #.SArg0# Energy from enemy heroes and stores it in her bell. Up to #.SArg1# Energy can be stored.
Active: Lady Simona activates her bell to deal 3 strikes of damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of her Attack Rating to enemies within a certain range in front of her. If any Energy is stored in her bell, it will be transferred to her.
11.ShortDescription:
Passive: Lady Simona's normal attack drains Energy from enemy heroes and stores it in her bell.
Active: Lady Simona activates her bell to deal damage to enemies within a certain range in front of her.

20.Description: At the start of battle, Lady Simona forms a bond with an enemy hero for #.SArg0#s (prioritizes the enemy hero with the highest initial Attack Rating), during which they become her Resonator. Resonators cannot deal damage to Lady Simona, and when they use an active skill other than normal attacks, Lady Simona will store #.SArg1# Energy in her bell. When the bond duration expires, the Resonator is banished for #.SArg2#s, and then Lady Simona will select the enemy hero that deals the most damage to bond with and make her Resonator.
20.ShortDescription: At the start of battle, Lady Simona forms a bond with an enemy hero for #.SArg0#s, during which they become her Resonator. Resonators cannot deal damage to Lady Simona, and when they use an active skill other than normal attacks, Lady Simona will store Energy in her bell. When the bond duration expires, the Resonator is banished. Periodically during battle, Lady Simona will select the enemy hero that deals the most damage to bond with and make her Resonator.

31.Description: Creates a phantom bell for #.SArg0#s in an area where enemies are gathered (prioritizes Resonators). For its duration, the phantom deals damage every second to enemies within range. This damage increases over time. Enemies hit by this damage have their Haste reduced by #.SArg2#, lasting for #.SArg3#s. If a Resonator within range of the phantom casts their Ultimate, the phantom's range will be expanded, for a max expansion of up to #.SArg6.Per#.
31.ShortDescription: Creates a phantom bell for #.SArg0#s in an area where enemies are gathered (prioritizes Resonators). For its duration, the phantom deals damage every second to enemies within range. This damage increases over time. Enemies hit by this damage have their Haste reduced. When a Resonator casts their Ultimate, the phantom's range will be expanded, for a max expansion of up to #.SArg6.Per#.

81.Description: Every time Lady Simona stores #.SArg0# Energy in her bell during this battle, her damage dealt is permanently increased by #.SArg1.Per#.
81.ShortDescription: Every time Lady Simona stores a certain amount of Energy in her bell during this battle, her damage dealt is permanently increased.

11.Description: Scarlet unleashes a torrent of dark energy that strikes #.SArg0# times. Each strike deals damage to a random enemy for #.PlusRatio.Per# of Attack Rating, and inflicts them with 1 stack of Dark Miasma, which lasts for #.SArg1#s and can be stacked up to #.SArg3# times.
11.ShortDescription: Scarlet unleashes a torrent of dark energy that strikes #.SArg0# times. Each strike deals damage to a random enemy and inflicts them with 1 stack of Dark Miasma, which lasts for #.SArg1#s and can be stacked up to #.SArg3# times.

20.Description: When an enemy has at least 1 stack of Dark Miasma, each stack reduces their damage dealt by #.SArg1.Per#. Enemies with #.SArg0# stacks of Dark Miasma enter a state of Shaded Corruption. Enemies affected by Shaded Corruption cannot move or use skills, and lose #.SArg2# Energy every second.
20.ShortDescription: When an enemy is affected by Dark Miasma, each stack reduces their damage dealt. Enemies with #.SArg0# stacks of Dark Miasma enter a state of Shaded Corruption. Enemies affected by Shaded Corruption cannot move or use skills, and lose Energy every second.

41.Description: When a target on the battlefield has lower than #.SArg0.Per# health, Scarlet creates a Dark Aura underneath the area with the highest concentration of enemies. She then teleports the target into the center of the aura and detonates them. The target and all enemies within the Dark Aura are dealt damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of Scarlet's Attack Rating. This effect can only be triggered once every #.SArg1#s.
41.ShortDescription: When there's a target with low health on the battlefield, Scarlet creates a Dark Aura underneath the area with the highest concentration of enemies. She then teleports the target into the center of the Dark Aura and detonates them, dealing damage to the target and all enemies within the Dark Aura. This effect can only be triggered once every #.SArg1#s.

81.Description: Enemies struck by Scarlet's Ultimate skill carry residual dark energy that randomly explodes within #.SArg0#s. All enemies within range of the explosion are dealt damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of Scarlet's Attack Rating.
81.ShortDescription: Enemies struck by Scarlet's Ultimate skill carry residual dark energy that randomly explodes within #.SArg0#s and deals damage to all enemies within range of the explosion.

11.Description: Anasta shatters nearby enemies' shields and deals 2 strikes of #.PlusRatio.Per# Attack Rating damage to them, then knocks down all enemies in front of her and deals another strike of damage equal to #.SArg0.Per# of Attack Rating to them. If Anasta hits her current dueling target, the duel duration will be increased by #.SArg1#s.
11.ShortDescription: Shatters nearby enemies' shields and deals 2 strikes of damage to them, then knocks down all enemies in front of Anasta and deals another strike of damage to them. If Anasta hits her current dueling target, the duel duration will be increased by #.SArg1#s.

20.Description: Anasta deals damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of Attack Rating to all enemies in front of her and reduces their shield values by #.SArg0.Per# for #.SArg1#s. If there are #.SArg2# or fewer targets within attack range, the damage is increased to #.SArg3.Per# of Attack Rating and the shield value reduction is increased to #.SArg4.Per#.
20.ShortDescription: Deals damage to all enemies in front of Anasta and reduces their shield values for #.SArg1#s. If there are #.SArg2# or fewer targets within attack range, the damage and shield value reduction are both increased.

31.Description: Anasta initiates a duel with the nearest enemy, immobilizing them for #.SArg1#s, while terrifying other nearby enemies for #.SArg0#s. For the duration of the duel, Anasta prioritizes attacking the dueling target, gains immunity to taunts, and her skills deal extra damage equal to #.SArg2.Per# of the enemy's max health, but not to exceed #.SArg3.Per# of Anasta's Attack Rating.
31.ShortDescription: Initiates a duel with the nearest enemy, immobilizing them for #.SArg1#s, while terrifying other nearby enemies #.SArg0#s. For the duration of the duel, Anasta prioritizes attacking the dueling target, gains immunity to taunts, and her skills deal extra damage based on the enemy's max health.

41.Description: Anasta gains #.SArg1# stacks of Brawler's Protection, with each stack reducing her damage taken by #.SArg2.Per# and increasing her damage dealt by #.SArg6.Per# for #.SArg0#s. This effect can be stacked up to #.SArg1# times. When Anasta takes damage exceeding #.SArg3.Per# of her max health from her current dueling target, she loses 1 stack of Brawler's Protection and launches a counterattack, dealing damage equal to #.SArg4.Per# of Attack Rating to all nearby enemies.
41.ShortDescription: Anasta gains #.SArg1# stacks of Brawler's Protection, with each stack granting Damage Reduction and increasing damage dealt. This effect lasts for #.SArg0#s. When Anasta takes significant damage from her current dueling target, she loses 1 stack of Brawler's Protection and launches a counterattack that deals AoE damage.

11.Description: The Cindercrow Specter summons crows to attack all enemies, dealing damage and knocking them back. Enemy units hit will take #.SArg0# stack of Cursecrow Marks, and if the unit is knocked back successfully, they'll take #.SArg1# extra stacks. Each stack of Cursecrow Mark reduces the affected enemy unit's Attack Rating by #.SArg2.Per#. Cursecrow Marks cannot be dispelled, but #.SArg4# stack will be removed for every #.SArg3# strikes of normal attack damage landed.

21.Description: The Cindercrow Specter creates rice-fields that begin to grow. Enemy units that wander into a field will be unable to inflict magic damage or health loss. The fields mature after growing for #.SArg0#s, and the Cindercrow Specter summons a phantom to harvest it, dealing damage to enemy units in range. Units hit will also take #.SArg2.Per# increased damage for #.SArg1#s, and summons within a field will be instantly slain.

31.Description:
The Cindercrow Specter summons an inferno, dealing damage to all enemies. When the inferno hits a unit affected by Cursecrow Marks, it will inflict extra effects based on the number of stacks:
#.SArg0# Stacks: Dispels most of the unit's attribute buffs and prevents their attributes from being increased for #.SArg1#s.
#.SArg2# Stacks: The unit will be unable to gain Energy for #.SArg3#s.
#.SArg4# Stacks: The unit will be imprisoned in a Cremation Cage and instantly slain.

11.Description: The Cindercrow Specter summons crows to attack all enemies, dealing damage and knocking them back. Enemy units hit will take #.SArg0# stack of Cursecrow Marks, and if the unit is knocked back successfully, they'll take #.SArg1# extra stacks. Each stack of Cursecrow Mark reduces the affected enemy unit's Attack Rating by #.SArg2.Per#. Cursecrow Marks cannot be dispelled, but #.SArg4# stack will be removed for every #.SArg3# strikes of normal attack damage landed.

21.Description: The Cindercrow Specter creates rice-fields that begin to grow. Enemy units that wander into a field will be unable to inflict magic damage or health loss. The fields mature after growing for #.SArg0#s, and the Cindercrow Specter summons a phantom to harvest it, dealing damage to enemy units in range. Units hit will also take #.SArg2.Per# increased damage for #.SArg1#s, and summons within a field will be instantly slain.

11.Description: #.SArg4#s after the start of battle, Khazard damages all enemies for #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating and envelops the battlefield in a frozen mist for #.SArg0#s. While the frozen mist is present, enemies will take damage for #.SArg3.Per# of Khazard's Attack Rating every second and enemies under #.SArg2.Per# health will become frozen until they are able to recover to #.SArg2.Per# of their health or the mist disappears. Once the frozen mist has dissipated, damage taken by Khazard is increased by #.SArg6.Per# every #.SArg5#s.

20.Description: Khazard fires #.SArg0# "Glacial Shards" in multiple directions. Each glacial shard deals #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to the enemies which are struck, also causing them to lose #.SArg3# Haste points for #.SArg2#s. Any enemies that are struck by multiple ice shards will be dealt #.SArg1.Per# less damage by subsequent shards after the second glacial shard.

31.Description: Khazard fires an icy beam at an enemy which deals #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to them and causes them to become frozen for #.SArg0#s.

41.Description: While there is "Frozen Mist" present on the battlefield, Khazard's "Frost Serpent" attacks an enemy with its ice breath, dealing #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to them, causing them to become frozen for #.SArg0#s.

11.Description: Demonic Nemora cannot be attacked. Instead, she will summon #.SArg0# Dreafs in Spirit form to fight for her. Dreafs are considered to be boss units, and all direct damage dealt to Dreafs in Spirit form will be reduced to #.SArg1#. As the battle progresses, her Dreafs will exit Spirit form in order of their formation positions. The death of a Dreaf will cause the next Dreaf to exit Spirit Form sooner.

20.Description: This skill is used on all Dreafs to reduce damage taken by them by #.SArg1.Per# and increase their health loss by #.SArg0.Per#. This effect lasts for #.SArg2#s and cannot be stacked.

31.Description: Demonic Nemora slowly corrodes enemy heroes, causing them to lose health equal to #.SArg0.Per# of their max health and #.SArg1# Energy. Her Dreafs will also use this skill on enemy heroes positioned directly opposite from them.

11.Description: Ice Shemira blankets the battlefield in a Blizzard that prevents enemies from recovering health and periodically deals damage to them. Using this skill again will upgrade the Blizzard, increasing its damage and adding a knockback effect.

21.Description: Shemira prioritizes her attack against two frontline enemies, dealing multiple instances of damage against them, also causing them to become slowed down. Shemira then unleashes a "Frost Nova" that deals damage to all enemies on the battlefield, freezing any enemies that have health lower than #.SArg1.Per#.

41.Description: Whenever Ice Shemira uses the Blizzard skill, she will gain a frozen armor that negates all physical damage for #.SArg0#s.

11.Description: Kane orders the dragon to breathe out flames, dealing massive damage to all enemies within range.

31.Description: Used once every #.SArg0#s after the battle starts. The enemy who has dealt the lowest total damage will gain #.SArg3.Per# Attack Rating, lose #.SArg4.Per# Defense Rating, and take damage over time. This skill can only be used #.SArg1# times and cannot be used multiple times against a single target.

41.Description: Deals damage to all enemies twice. The first hit destroys all shields of enemies hit.

11.Description: When the Burning Brute's health drops to #.SArg0.Per# and #.SArg1.Per#, it dozes off for #.SArg2#s. After the Brute awakens from its first daze, it gains a new attack: damaging enemies behind it with a powerful smash. After awakening from its second daze, its frontal attacks become more powerful.

21.Description: The Brute breathes fire on his enemies, inflicting damage upon them. After the Brute awakens from its slumber for the first time, it acquires a new attack method that causes fire to erupt from below its enemies' feet, dealing damage to them and AoE damage to any other enemies surrounding the original enemy target.

31.Description: The Burning Brute creates a barrier to protect itself. Whenever an enemy outside the barrier attacks the Brute, the damage is reduced by #.SArg0.Per# and the Brute gains a temporary bonus to its Defense Rating. When the Brute dozes off, the barrier will shatter and be temporarily disabled. The barrier shattering will damage all enemies for a portion of the Brute's Attack Rating.

11.Description: Normal Attacks shoot a bolt of lightning, which ignores summoned entities and strikes an enemy target, after which it is rebounded onto the next target according to the enemy formation's order. Lightning bolts will end after reaching a maximum distance, or after they are rebounded #.SArg0# times. When a target is hit by the lightning, their Attack Rating will be reduced by #.SArg1.Per# for #.SArg2#s. The Attack Rating debuff is calculated separately each time a target is hit by lightning. If only one enemy remains, a single high-power lightning bolt shall be shot, dealing a high amount of damage, simultaneously reducing the target's Attack Rating by #.SArg3.Per#.

21.Description: Whenever a phantom is summoned, it locks onto and attacks the enemy hero that has dealt the most damage. It is immune to damage from enemies other than its target. A hero that has been locked onto cannot use their Ultimate skill.

31.Description: Damages all enemies and summons a phantom. The phantom removes most buffs from enemies and transfers any attribute bonuses from those buffs to itself. There can be up to #.SArg0# phantoms on the battlefield at a time. Damage dealt to the phantoms does not count towards the total damage dealt.

21.Description: The Dune Destroyer attacks #.SArg0# enemies, prioritizing front row targets. If the targets have shields, this attack destroys the shields. If not, the targets will be crystallized for #.SArg1#s (undispellable). Crystallized targets cannot take any action. The duration is reduced by #.SArg2#s each time they gain a shield.

31.Description: The Dune Destroyer attacks all enemies, preventing struck enemies from regaining health for #.SArg1#s (undispellable). Crystal Burst will be enhanced every #.SArg0# time, increasing the damage and the healing penalty duration to #.SArg2#s.

41.Description: The Dune Destroyer's body is covered with crystallized skin, granting it a high Defense Rating and Damage Reduction. Enemies without a shield that are attacked by the Dune Destroyer lose #.SArg0.Per# of their max health every #.SArg2#s for the next #.SArg1#s.

11.Description:
The Fire Daemon has protected itself with various pieces of armor, granting it a high Defense Rating.

Spectral Hands: Damage received from behind is reduced by #.SArg0.Per#.
Horn: Damage received from the front is reduced by #.SArg1.Per#.
Arm Guards: The Fire Daemon recovers significant health every second.

When a piece of armor is destroyed, the effects it grants will also disappear.

21.Description:
The Fire Daemon strikes the farthest enemy hero with its hammer, damaging them for #.PlusRatio.Per# of its Attack Rating. If there are other enemy heroes near the target, the damage will be split between them. If there are no other enemy heroes near the target, they will be knocked down.

After the Fire Daemon has taken enough damage from its front, its Arm Guards will be destroyed and the damage dealt by this skill will be greatly reduced.

31.Description:
The Fire Daemon fires a massive beam of light. The beam damages all enemies in front of it #.SArg0# times for up to #.PlusRatio.Per# of its Attack Rating per hit and interrupts the targets' actions. The beam deals less damage the farther away a target is. Additionally, the beam leaves flames that will continue to burn the enemies.

After the Fire Daemon has taken enough damage from behind, its Horn will be destroyed and the attack range of this skill will be greatly reduced.

41.Description: After the Fire Daemon has taken enough damage, it will summon a Spectral Fist to strike the hero with the highest current health and keep them knocked down. Spectral Fists can be attacked and destroyed. After the Fire Daemon's Spectral Hands have been destroyed, it can no longer use this skill.

11.Description: Thesku plays his bone flute, damaging all enemies and petrifying nearby enemies for #.SArg0#s. Petrified enemies cannot take any actions or recover Energy. Enemies who are not petrified will instead lose #.SArg1# points of Haste for #.SArg2#s.

20.Description: Thesku's pet snake Zilsu spits a deadly neurotoxin at an enemy, damaging them and intoxicating them. While intoxicated, an enemy cannot recover Energy, can only use normal attacks, and deals #.SArg1.Per# extra normal attack damage for #.SArg0# seconds. Intoxication cannot stack or be dispelled. Neurotoxicity will prioritize the enemy hero who has dealt the most total damage and is not already intoxicated.

41.Description: Thesku's pet snakes Zilsu and Szetzu breathe a Cursed Flame, damaging all enemies in front of them #.SArg3# times. Damaged enemies lose #.SArg1# points of Accuracy and #.SArg2# points of Magic Efficiency for #.SArg0#s. This effect cannot stack.

11.Description: Treznor spins his spear around, damaging all nearby enemies, knocking them down, and removing any shields they have.

20.Description: Treznor charges towards an enemy, damaging all enemies in his path and stunning them for #.SArg1#s. Treznor then stops behind the target enemy, damaging them and destroying any shields they have. Death Charge will prioritize the enemy hero furthest away from Treznor.

31.Description: Treznor faces the direction with the most targetable enemies then swings his spear, damaging all enemies in front of him and preventing them from receiving healing for #.SArg0#s.

11.Description: Sonja grants herself #.SArg0# Gold Roses. Whenever Sonja takes damage, each Gold Rose she has will cause the attacker to lose health. Sonja loses 1 Gold Rose every #.SArg1#s.

31.Description: Sonja plants a Black Rose near the most injured enemy hero. The Black Rose damages nearby enemy heroes 3 times. Sonja also gains a shield that negates incoming damage up to #.SArg2# times and lasts for #.SArg1#s.

41.Description: Sonja grants #.SArg0# enemy heroes Red Roses, which causes them to lose health equal to #.SArg2.Per# of their max health every second for #.SArg1#s. Sonja then takes back her Red Roses, damaging all targets. This skill prioritizes enemy heroes with the lowest health.

11.Description: Mezoth imprisons an enemy, preventing them from taking any actions for #.SArg0#s. While imprisoned, the target loses health equal to #.SArg1.Per# of their max health and #.SArg2# Energy every second. This skill prioritizes the enemy hero that has dealt the lowest total damage. Every time Devour is used, Mezoth's Defense increases and the damage he takes from defense-ignoring attacks is reduced. This effect can stack #.SArg5# times.

20.Description: Mezoth attempts to knock down an enemy target. If he succeeds, he damages the target multiple times, with the final attack dealing extra damage.

31.Description: Mezoth damage all enemies in front of him. Damaged enemies lose #.SArg0# points of Haste for #.SArg1#s. Mezoth also gains a shield that can negate damage up to #.SArg2# times and lasts for #.SArg3#s.

21.Description: The Brute breathes fire out of its mouth, inflicting damage on its enemies. Once the Brute awakens from its "Doze" state it receives a new type of skill that causes the ground below its enemies' feet to burn, dealing AoE damage to them.

11.Description: When used passively, a singular lightning bolt is cast upon a random enemy every #.SArg0#s. When used actively, #.SArg1# bolts will be cast successively on multiple enemies. Enemies that are struck by lightning bolts will lose the majority of buffs from which they are currently benefiting.

When Duskwailer uses a skill other than her Normal Attack in the absence of an oathbearer, she will select an enemy hero to be the oathbearer, prioritizing the hero in the center of the back line, followed by the hero with the highest Attack Rating. The oathbearer's Attack Rating is increased by #.SArg1.Per# and their Tenacity is increased gradually over time.

When the number of targetable enemy heroes on the battlefield is greater than or equal to #.SArg3#, the Normal Attack of Duskwailer will not target and deal damage to the oathbearer.

21.Description:
Duskwailer dances with her sword, dealing damage #.SArg1# times to surrounding enemies.

When the number of targetable enemy heroes on the battlefield is greater than or equal to #.SArg0#, "Dancing Shadows" will not target and deal damage to the oathbearer.

31.Description:
Duskwailer appears on the right of the battlefield, then moves toward the oathbearer's phantom on the left of the battlefield, holding a bouquet of flowers. Each time she takes damage equal to #.SArg0.Per# of her max health when she starts moving, is about to move toward the oathbearer's phantom, or during her movement, she charms the oathbearer.

If the oathbearer's Tenacity is strong enough to resist Duskwailer's charm, she stops moving and enters a sorrowful state for #.SArg5#s. Damage received while in a sorrowful state is increased by #.SArg4.Per#. If Duskwailer has moved to the front of the oathbearer's phantom, damage she receives in the next #.SArg7#s is reduced by #.SArg6.Per#.

41.Description:
Duskwailer's resentment clumps into a cloudy mist, terrifying all enemies except the oathbearer. She then performs her sword dance, dealing damage to nearby enemies. She also receives a shield worth #.SArg0.Per# of her max health, which lasts until the end of her sword dance. While the shield is active, damage received by her from the oathbearer and from other enemies is increased by #.SArg1.Per# and reduced by #.SArg2.Per# respectively.

If the shield is broken while active, all enemies are immediately released from their terrify effects and their Energy is fully replenished. Meanwhile, Duskwailer enters a sorrowful state for #.SArg4#s, during which the damage she takes is increased by #.SArg3.Per#.

11.Description: The Mask Curator deals damage #.SArg0# times to an enemy with his Normal Attack. When his health is below #.SArg2.Per#, he deals damage #.SArg0# times to #.SArg3# enemies simultaneously with his Normal Attack.

21.Description: The Mask Curator deals damage to enemies around #.SArg0# fixed locations. If he wields Volatile Torrent when his health is below #.SArg2.Per#, he casts spells continuously dealing damage #.SArg3# times to all enemies, then enters a brief feeble state during which he cannot attack. While the Mask Curator is casting spells continuously or is in a feeble state, the damage he receives and his health loss are increased by #.SArg5.Per#.

31.Description: The Mask Curator absorbs an enemy's power, dealing damage to them while reducing their Attack Rating by #.SArg0.Per# and Energy Recovery Rate by #.SArg1.Per#, for #.SArg2#s. If he uses Soul Taker when his health is below #.SArg3.Per#, the Mask Curator absorbs the power of all enemies.

41.Description:
At the start of battle, magic damage received by the Mask Curator is reduced by #.SArg0.Per#. When his health falls below #.SArg1.Per#, #.SArg3.Per#, and #.SArg5.Per# for the first time, he will switch personalities and change the Damage Reduction effects as follows:

Physical damage received is reduced by #.SArg2.Per#;
Physical damage and magic damage received is reduced by #.SArg4.Per#.
Damage received that ignores enemy Defense is reduced by #.SArg6.Per#.

After switching personalities, the Mask Curator is briefly immune to damage and replenishes the Energy of all enemy heroes and removes all debuffs inflicted by Soul Taker.

101.Description: Active: The Soul Hound attacks the farthest #.SArg0# enemy heroes, dealing damage to each of them. Passive: Each time a Whistle Bearer deals damage with their Ultimate, the Soul Hound is tamed and the damage it receives is increased by #.SArg1.Per#. This effect can trigger once every #.SArg2# seconds. After being tamed for #.SArg3# stacks, the Soul Hound is fully tamed, damage it receives is further increased, and it no longer uses this skill actively.

21.Description: Passive: After the battle starts, the Soul Hound can be controlled under the first control effect received. While this control effect is active, damage taken by the Soul Hound increases over time. Additionally, the hero that inflicts this control effect becomes a Whistle Bearer, permanently increasing the damage they deal to the Soul Hound by #.SArg1.Per#.

31.Description: The Soul Hound swings its staff and casts a spell, attacking and dealing damage to all enemies. Then it teleports surrounding enemies to the enemy's backline. For every enemy teleported away, the number of stacks the Soul Hound is tamed for is reduced by #.SArg0#.

41.Description: The Soul Hound wields its dagger, counterattacking and dealing damage to the Whistle Bearer via a portal, while terrifying them for #.SArg0# seconds. While the Whistle Bearer is terrified, they are also unable to use their Ultimate skill for #.SArg1# seconds, and the number of stacks the Soul Hound is tamed for is reduced by #.SArg2#.

11.Description:
Demonic Puppet's Vitality cannot be reduced and he will summon Skeletal Spirits, which live and die with him. Skeletal Spirits cannot be targeted and are immune to damage.
After a battle starts, the Skeletal Spirits are awakened, restoring Demonic Puppet's health for #.SArg2.Per# of his max health every #.SArg1#s, up to #.SArg3#s. At the end of the duration, the Skeletal Spirits hibernate for #.SArg4#s. Thereafter, they will enter a cycle of periodic awakening and hibernating.

21.Description:
When the Skeletal Spirits are awakened, direct damage and health loss suffered by Demonic Puppet are reduced by #.SArg3.Per#, and he is immune to healing restrictions for #.SArg0# times. The buff remains effective until Demonic Puppet has suffered healing restrictions #.SArg0# times or enters hibernation mode.
When Demonic Puppet suffers healing restrictions, his Skeletal Spirits' next hibernation is extended by #.SArg1#s. If the Skeletal Spirits are already in hibernation, their current hibernation is extended by #.SArg1#s, up to #.SArg2#s.

31.Description: Demonic Puppet augments his arm and sweeps the battlefield, dealing damage to all enemies. If the target is a Hypogean, they deal health loss and healing restrictions equaling #.SArg0.Per# of their Attack Rating to Demonic Puppet.

41.Description: Demonic Puppet brandishes his scissors, inflicting ferocious slashes to deal damage to all enemies.

11.Description: Ezizh produces a Nightmare Shockwave that deals damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating to all enemies, rendering their Ultimate skills unusable for #.SArg1#s. The shockwave causes the battlefield to be transformed into a hellish nightmare for #.SArg0#s. Ezizh is unable to recover Energy while the battlefield is transformed into a hellish nightmare, but he will produce a Nightmare Shockwave once every #.SArg2#s.
11.ShortDescription: Ezizh produces a Nightmare Shockwave that deals damage to all enemies, rendering their Ultimate unusable for #.SArg1#s. The shockwave causes the battlefield to be transformed into a hellish nightmare for #.SArg0#s. Ezizh is unable to recover Energy while the battlefield is transformed into a hellish nightmare, but he will produce a Nightmare Shockwave once every #.SArg2#s.

12.UpgradeDescription: Ezizh gains #.SArg3# Haste points for every enemy that is in a state of insanity while the battlefield is transformed into a hellish nightmare.
12.ShortUpgradeDescription: Increases Haste for every enemy that is in a state of insanity while the battlefield is transformed into a hellish nightmare.

13.UpgradeDescription: Ezizh produces an additional Nightmare Shockwave each time an ally uses their Ultimate skill while the battlefield is transformed into a hellish nightmare. Effect can be triggered up to #.SArg4# times.
13.ShortUpgradeDescription: Ezizh produces an additional Nightmare Shockwave each time an ally uses their ultimate skill while the battlefield is transformed into a hellish nightmare.

20.Description: At the start of battles, Ezizh causes the enemy mirroring his own position to fall into a nightmare state, up until they receive damage equal to #.SArg0.Per# of their max health, or #.SArg1#s have passed.
20.ShortDescription: At the start of battles, Ezizh causes the enemy mirroring his own position to fall into a nightmare state, up until they have accumulated greater damage received or #.SArg1#s have passed.

21.UpgradeDescription: Passive. When Ezizh suffers from a control effect, the damage he receives over the following #.SArg2#s is reduced by #.SArg3.Per#.
21.ShortUpgradeDescription: Passive. Reduces the damage received over the next #.SArg2#s when suffering from a control effect.

22.UpgradeDescription: Passive. When Ezizh suffers from a control effect, the damage he receives over the following #.SArg2#s is reduced by #.SArg3.Per#.
22.ShortUpgradeDescription: Damage Reduction is increased.

23.UpgradeDescription: After resisting a control effect due to Tenacity or Immunity, the same effect stated above shall occur, but with a #.SArg6.Per# reduced duration.
23.ShortUpgradeDescription: After resisting a control effect due to Tenacity or Immunity, the same effect stated above shall occur, but with a #.SArg6.Per# reduced duration.

24.UpgradeDescription: When Ezizh suffers from a control effect, the source of the effect is put into a nightmare state up until they receive damage equal to #.SArg4.Per# of their max health, or #.SArg7#s have passed. This effect may only be triggered once every #.SArg5#s.
24.ShortUpgradeDescription: When Ezizh suffers from a control effect, the source of the effect is put into a nightmare state up until they have accumulated greater damage received or #.SArg5#s have passed.

31.Description: Ezizh uses an abyssal tentacle to deal AoE damage to enemies that equals #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating and also drains their sanity, forcing them into a state of insanity for #.SArg0#s. All enemies that are insane lose #.SArg1# Tenacity points, and all allied heroes gain #.SArg2# Tenacity points.
31.ShortDescription: Ezizh uses an abyssal tentacle to deal AoE damage to enemies and drain their sanity, forcing them into a state of insanity for #.SArg0#s. All enemies that are in a state of insanity will have their Tenacity reduced while increasing the Tenacity of all allied heroes.

32.UpgradeDescription: Enemies that are currently in a state of insanity are additionally terrified for #.SArg6#s if their sanity is drained again.
32.ShortUpgradeDescription: Enemies that are currently in a state of insanity are additionally terrified for #.SArg6#s if their sanity is drained again.

33.UpgradeDescription: If an enemy is in a state of insanity when they are dealt damage from Ezizh, the following damage dealt to them from Ezizh is increased by #.SArg4.Per# per attack, up until #.SArg5.Per# is reached. The stacked damage bonus shall be reset when the insanity effect wears off.
33.ShortUpgradeDescription: If an enemy is in a state of insanity when they receive damage from Ezizh, the subsequent damage they receive from Ezizh will be increased. The stacked damage bonus shall be reset when the insanity effect wears off.

41.Description: Ezizh focuses nightmare energy and unleashes it on an enemy target, dealing damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating to them, also stunning them for #.SArg0#s. If the enemy target is successfully stunned, the effects of the nightmare energy are transferred to a new enemy target, who will suffer the same damage and effects as before. The energy transfer effect will continue targeting new enemies up until an enemy resists the attack, or the energy is successfully transferred #.SArg1# times. If this skill is used when the battlefield has been transformed into a hellish nightmare, the nightmare energy will always be transferred the maximum number of times.
41.ShortDescription: Ezizh focuses nightmare energy and unleashes it on the enemy target, dealing damage and stunning the target for #.SArg0#s. If the enemy target is successfully stunned, the effects of the nightmare energy will be transferred to a new enemy target, who will suffer the same damage and effects as before.

42.UpgradeDescription: Enemy targets also lose #.SArg2# Energy points when stunned.
42.ShortUpgradeDescription: Enemy targets also lose #.SArg2# Energy points when stunned.

43.UpgradeDescription: Each time nightmare energy is transferred to a target in a state of insanity, the damage caused by following energy transfers is increased by #.SArg3.Per# of Ezizh's Attack Rating, and will also cause enemy targets to enter a state of insanity.
43.ShortUpgradeDescription: Each time nightmare energy is transferred to a target in a state of insanity, the subsequent energy transfers will deal greater damage and cause the enemy target to enter a state of insanity.

51.Description: After every #.SArg0#s of battle, Ezizh enters a dream state that allows him to become immune to all damage and control effects for #.SArg1#s. While in a dream state, Ezizh is able to normally cast his skills and he gains #.SArg2# Haste points, while his damage is increased by #.SArg3.Per#. Each time Ezizh enters a dream state, the amount of time needed to enter it again is increased by #.SArg4#s, and the amount of time he stays in a dream state is decreased by #.SArg5#s, but will be no fewer than #.SArg6#s. Each time an allied hero successfully resists control effects due to their Tenacity, the amount of time needed for Ezizh to enter a dream state again is reduced by #.SArg7#s.
51.ShortDescription: After every #.SArg0# seconds of the battle, Ezizh enters a dream state that allows him to become immune to all damages and control effects for #.SArg1# seconds. While in a dream state, Ezizh can normally cast his skills and gain Haste while his damage is increased. Each time Ezizh enters a dream state, the time required to enter it again will be increased, and the time he stays in it will be decreased. Each time an allied hero successfully resists control effects due to their Tenacity, the time required for Ezizh to enter a dream state again will be decreased.

21.Description:
The Light Martyr selects the enemy hero positioned at the forefront as her execution target. She pulls the target before her and makes them unable to move or use skills, while also making them lose health every second, for #.SArg0#s. During an execution, the Light Martyr takes damage equal to #.SArg3.Per# of the healing received by the target.
Passive. Damage and health loss dealt to the Light Martyr by other means are reduced by #.SArg4.Per#.

31.Description: At the start of a battle, the Light Martyr casts a cursed mist over the battlefield for #.SArg0#s. When the mist exists, enemies within the cursed mist suffer damage each second. If the health percentage of an enemy is lower than #.SArg1.Per# when damage is dealt, their Energy is deducted by #.SArg2# points. Any summoned entity receiving damage from the mist is instantly killed.

41.Description: The Light Martyr focuses her energy continuously, then fires raining blades to deal high damage to enemies within a certain range in front. Each time the Light Martyr is attacked while focusing her energy, damage dealt by the raining blades is reduced. Once she is attacked #.SArg2# times, the Light Martyr is interrupted in her energy focusing and becomes vulnerable for #.SArg4#s. When in a vulnerable state, damage taken by the Light Martyr that is converted from the healing received by the executed target is increased by #.SArg3.Per#. When energy focusing starts, the higher the executed target's health percentage, the longer the focusing takes, up to #.SArg0#s.

11.Description:
The Sky Serpent flaps its wings and forms multiple cyclones in the battlefield dealing damage to enemies within range multiple times. Meanwhile, damage dealt by attacked enemies is reduced by #.SArg1.Per# for #.SArg0#s. If the attacked target has a shield, they are immune to the damage reduction effect.
Pseudo-Dragon Form:
During a battle, the Sky Serpent slowly consumes its mimicry value to stay in Dragon form. Once its mimicry value is exhausted, it is forced to remove its disguise and reveal its beast form.

21.Description:
The Sky Serpent chants Dragon Speak for #.SArg1#s. After finishing the chant, it channels several thunderbolts to the battlefield, dealing massive damage to all enemies. If an attacked target has a shield, some of the damage is deflected back onto the Sky Serpent, causing it health loss.
Passive:
A cyclone that isolates enemies spins under the Sky Serpent, rendering enemies unable to approach and massively reducing their melee damage received. While Dragon Speak is being chanted, the cyclone disappears briefly. During the chant, the Sky Serpent loses an additional #.SArg3.Per# mimicry value per second for each ranged attack dealt to it by a hero.

51.Description:
The Sky Serpent flaps its degenerate wings, shooting feather blades to damage one target while knocking them back mildly. If the target is using their normal attack while being hit, the attack is interrupted. If the target has a shield, they are immune to knockback and interrupting effects.
Owl Beast Form:
The Sky Serpent is forced to reveal its original form, massively increasing damage it receives. The beast in its raw form is exasperated, switching its attack target every certain duration. After each target change, it further boosts its Haste until the effect disappears upon the next target change.

41.Description: After focusing briefly, the Sky Serpent charges to the other side of the battlefield, dealing substantial damage to all enemies and stunning them for #.SArg0#s. If an attacked target has a shield, some of the damage is deflected back onto the Sky Serpent, causing it health loss, and the target is immune to the stunning effect.

11.Description:
Fane uses chains to restrict the enemy with the highest Attack Rating. During the following #.SArg0#s the restricted enemy loses health equal to #.SArg1.Per# of Fane's Attack Rating every second and cannot move or use skills. If the control effect prematurely ends, the enemy will be immediately dealt damage one time that is equal to #.SArg2.Per# of Fane's Attack Rating which ignores all of the enemy's Defense. If a Bone Prison exists on the battlefield, its duration will be extended by #.SArg3#s.

Fane cannot be controlled, and increases his Dissolve by #.SArg5# points in the next #.SArg4#s when receiving a control effect.

20.Description: Fane summons a Bone Prison on the enemy side of the battlefield that exists for #.SArg0#s. Enemies that leave the Bone Prison lose #.SArg1.Per# of their max health every second, but shall not lose more than #.SArg2.Per# of Fane's Attack Rating. Enemies within the Bone Prison have their Energy Recovery reduced by #.SArg3.Per#.

31.Description: An enemy outside of the Bone Prison is pulled inside of it and dealt damage equal to #.SArg0.Per# of their max health, and cannot move for #.SArg1#s. Damage dealt to the enemy cannot exceed #.SArg2.Per# of Fane's Attack Rating.

41.Description: Gigantic rolling logs hurtle towards enemies within the Bone Prison. While rolling, logs deal #.SArg0.Per# of Fane's Attack Rating as damage and knock back enemies. Can only deal damage to the same target up to #.SArg3# times.

11.Description: Gorvo roars angrily, dealing #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to all enemies. Gorvo's roar is able to taunt enemies within a certain radius into targeting him with normal attacks for #.SArg0#s. Gorvo is also able to deflect #.SArg1.Per# of the damage he receives back at his enemies while this skill is active.

20.Description:
Gorvo assails his enemies by leaping into the air and dive bombing into their midst, inflicting AoE damage equaling #.PlusRatio.Per# Attack Rating, the skill also leaves enemies stunned for #.SArg0#s. Gorvo cannot be targeted while using this skill.

Gorvo cannot be controlled, and when this skill hits #.SArg1# or more enemies, damage he receives in the next #.SArg2#s is reduced by #.SArg3.Per#, otherwise such damage is increased by #.SArg3.Per#.

31.Description: Gorvo charges his war hammer up every #.SArg1#s, causing the following attack to become a critical strike that deals AoE damage to nearby enemies, leaving them stunned for #.SArg0#s.

41.Description: After entering the battlefield Gorvo casts a shield around himself that is equal to #.SArg0.Per# of his maximum health which lasts for #.SArg1#s. The shield is also activated every time Gorvo uses his ultimate skill.

11.Description:
Morrow summons an Eye of Evil that deals damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating #.SArg2# times to enemies within range. Enemies that are burned are unable to use their ultimate skills for #.SArg1#s.

Every #.SArg3# times an ultimate skill is used on the battlefield, both allies and enemies are immune to control effects for the next #.SArg4#s.

20.Description: Morrow summons a spider that cocoons an enemy, dealing #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to them in the process, also preventing them from moving for following #.SArg1#s.

31.Description: Morrow releases Korgas behind the enemy that has dealt the highest total amount of damage and deals #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to them, also manipulating them into attacking their own allies for #.SArg1# seconds. While the enemy target is being manipulated, they are unable to use their Ultimate skill and shall not be targeted by the skill "Binding Terror".

11.Description: Dreaf randomly casts out explosive seeds at multiple targets, dealing damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating while poisoning the hit targets when they explode. This skill also renders Dreaf immune to control effects for the rest of the battle.

21.Description: Dreaf increases deadly spines from the ground beneath his enemies that slows them down and deals #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to them.

0.Description: Dalax is capable of long and short-range normal attacks. When using long-range attacks, a piercing bone is fired at the farthest enemy. When using short-range attacks, Dalax smashes nearby enemies with his tail to deal damage.

21.Description: Dalax spits out a deadly poisonous mist, dealing damage and applying #.SArg0# stack(s) of Poison to all affected enemies. Poisoned enemies have their Vitality reduced by #.SArg1# points and are dealt a certain amount of damage every #.SArg2#s based on the number of stacks. This effect can be stacked up to #.SArg3# times. When a Poisoned enemy takes damage from the effect or dies, #.SArg5# stack(s) spread to the nearest allied unit. Poison can be dispelled. Receiving a shield from an ally removes #.SArg4# stack(s).

31.Description: Dalax continuously flaps his wings, firing #.SArg0# tainted fireballs each time at random enemies. If a tainted fireball strikes an enemy affected by Poison, they are dealt additional damage based on the number of stacks.

41.Description: Dalax first thrashes his tail, dealing damage and knocking back enemies. Dalax then smashes his tail into the ground, dealing AoE damage to enemies within a certain range and stunning them for #.SArg0# to #.SArg1#s. The more stacks of Poison the enemies have, the longer the stun duration.

0.Description:
Dalax is capable of long and short-range normal attacks.

Passive: Any damage dealt by Dalax adds #.SArg0# stack(s) of Poison. Poisoned enemies have their Vitality reduced by #.SArg1# points and are dealt a certain amount of damage every #.SArg2#s based on the number of stacks. This effect can be stacked up to #.SArg3# times. When a Poisoned enemy takes damage from the effect or dies, #.SArg5# stack(s) spread to the nearest allied unit. Poison can be dispelled. Receiving a shield from an ally removes #.SArg4# stack(s).

21.Description: Dalax roars, adding #.SArg0# layers of poison to the enemy with the highest Attack Rating. Afterwards, Dalax deals #.SArg1.Per# max health damage to the enemy with the most poison layers, but they will not die as a result.

31.Description: Dalax swoops over the battlefield, dealing damage to all enemies and leaving a path of tainted flames on the ground in his wake that lasts for #.SArg0#s. These flames deal damage to enemies standing upon them every #.SArg1#s. Dalax is untargetable while in flight.

41.Description: Dalax thrashes his tail around, dealing damage #.SArg0# times to enemies within range, knocking them back and stunning them for #.SArg1# to #.SArg2#s. The more stacks of Poison the enemies have, the longer the stun duration.

11.Description: Passive. Swamp Corruptor and its summoned entity possess a volatile core. At the start of a battle, the core of Swamp Corruptor is activated by the corrosive energy. Damage received by entities whose cores are activated is increased by #.SArg0.Per#, while those with inactivated cores have their received damage reduced by #.SArg1.Per#. Every #.SArg2#s, the corrosive energy moves to the next core.

21.Description: Swamp Corruptor attacks the enemy hero that is positioned furthest at the front, and decays them for #.SArg0#s. Heroes in a decay state are unable to restore their health and lose #.SArg1.Per# of their max health every second. A hero whose health is lower than #.SArg3.Per# at the end of their decay state will perish immediately. The death of every hero in a decay state will enhance the corrosive energy and reduce #.SArg2.Per# of the damage received by entities with activated cores.

31.Description: Swamp Corruptor inflicts damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of its Attack Rating on all enemies, and in the next #.SArg0#s, entities with activated cores cause all enemies to lose #.SArg1.Per# of their max health every second. If entities with activated cores are being controlled, the damage dealt will not be continuous.

11.Description: Marsha alternates between melee and ranged attacks. Her ranged attack uses magma that prioritizes the furthest target, dealing AoE damage at their location and applying Magma Mark on them for #.SArg0#s. When a target is afflicted with Magma Mark, their Attack Rating is reduced by by #.SArg3.Per#. Her melee attack deals multiple hits to enemies close around her.

21.Description: Marsha periodically releases #.SArg5# Magma Guards from her abdomen that inherit a percentage of her max health and #.SArg4.Per# of other stats. Magma Guards only use Normal Attacks and prioritize targets afflicted with Magma Marks. When a Magma Guard is killed by the enemy, Marsha additionally loses a percentage of her max health. After the battle has proceeded for a while, she will release Magma Guards faster, each time releasing #.SArg6# enraged Magma Guards that each additionally have a shield equal to a certain amount of Marsha's Attack Rating. Each Magma Guard exists up to #.SArg8#s.

31.Description: Marsha sprays several Magma bombs from her abdomen to attack all present heroes #.SArg3# times and creates a Magma area at the location of the target hero for #.SArg0#s. The Magma area damages enemies every second. Magma Guards within the Magma area gain #.SArg2# additional Haste points.

11.Description: The Mirror Demon transforms into a real mirror and a virtual mirror that battle together, with their attacks covering each half of the battlefield respectively. The real and virtual mirrors are immune to any damage from behind them.

21.Description: When the battle starts, the real mirror and virtual mirror receive substantial Physical Resist and Magic Resist respectively. These effects reduce slowly over time. When the cumulative Physical Damage received by the real mirror reaches a certain level, it wields both its arms and casts several slashes of blade aura forward, dealing damage #.SArg6# times and further stunning the hero directly opposite for #.SArg7#s. When the cumulative Magic Damage received by the virtual mirror reaches a certain level, it also uses the same skill.

31.Description: The Mirror Demon summons several targetable illusive mirrors in the battlefield, and turns its own mirrors around and becomes untargetable, while hiding its true identity in two of the illusive mirrors. By shattering the wrong illusive mirror, the attacker suffers health loss equal to #.SArg1.Per# of their max health. If the illusive mirror which the Mirror Demon is hiding in is shattered, all other illusive mirrors will shatter too. Then, the Mirror Demon will return to its original mirrors from the illusive mirrors, while dealing damage to all enemies in its paths.

41.Description: The Mirror Demon in one mirror reflects #.SArg0.Per# of the damage it receives to the hero positioned directly opposite the other mirror. When one mirror of the Mirror Demon is defeated, and the other mirror's health is higher than #.SArg2.Per#, then the defeated mirror will be revived at #.SArg4.Per# of health after a brief delay.

11.Description: Marsha alternates between melee and ranged attacks. Her ranged attack uses magma that prioritizes the furthest target, dealing AoE damage at their location and applying Magma Mark on them for #.SArg0#s. When a target is afflicted with Magma Mark, their Attack Rating is reduced by by #.SArg3.Per#. Her melee attack deals multiple hits to enemies close around her.

21.Description: Marsha periodically releases #.SArg5# Magma Guards from her abdomen that inherit a percentage of her max health and #.SArg4.Per# of other stats. Magma Guards only use normal attacks and prioritize targets afflicted with Magma Marks. When a Magma Guard is killed by the enemy, Marsha additionally loses a percentage of her max health.

31.Description: Marsha sprays several Magma bombs from her abdomen to attack all present heroes #.SArg3# times and creates a Magma area at the location of the target hero for #.SArg0#s. The Magma area damages enemies every second. Magma Guards within the Magma area gain #.SArg2# additional Haste points.

11.Description: Solhorn launches the Raging Cannon, dealing damage to all enemies on the battlefield and rendering them unable to use their Ultimate skills for #.SArg0#s. The recoil from the Raging Cannon also knocks nearby enemies into the air and deals damage to them, while enemies behind the Cannon receive more damage.

21.Description:
The Raging Cannon is operated by two brothers, Solhorn and Bihorn.
 
Solhorn is in charge of launching the Epic Cannon. He cannot be controlled or killed. For every #.SArg1# times he suffers control effects, he becomes terrified and misfires the Cannon at the next launch, additionally increasing its heat value by #.SArg0.Per#.
 
Bihorn is responsible for cooling down the Epic Cannon. He can be controlled but cannot be killed. When the Cannon's heat value exceeds #.SArg3.Per#, Bihorn cools it down and reduces its heat value. Bihorn is deemed the entity with the highest Attack Rating.

31.Description: Each time after launching, the Raging Cannon heats up, increasing its heat value by #.SArg3.Per#. For every #.SArg1.Per# increase in heat value, the damage dealt by the Cannon is boosted by #.SArg2.Per#. Each time the total physical damage the Cannon has received reaches #.SArg0.Per# of its Attack Rating, its heat value increases by #.SArg4.Per#.

301.Description:
When the heat value of the Raging Cannon reaches #.SArg0.Per#, it explodes immediately and loses significant health. Its heat value is then reduced to 0 and it enters the damaged state, where it is unable to fire and the damage it receives is increased by #.SArg2.Per#. After the explosion, the surrounding ground is ignited, dealing damage continuously to nearby enemies.
 
After the Raging Cannon explodes, Bihorn repairs it, during which it cannot be controlled. The repair completes in #.SArg1#s.

11.Description: Passive: Respen manifests a Wind Swallow every #.SArg0#s, which encircle himself up until #.SArg1# Swallows exist. Active: Using his Ultimate skill, Respen sends the enemy with the highest Attack Rating hurtling into the air, dealing #.SArg2.Per# damage to them, also stunning them for #.SArg3#s. All Wind Swallows manifested by Respen currently on the battlefield will then respectively deal an additional #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to the enemy.
11.ShortDescription: Respen manifests a Wind Swallow every #.SArg0#s to encircle himself. Respen uses his Ultimate to send the enemy with the highest Attack Rating hurtling into the air, dealing damage and stunning them for #.SArg3#s. Finally, he deals additional damage to the enemy based on the number of Wind Swallows that exist on the battlefield.

20.Description: Skill is only activated when a Wind Swallow is next to Respen. Respen commands a Wind Swallow to attack the nearest enemy, dealing #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to them. If the enemy is not already being encircled by a Swallow, the Swallow will encircle them until the end of battle. If the enemy is already being encircled by a Swallow, the Swallow's attack will stun the enemy for #.SArg2#s, and the Swallow will fly towards an enemy which is not being encircled, and encircle them.
20.ShortDescription: When there are Wind Swallows encircling Respen, he sends one of them to encircle and deal damage to the nearest enemy. The enemy will be stunned for #.SArg2#s if there's already a Wind Swallow encircling them.

31.Description: When an enemy is sent flying into the air, Respen manifests an additional Wind Swallow to attack them, dealing #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to them. After the attack, the Swallow will return to Respen's side. This skill can target the same enemy once every #.SArg0#s.
31.ShortDescription: Respen creates another Wind Swallow to attack the enemy if the unit is currently sent flying into the air.

11.Description: Skriath summons a sand vortex that appears in the center of the enemy formation which persists for #.SArg0#s. The vortex has an AoE radius which continuously pulls in enemies, dealing #.PlusRatio.Per# damage per second to all enemies that are trapped in its grasp.
11.ShortDescription: Skriath summons a sand vortex that appears in the center of the enemy formation. The vortex has an AoE radius that continuously pulls in enemies, dealing damage to all enemies that are trapped in its grasp.

20.Description: Skriath causes large rocks to fall upon an enemy target's head, dealing #.PlusRatio.Per# AoE damage to them and any nearby enemies.
20.ShortDescription: Skriath causes large rocks to fall upon the enemy's head, dealing damage to them.

31.Description: Skriath creates a "Sandstorm" which lasts for #.SArg0#s. The sandstorm reduces the Accuracy of all enemies by #.SArg1# points and Haste by #.SArg2# while they are standing within the sandstorm.
31.ShortDescription: Skriath creates Sandstorm, which lasts for #.SArg0#s. The Sandstorm reduces the Accuracy and Haste of all enemies within.

41.Description: Increases allies' Crit Ratings by #.SArg0# points per second until a maximum of #.SArg1# points are reached.
41.ShortDescription: Increases all allies' Crit Rating every second up to #.SArg1# during the battle.

11.Description: Zaphrael teleports to the edge of the battlefield that has the most enemies on it and fires #.SArg0# powerful bolts of lightning across the battlefield. Each bolt deals damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating to enemies it passes through.
11.ShortDescription: Zaphrael teleports to the edge of the battlefield that has the most enemies on it and fires #.SArg0# powerful bolts of lightning across the battlefield, dealing piercing damage.

20.Description: Zaphrael summons #.SArg4# thundercloud(s) that exist for #.SArg0#s which strike the nearest enemy target every #.SArg1#s, dealing damage equaling #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating to them and also stunning them briefly.
20.ShortDescription: Zaphrael summons #.SArg2# thundercloud(s) that exist for #.SArg0#s which strike the nearest enemy target every #.SArg1#s, dealing damage to them and stunning them briefly.

31.Description: Zaphrael teleports behind the enemy closest to the allied side and knocks them to the ground, damaging nearby enemies for #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating and gaining a shield that can absorb damage for #.SArg1.Per# of his Attack Rating for #.SArg0#s. Zaphrael uses melee normal attacks while the shield is active. When Zaphrael takes damage, the closer the attacker is to him, the greater his Resist is, which can reduce incoming damage by up to #.SArg2.Per#. When the shield wears off, Zaphrael teleports back to his original position.
31.ShortDescription: Zaphrael teleports behind the enemy closest to the allied side, knocking them down and damaging nearby enemies. He also gains a shield for #.SArg0#s. Zaphrael uses melee normal attacks while the shield is active. When the shield wears off, Zaphrael teleports back to his original position.

900.Description: Zaphrael teleports behind the enemy closest to the allied side and knocks them to the ground, damaging nearby enemies for #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating and gaining a shield that can absorb damage for #.SArg1.Per# of his Attack Rating for #.SArg0#s. Zaphrael uses melee normal attacks while the shield is active. When Zaphrael takes damage, the closer the attacker is to him, the greater his Resist is, which can reduce incoming damage by up to #.SArg2.Per#. When the shield wears off, Zaphrael teleports back to his original position.

41.Description: During battle, enemies damaged by Zaphrael will be electrified for #.SArg0#s. Electrified enemies have their Attack Rating and Defense Rating reduced by #.SArg3.Per# and #.SArg4.Per# respectively every second. When damage dealt to them exceeds #.SArg1.Per# of their max health, the electric shall be transferred to the next closest enemy, causing the nearby enemy to lose health equal to #.SArg2.Per# of the initial attack's damage and stunning them for #.SArg5#s.
41.ShortDescription: After dealing damage, if the enemy takes damage exceeding a percentage of their max health, the damage chains to the next closest enemy, causing them to lose health based on the initial attack's damage.

101.Description: Active: The Soul Hound attacks the farthest #.SArg0# enemy heroes, dealing damage to each of them. While the Whistle Bearer is terrified, they are also unable to use their Ultimate skill for #.SArg1# seconds, and the number of stacks the Soul Hound is tamed for is reduced by #.SArg2#.

11.Description: Generates #.SArg0# lightning bolts and attacks enemy heroes in the order they were placed in their formation, dealing considerable health loss damage and reducing damage they deal by #.SArg2.Per#. This effect lasts until their health is fully restored. This skill is immediately released once at the start of a battle.

Every cumulative #.SArg3# times he receives controlling or Haste-reducing effect, the damage reduction of his current barrier is temporarily diminished by #.SArg4.Per#.

102.Description: 挣脱(不用翻译)

21.Description: Clawlossus summons a massive wave, dealing several rounds of damage to all enemies and knocking them back. The wave destroys the targets' shields and stuns them for #.SArg1#s if they are knocked to the edge of the battlefield. Each use of Drowning Deluge will increase its damage and knockback distance.

Soullessness lasts for #.SArg3#s and cannot stack or be dispelled.

41.Description: After an enemy hero is knocked back to the edge of the battlefield by Drowning Deluge or becomes Soulless due to Spirit Snatcher, Clawlossus will deal #.SArg1.Per# extra damage and take #.SArg2.Per# less damage for #.SArg3#s. 0.Description:
Dalax is capable of long and short-range normal attacks.

Passive: Any damage dealt by Dalax adds #.SArg0# stack(s) of Poison. Poisoned enemies have their Vitality reduced by #.SArg1# points and are dealt a certain amount of damage every #.SArg2#s based on the number of stacks.
