31.Description: Dalax swoops over the battlefield, dealing damage to all enemies and leaving a path of tainted flames on the ground in his wake that lasts for #.SArg0#s. These flames deal damage to enemies standing upon them every #.SArg1#s. Dalax is untargetable while in flight.

41.Description: Dalax thrashes his tail around, dealing damage #.SArg0# times to enemies within range, knocking them back and stunning them for #.SArg1# to #.SArg2#s. The more stacks of Poison the enemies have, the longer the stun duration.

11.Description: Marsha alternates between melee and ranged attacks. Her ranged attack uses magma that prioritizes the furthest target, dealing AoE damage at their location and applying Magma Mark on them for #.SArg0#s. When a target is afflicted with Magma Mark, their Attack Rating is reduced by by #.SArg3.Per#. Her melee attack deals multiple hits to enemies close around her.

21.Description: Marsha periodically releases #.SArg5# Magma Guards from her abdomen that inherit a percentage of her max health and #.SArg4.Per# of other attributes. Magma Guards only use Normal Attacks and prioritize targets afflicted with Magma Marks. When a Magma Guard is killed by the enemy, Marsha additionally loses a percentage of her max health. When her health is below #.SArg2.Per#, she will release Magma Guards faster, each time releasing #.SArg6# enraged Magma Guards that additional have a shield equal to a certain amount of Marsha's Attack Rating.

31.Description: Marsha sprays several Magma bombs from her abdomen to attack all present heroes #.SArg3# times and creates a Magma area at the location of the target hero for #.SArg0#s. The Magma area damages enemies every second. Magma Guards within the Magma area gain #.SArg2# additional Haste points.

11.Description: Cecilia summons a divine blade down on the head of the enemy that has the most 'Symbols of Sin' above their head, dealing #.PlusRatio.Per# Attack Rating damage to them and further increasing the number of symbols above their head by 1. When this skill is used against enemies marked with 3 or more symbols, the enemies are stunned for a period of time. When used against enemies marked with 5 symbols, their symbols are cleared and the skill's damage is buffed by #.SArg0.Per#.
11.ShortDescription: Cecilia summons a divine blade upon the enemy that currently has the most Symbols of Sin above their head, dealing damage to them and further increasing the number of symbols above their head by 1. When this skill is used against enemies marked with 3 or more symbols, the enemies will also be stunned for a period of time. If used against enemies marked with 5 symbols, Judgment Day will deal additional damage to the enemies while removing all their symbols.

20.Description: Cecilia initiates a three-stage attack against an enemy, with each attack dealing #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to the target. Each time this skill is used increases the enemy's 'Symbols of Sins' by 1 symbol. The damage caused by this skill is increased by #.SArg0.Per# for every additional symbol that the enemy is marked with. Enemies may be marked by a maximum of 5 symbols.
20.ShortDescription: Cecilia initiates a three-stage attack against an enemy in front, dealing damage to the target with each strike. On the third strike, it increases the enemy's Symbols of Sin by 1. The damage caused by Blade of Purification is increased for every symbol that the enemy is marked with.

31.Description: Cecilia does not appear immediately at the beginning of battles, but instead appears behind the enemy that mirrors her formation position, unleashing a three-stage attack on them, dealing #.PlusRatio.Per# damage per attack to them while also marking them with 3 'Symbols of Sin'.
31.ShortDescription: Cecilia does not appear immediately at the beginning of battles but instead appears behind the enemy that mirrors her formation position, unleashing a three-stage attack on them, dealing damage with each strike while marking them with 3 Symbols of Sin on the last strike.

41.Description: Cecilia creates a divine circle that encompasses her enemies. All enemies within the divine circle have their attack ratings reduced by #.SArg0.Per#. The first time each enemy tries to enter or exit the circle will cause them to suffer #.PlusRatio.Per# damage.
41.ShortDescription: Cecilia creates a divine circle that encompasses her enemies. All enemies within the divine circle will have their Attack Rating reduced. The first time each enemy tries to enter or exit the circle will receive damage.

11.Description:
Morrow summons an Eye of Evil that deals damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating #.SArg2# times to enemies within range. Enemies that are burned are unable to use their ultimate skills for #.SArg1#s.

Every #.SArg3# times an ultimate skill is used on the battlefield, both allies and enemies are immune to control effects for the next #.SArg4#s.
11.ShortDescription: Morrow summons an Eye of Evil that deals damage to enemies within range. The struck enemies are unable to use their Ultimate for #.SArg1#s.

20.Description: Morrow summons a spider that cocoons an enemy, dealing #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to them in the process, also preventing them from moving for following #.SArg1#s.
20.ShortDescription: Morrow summons a spider that cocoons an enemy, dealing damage to them while preventing them from moving for the next #.SArg1#s.

31.Description: Morrow releases Korgas behind the enemy that has dealt the highest total amount of damage and deals #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to them, also manipulating them into attacking their own allies for #.SArg1# seconds. While the enemy target is being manipulated, they are unable to use their Ultimate skill and shall not be targeted by the skill "Binding Terror".
31.ShortDescription: Morrow releases Korgas behind the enemy with the highest total amount of damage dealt. Korgas deals damage to the enemy while manipulating them into attacking their allies for #.SArg1#s. While the enemy target is being manipulated, they cannot use their Ultimate.

41.Description: Passive. Morrow deals an additional #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to an enemy while attacking them. This skill can only target the same enemy once every #.SArg0# seconds.
41.ShortDescription: Passive. Morrow deals additional damage to an enemy while attacking them. This skill can be triggered on the same enemy once every #.SArg0# seconds.

11.Description: Eluard immediately creates a Divine Shield that has a value equal to #.SArg0.Per# of his Attack Rating. If Eluard already possesses a Divine Shield, he consumes it in order to deal damage equal to #.SArg1.Per# of the consumed shield's value to all enemies. Damage dealt cannot exceed #.SArg2.Per# of Eluard's own Attack Rating.

21.Description: Passive. Eluard creates a Divine Shield at the beginning of battle that has a value equal to #.SArg0.Per# of his Attack Rating. When the Divine Shield is broken, Eluard becomes weakened for #.SArg1#s, after which he creates a new Divine Shield with a value equal to #.SArg0.Per# of his Attack Rating. Damage dealt to Eluard when not protected by his Divine Shield is equal to #.SArg2.Per# of the initial damage.

31.Description: Eluard prioritizes the enemy with the highest total damage. Eluard starts reciting divine scripture, preventing both himself and the enemy target from moving and using skills, during which time Eluard is immune to all damage. Eluard's recitation can be interrupted when damage is dealt to him #.SArg1# times.

41.Description: Eluard recites a scripture of judgment, after which he deals #.PlusRatio.Per# damage to all enemies, dealing even more damage to summoned enemies. Passive: Summoned enemies deal increased damage to Eluard.

11.Description: Tidus spirals into a whirlwind that engulfs the battlefield, damaging all enemies he passes for #.SArg0.Per# of his Attack Rating. Then, Tidus jumps up and lands near the enemy with the lowest health percentage, damaging all surrounding enemies for #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating. While using his ultimate skill, Tidus cannot be targeted.
11.ShortDescription: Tidus spirals into a whirlwind that engulfs the battlefield, damaging all enemies he passes. Then, Tidus jumps up and lands near the enemy with the lowest health percentage, damaging all surrounding enemies.

20.Description:
Tidus performs a five-hit combo on enemies in front of him, with each hit dealing damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating and causing a slight knockback. Meanwhile, he inflicts Slice on the enemies for #.SArg0#s.

Slice: Loses health equal to #.SArg1.Per# of Tidus' Attack Rating per second while moving. This effect cannot stack.
20.ShortDescription:
Tidus performs a five-hit combo on the enemies in front of him, dealing damage and causing a slight knockback. Meanwhile, he inflicts Slice on them.

Slice: Loses health every second while moving.

31.Description: Tidus lets out a ferocious howl that terrifies the surrounding enemies, causing them to flee from him for #.SArg3#s. Tidus' Movement Speed is increased by #.SArg1.Per# and his Attack Rating is increased by #.SArg2.Per# for #.SArg0#s. This effect cannot stack.
31.ShortDescription: Tidus lets out a ferocious howl that terrifies the surrounding enemies, causing them to flee from him. Tidus' Movement Speed and Attack Rating are both increased.

11.Description: Lucius blesses all of his allies with a divine shield that mitigates damage equal to #.SArg1.Per# of his Attack Rating for #.SArg0#s.
11.ShortDescription: Lucius grants each ally a shield, lasting for #.SArg0#s.

20.Description: Lucius smashes the ground with his warhammer that causes a shockwave, dealing damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of his Attack Rating to nearby enemies and knocking them down.
20.ShortDescription: Lucius swings his warhammer that knocks down nearby enemies while dealing damage to them.

31.Description: Heals the allied hero with the lowest health percentage for #.PlusRatio.Per# of their own Attack Rating and raises their Defense Rating by #.SArg2.Per# for #.SArg0#s.
31.ShortDescription: Lucius heals the allied hero with the lowest health percentage and raises their Defense Rating.

11.Description: Antandra unleashes a multi-stage attack on the enemy with the highest Attack Rating, each attack dealing damage for #.PlusRatio.Per# Attack Rating and ignoring their Dodge, with the final attack dealing damage for #.SArg0.Per# of her Attack Rating and stunning the target for #.SArg1#s. This effect cannot stack against the same target, and the amount of stolen Attack Rating cannot exceed #.SArg4.Per# of Antandra's initial Attack Rating.
11.ShortDescription: Antandra unleashes a multi-stage attack on the enemy with the highest Attack Rating, with her final attack causing the enemy to become stunned for #.SArg3#s while stealing their Attack Rating.

20.Description: Damages a single enemy for #.PlusRatio.Per# of Attack Rating, imprinting Mark Of The Wild on them for #.SArg0#s. While marked, the enemy's Vitality is reduced by #.SArg2# points.
20.ShortDescription: Damages a single enemy, imprinting Mark Of The Wild on them for #.SArg0#s. While marked, the enemy's Vitality is reduced by #.SArg2# points.

31.Description: Antandra throws her spear at the enemy with the highest Attack Rating, damaging all enemies in its path for #.PlusRatio.Per# of her Attack Rating and imprinting Mark Of the Wild on them. Antandra then dashes over to the target enemy and gains a shield for #.SArg0#s. The shield can absorb damage for #.SArg1.Per# of the target enemy's Attack Rating (up to #.SArg2.Per# of Antandra's own Attack Rating). Antandra is immune to control effects while using this skill.
31.ShortDescription: Antandra throws her spear at the enemy with the highest Attack Rating, damaging and inflicting Mark Of The Wild on all enemies in its path. Antandra then dashes over to the target enemy and gains a shield.

11.ShortDescription: Scarlet unleashes a torrent of dark energy that strikes #.SArg0# times. 20.ShortDescription: Enemies with #.SArg0# stacks of Dark Miasma enter a state of Shaded Corruption, and are unable to move or use skills.

Each layer of ice shards reduces the target's Defense by #.SArg4.Per# and Haste by #.SArg5# points. At the end of their duration, the ice shards expand and cause beast damage equal to #.SArg6.Per# of the target's max health, without exceeding #.SArg7.Per# of Polar Beast's max health. Each additional layer of ice shards increases their expansion damage and max damage by #.SArg8.Per#.
31.ShortDescription: The skill casts ice shards on hit enemy heroes and reduces the target's Defense and Haste. At the end of their duration, the ice shards expand and cause beast damage based on the target's max health.

41.Description: When the target suffers their first control effect during the existence of the ice shards, enemies surrounding the target are inflicted beast damage of #.PlusRatio.Per# Attack Rating and Freeze for #.SArg0#s.
41.ShortDescription: When the target suffers their first control effect during the existence of the ice shards, enemies surrounding the target are inflicted beast damage and Freeze.

101.Description: 战斗中，布阵在后排中央的友方英雄首次对敌人施加控制效果时，无论控制效果是否因韧性而被抵抗，为该友方英雄回复#.SArg1#点能量。
101.ShortDescription: 布阵在后排中央的友方英雄首次对敌人施加控制效果时，为该友方英雄回复能量。

102.Description: 战斗中，布阵在后排中央的友方英雄首次使用必杀技时，在后续#.SArg1#秒内无视敌人的韧性。
102.ShortDescription: 布阵在后排中央的友方英雄首次使用必杀技时，无视敌人的韧性。

103.Description: 若敌方英雄因韧性而抵抗了来自友方英雄的控制效果，则降低该敌方英雄#.SArg0.Per#攻击力和#.SArg1#点韧性，持续#.SArg2#秒，该效果不可叠加。
103.ShortDescription: 若敌方英雄因韧性而抵抗了来自友方英雄的控制效果，则降低该敌方英雄攻击力和韧性。

11.Description: 熔火巨兽敲击地面使熔岩迸发，对累计造成伤害最多的友方英雄周围的敌人造成#.PlusRatio.Per#攻击力的兽灵伤害。友方英雄阵亡时，熔火巨兽会获得额外的兽灵能量。
11.ShortDescription: 熔火巨兽敲击地面使熔岩迸发，对累计造成伤害最多的友方英雄周围的敌人造成兽灵伤害。友方英雄阵亡时，熔火巨兽会获得额外的兽灵能量。

21.Description: 释放时，对累计造成伤害最多的友方英雄周围的敌人造成的伤害提升至熔火巨兽#.SArg0.Per#攻击力。同时使该友方英雄获得其自身#.SArg1.Per#最大生命值的熔岩护盾，护盾值不超过熔火巨兽#.SArg2.Per#最大生命值，持续#.SArg3#秒，熔岩护盾持续期间，该英雄拥有的大部分正面效果的持续时间增加#.SArg4.Per#。
21.ShortDescription: 释放时，对累计造成伤害最多的友方英雄周围的敌人造成的伤害提升，同时使该友方英雄获得熔岩护盾，熔岩护盾持续期间，该英雄拥有的大部分正面效果的持续时间增加。

31.Description: 释放时，创造跟随该友方英雄移动的熔岩区域，持续#.SArg0#秒。熔岩区域内所有单位每#.SArg1#秒流失#.SArg2.Per#最大生命值，至多不超过熔火巨兽#.SArg3.Per#最大生命值。友方英雄流失的生命值会转化为等额熔岩护盾，持续#.SArg4#秒。敌人在熔岩区域内无法恢复生命值。
31.ShortDescription: 释放时，创造跟随该友方英雄移动的熔岩区域。熔岩区域内所有单位持续流失生命值，友方英雄流失的生命值会转化为等额熔岩护盾，敌人在熔岩区域内无法恢复生命值。

41.Description: 释放后#.SArg0#秒内，累计造成伤害最多的友方英雄造成的伤害提升#.SArg1.Per#并免疫控制效果。
41.ShortDescription: 释放后#.SArg0#秒内，累计造成伤害最多的友方英雄造成的伤害提升并免疫控制效果。

101.Description: 熔火巨兽每秒获得的兽灵能量提升。友方英雄受到伤害时，熔火巨兽会获得额外的兽灵能量。
101.ShortDescription: 熔火巨兽每秒获得的兽灵能量提升。友方英雄受到伤害时，熔火巨兽会获得额外的兽灵能量。

102.Description: 战斗中，每#.SArg0#个非召唤物单位阵亡后，储存#.SArg1#秒无敌时长。释放“流火喷发”时，清除储存的无敌时长，并为累计造成伤害最多的友方英雄施加同等时长的无敌状态，无敌状态下免疫伤害和控制效果。
102.ShortDescription: 有非召唤物单位阵亡后，下次“流火喷发”会为累计造成伤害最多的友方英雄施加无敌状态。

103.Description: Increases the range of Lava Spouts and lava zones. If there are #.SArg0# or #.SArg1# enemy heroes within a lava zone, the health lost by each of them every #.SArg2#s shall increase to #.SArg3.Per#, up to #.SArg4.Per# of Fire Breather's max health.
103.ShortDescription: Increases the range of Lava Spouts and lava zones. If there are #.SArg0# or #.SArg1# enemy heroes within a lava zone, the health lost by each of them every #.SArg2#s shall increase.

11.Description: 剑脊龙蜥迅速接近目标并挥舞利爪，对#.SArg6#个敌人造成#.PlusRatio.Per#攻击力的兽灵伤害，优先选择累计受到伤害最多的敌方英雄。友方存活的初始攻击力最高的英雄释放必杀技后造成大量伤害时，剑脊龙蜥会获得额外的兽灵能量。
11.ShortDescription: 剑脊龙蜥迅速接近目标并挥舞利爪，对#.SArg6#个敌人造成兽灵伤害。友方存活的初始攻击力最高的英雄释放必杀技后造成大量伤害时，剑脊龙蜥会获得额外的兽灵能量。

21.Description: Reduces the cooldown of Raiding Chariot by #.SArg0#s. If damage is dealt to a target, Blade Ridge will receive additional Beast Energy.
21.ShortDescription: Reduces the cooldown of Raiding Chariot. If damage is dealt to a target, Blade Ridge will receive additional Beast Energy.

31.Description: 战斗中每过#.SArg0#秒，剑脊龙蜥的幻影会攻击#.SArg1#个敌人，造成#.PlusRatio.Per#攻击力的兽灵伤害，优先选择累计受到伤害最多的敌方英雄；并对友方存活的初始攻击力的最高英雄施加#.SArg2#层蓄力效果，至多叠加#.SArg3#层。该友方英雄使用必杀技时，清除所有蓄力效果，清除的每层蓄力效果使其造成的伤害提升#.SArg4.Per#，持续#.SArg5#秒。
31.ShortDescription: 战斗中每过#.SArg0#秒，剑脊龙蜥的幻影会攻击#.SArg1#个敌人，造成兽灵伤害，并对友方存活的初始攻击力的最高英雄施加蓄力效果。该英雄使用必杀技时，会清除蓄力效果并使其造成的伤害提升。

41.Description: If Raiding Chariot fails to inflict any damage on a target, it will deal additional #.SArg0# times of beast damage, each equal to #.SArg1.Per# Attack Rating, up to #.SArg2# times. Once successfully hit, the target loses #.SArg4.Per# of their max health every #.SArg3#s, up to #.SArg5.Per# of Blade Ridge's max health, for #.SArg6#s. This effect cannot be stacked.
41.ShortDescription: If Raiding Chariot fails to inflict any damage on a target, it will deal additional #.SArg0# times of beast damage, up to #.SArg2# times. Once successfully hit, the target loses their health continuously.

101.Description: For each round of damage dealt with Raiding Chariot, the subsequent damage from the skill is increased permanently by #.SArg0.Per# of Blade Ridge's Attack Rating, which can be stacked up to #.SArg1# times.
101.ShortDescription: For each round of damage dealt with Raiding Chariot, the subsequent damage from the skill is increased permanently.

102.Description: When using Raiding Chariot, Blade Ridge reduces the target's Physical Resist by #.SArg0# and Magic Resist by #.SArg1#, for #.SArg2#s. This effect can be stacked up to #.SArg3# times.
102.ShortDescription: When using Raiding Chariot, Blade Ridge reduces the target's Physical Resist and Magic Resist.

103.Description: 释放“突袭战车”时，对所有友方英雄施加#.SArg0#层蓄力效果。友方英雄使用必杀技时，只会清除#.SArg1#层蓄力效果，但伤害提升效果不变。
103.ShortDescription: 释放“突袭战车”时，对所有友方英雄施加#.SArg0#层蓄力效果。友方英雄使用必杀技时，只会清除#.SArg1#层蓄力效果，但伤害提升效果不变。

11.Description: 烁金翼狮盘旋升空后震耳吼叫，对所有敌人造成#.PlusRatio.Per#攻击力的兽灵伤害。友方英雄使用必杀技时，烁金翼狮会获得额外的兽灵能量。
11.ShortDescription: 烁金翼狮盘旋升空后震耳吼叫，对所有敌人造成兽灵伤害。友方英雄使用必杀技时，烁金翼狮会获得额外的兽灵能量。

21.Description: 释放时，处于敌方半场的友方英雄立即回复#.SArg0#点能量，处于友方半场的友方英雄在后续#.SArg1#秒内，每秒回复#.SArg2#点能量。
21.ShortDescription: 释放时，处于敌方半场的友方英雄立即回复能量，处于友方半场的友方英雄持续回复能量。

31.Description: 释放时，对攻击力最高的友方英雄施加鼓舞效果，使其造成的伤害提升#.SArg0.Per#，受到的伤害降低#.SArg1.Per#。被鼓舞的友方英雄使用必杀技或鼓舞效果持续#.SArg2#秒后，鼓舞效果会传递给另一个未被此次鼓舞效果影响的友方英雄。所有友方英雄均被此次鼓舞效果影响后，攻击力最高的友方英雄会受到一次强化鼓舞，持续#.SArg3#秒且不会传递。强化鼓舞会在鼓舞效果的基础上，额外提升目标英雄#.SArg4.Per#攻击力，额外提升的攻击力不超过烁金翼狮#.SArg5.Per#攻击力。
31.ShortDescription: 释放时，对攻击力最高的友方英雄施加鼓舞效果，使其造成的伤害提升，受到的伤害降低。鼓舞效果会在友方英雄间传递。传递结束后，攻击力最高的友方英雄会受到一次强化鼓舞，强化鼓舞会在鼓舞效果的基础上，额外提升目标英雄攻击力。

41.Description: 被鼓舞的友方英雄提升#.SArg0#点破防和#.SArg1#点破魔；该英雄每回复#.SArg2#点能量后，恢复#.SArg3.Per#最大生命值，恢复的生命值不超过烁金翼狮#.SArg4.Per#最大生命值。
41.ShortDescription: 被鼓舞的友方英雄提升破防和破魔；该英雄每回复一定能量后，恢复生命值。

101.Description: 战斗开始时，烁金翼狮立即获得一定兽灵能量。战斗中，若友方英雄首先使用必杀技，则烁金翼狮会获得额外的兽灵能量。
101.ShortDescription: 战斗开始时，烁金翼狮立即获得一定兽灵能量。若友方英雄首先使用必杀技，则烁金翼狮会获得额外的兽灵能量。

102.Description: 战斗中，布阵在前排的友方英雄，前#.SArg0#次使用必杀技时，造成的伤害提升#.SArg1.Per#/#.SArg2.Per#/#.SArg3.Per#，持续#.SArg4#秒。
102.ShortDescription: 布阵在前排的友方英雄，前#.SArg0#次使用必杀技时，造成的伤害提升。

103.Description: 每个友方英雄受到的首次强化鼓舞的持续时间提升至#.SArg0#秒。
103.ShortDescription: 每个友方英雄受到的首次强化鼓舞的持续时间提升。

11.Description: 盾冠龙蜥引导岩石能量，在友方半场张开防护屏障，持续#.SArg3#秒。友方英雄在屏障内受到伤害的#.SArg4.Per#将由屏障承担。屏障至多承担盾冠龙蜥#.SArg5.Per#最大生命值的伤害，承担伤害超过上限时屏障会提前结束，但至少会持续#.SArg6#秒。友方英雄在友方半场受到伤害时，盾冠龙蜥会获得额外的兽灵能量。
11.ShortDescription: 盾冠龙蜥引导岩石能量，在友方半场张开防护屏障。友方英雄在屏障内受到的部分伤害将由屏障承担。友方英雄在友方半场受到伤害时，盾冠龙蜥会获得额外的兽灵能量。

21.Description: 屏障承担伤害的比例提升至#.SArg0.Per#，承担伤害的上限提升至盾冠龙蜥#.SArg1.Per#最大生命值。若屏障结束时承担伤害未超过上限，则剩余可承担伤害的#.SArg2.Per#会转化会治疗平均分配给屏障内存活的友方英雄。
21.ShortDescription: 屏障承担伤害的比例及承担伤害的上限提升。若屏障结束时承担伤害未超过上限，则会治疗屏障内存活的友方英雄。

31.Description: At the start of a battle, the Rock Crown Lizard is full of Beast Energy. When the Shield ends, the beast deals beast damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of its Attack Rating to all enemies within the Shield and strikes them back a certain distance into the enemy side of the battlefield. The #.SArg0# enemy heroes closest at the front receive additional damage equal to #.SArg1.Per# of their max health and are stunned for #.SArg2#s. The additional damage will not exceed #.SArg3.Per# of the Rock Crown Lizard's max health. For #.SArg5#s, the Attack Rating of hit enemies is reduced by #.SArg4.Per#.
31.ShortDescription: At the start of a battle, the Rock Crown Lizard is full of Beast Energy. When the shield ends, the beast deals beast damage to all enemies within the shield and strikes them back a certain distance into the enemy side of the battlefield. The #.SArg0# enemy heroes closest at the front receive additional damage and are stunned. The Attack Rating of hit enemies is reduced.

41.Description: If an enemy has a shield within the Guarding Shield, their shield value will be weakened by #.SArg0.Per# of their max health per second, with the lost shield value per second not exceeding #.SArg1.Per# of the Rock Crown Lizard's max health. Any shield value lost increases the Guarding Shield's maximum borne damage by an equal amount.
41.ShortDescription: If an enemy has a shield within the Guarding Shield, their shield value will be weakened by a certain amount per second. Any shield value lost increases the Guarding Shield's maximum borne damage by an equal amount.

101.Description: 提升屏障内的友方英雄#.SArg0#点化解和#.SArg1#点韧性。
101.ShortDescription: 提升屏障内的友方英雄化解和韧性。

102.Description: 友方英雄受到致死伤害时，免疫此次伤害并进入#.SArg0#秒无敌状态。盾冠龙蜥会立即充满兽灵能量并释放防护屏障；若此时友方场上已存在屏障，已存在的屏障会提前结束。该效果每场战斗至多生效#.SArg1#次。
102.ShortDescription: 友方英雄受到致死伤害时，免疫此次伤害并短暂无敌，盾冠龙蜥会立即释放防护屏障。该效果每场战斗至多生效#.SArg1#次。

103.Description: 屏障结束时，还会驱散屏障内敌人的大部分正面状态与友方英雄的大部分负面状态。
103.ShortDescription: 屏障结束时，还会驱散屏障内敌人的大部分正面状态与友方英雄的大部分负面状态。

11.Description: Feline Vesperio assembles Dark Flames to summon a Darkfire Ball above the battlefield that lasts for #.SArg3#s. Every #.SArg4#s, the Darkfire Ball releases Abysmal Draw on #.SArg5# enemies, dealing beast damage equal to #.SArg6.Per# of its Attack Rating. Abysmal Draw prioritizes the enemy heroes with the most Energy as targets. When an enemy hero uses a skill other than a Normal Attack, Feline Vesperio gains additional beast energy.
11.ShortDescription: Feline Vesperio assembles Dark Flames to summon a Darkfire Ball above the battlefield. Every #.SArg4#s, the Darkfire Ball releases Abysmal Draw on #.SArg5# enemies and deals beast damage. When an enemy hero uses a skill other than a Normal Attack, Feline Vesperio gains additional beast energy.

21.Description: Increases the duration of a Darkfire Ball to #.SArg0#s. When releasing Abysmal Draw, it selects #.SArg1# additional targets.
21.ShortDescription: Increases the duration of a Darkfire Ball. When releasing Abysmal Draw, it selects #.SArg1# additional targets.

31.Description: When a Darkfire Ball releases Abysmal Draw and the target is a hero, it steals #.SArg0# points of the target's Energy and stores it in the Darkfire Ball. If the target's Energy is lower than #.SArg1#, every Energy point short will increase Abysmal Draw's damage by #.SArg2.Per#. If the target is a boss or summoned entity, Abysmal Draw's damage will be increased by #.SArg3.Per#.
31.ShortDescription: When a Darkfire Ball releases Abysmal Draw and the target is a hero, it steals the target's Energy and stores it in the Darkfire Ball. If the target's Energy is insufficient or the target is a boss or summoned entity, Abysmal Draw's damage will be increased.

41.Description: 焰球持续时间结束时，会引爆幽暗之火，对所有敌人造成#.SArg0.Per#最大生命值的兽灵伤害，该伤害至多不超过幽焰翼狮#.SArg1.Per#最大生命值，并将焰球中储存的生命值和能量平均分配给所有存活的友方英雄。
41.ShortDescription: 焰球持续时间结束时，会引爆幽暗之火，对所有敌人造成基于最大生命值的兽灵伤害，并将焰球中储存的生命值和能量平均分配给所有存活的友方英雄。

101.Description: Enemy heroes attacked with Abysmal Draw have their Energy Recovery Rate reduced by #.SArg1.Per# over the next #.SArg0#s. This effect cannot be stacked.
101.ShortDescription: When attacked with Abysmal Draw, an enemy hero's Energy Recovery Rate is reduced.

102.Description: When an enemy hero uses their Ultimate, the damage they deal is reduced for #.SArg0#s. The longer the enemy hero goes without using their Ultimate, the higher the proportion of damage reduced, up to a maximum of #.SArg1.Per#. This max damage reduction is reached when the interval of the Ultimate exceeds #.SArg2#s. This effect cannot be stacked.
102.ShortDescription: When an enemy hero uses their Ultimate, the damage they deal is reduced.

103.Description: When a Darkfire Ball releases Abysmal Draw, it steals #.SArg0.Per# of the target's max health and stores it in the Darkfire Ball. The health stolen will not exceed #.SArg1.Per# of Feline Vesperio's max health. The target cannot restore their health in the next #.SArg2#s.
103.ShortDescription: When a Darkfire Ball releases Abysmal Draw, it steals the target's health and stores it in the Darkfire Ball. The target cannot restore their health in the next #.SArg2#s.

11.Description: 呦呦对所有友军造成#.SArg3.Per#攻击力的治疗，并在友方英雄最密集区域生成一处生机之路，持续#.SArg4#秒，位于生机之路上的友军受愈提升#.SArg5#点。友方英雄受到来自英雄的治疗时，呦呦获得额外的兽灵能量。
11.ShortDescription: 呦呦对所有友军造成治疗，并在友方英雄最密集区域生成一处持续一定时间的生机之路，位于生机之路上的友军受愈提升。友方英雄受到来自英雄的治疗时，呦呦获得额外的兽灵能量。

21.Description: 被动的，每隔一定时间，呦呦跑向最虚弱的友方英雄使其在后续#.SArg5#秒内受到的伤害降低#.SArg4.Per#，恢复其最大生命值#.SArg1.Per#的生命，至多不超过呦呦自身#.SArg2.Per#最大生命值，并生成一处生机之路，持续#.SArg3#秒。该技能会优先选择未位于生机之路的友方英雄。
21.ShortDescription: 每隔一定时间，呦呦跑向最虚弱的友方英雄使其在一定时间内受到的伤害降低，为其恢复生命，并生成一处生机之路。优先选择未位于生机之路的友方英雄。

31.Description: Any excess healing Bellbellow grants to allies on a Trail of Life will be stored by that Trail. Said Trail of Life will heal allies in its range for #.SArg1.Per# of their lost health every #.SArg0#s, until it disappears or is exhausted.
31.ShortDescription: Any excess healing Bellbellow grants to allies on a Trail of Life will be stored by that Trail. Said Trail of Life will continuously heal allies in its range for their lost health, until it disappears or is exhausted.

41.Description: 呦呦释放焕新生息时，所有生机之路将被强化，每有#.SArg2#个友方英雄位于强化后的生机之路上，全体友方英雄受到的伤害降低#.SArg0.Per#，造成的伤害提高#.SArg1.Per#。
41.ShortDescription: 呦呦释放焕新生息时，所有生机之路将被强化，友方英雄位于强化后的生机之路上，将使全体友方英雄受到的伤害降低，造成的伤害提高。

101.Description: 友方英雄受到来自英雄的治疗时，呦呦还会额外对其造成呦呦#.SArg0.Per#攻击力的治疗，该效果每#.SArg1#秒至多对同一英雄触发#.SArg2#次。
101.ShortDescription: 友方英雄受到来自英雄的治疗时，呦呦还会额外对其造成治疗。

102.Description: Bellbellow increases Vitality and shield value of allies on a Trail of Life by #.SArg0# and #.SArg1.Per# respectively.
102.ShortDescription: Bellbellow increases Vitality and shield value of allies on a Trail of Life.

103.Description: When Bellbellow heals an ally, an additional life shield is granted to them for up to #.SArg0#s, which offsets damage equaling up to #.SArg1.Per# of Bellbellow's Attack Rating. If the ally suffers healing restriction or receives excess healing, the duration of the life shield is extended to #.SArg2#s. It can also withstand #.SArg3# rounds of additional damage each not exceeding #.SArg4.Per# of Bellbellow's Attack Rating.
103.ShortDescription: When Bellbellow heals an ally, it grants a life shield to the ally, which negates damage up to a certain percentage of its Attack Rating. If the ally suffers from an effect that prevents healing or receives excess healing, the shield's duration is extended, and it can withstand a certain amount of additional damage.

11.Description: 飘羽林枭在敌我最密集的区域生成时间领域，对其中的敌人造成#.PlusRatio.Per#攻击力的伤害，并改变这片区域的时间流速，持续#.SArg5#秒。位于领域内的友军大部分正面效果的持续时间延长#.SArg6.Per#，敌人大部分正面效果的持续时间缩短#.SArg7.Per#。友方英雄对敌人造成伤害时，飘羽林枭可获得额外兽灵能量。
11.ShortDescription: 飘羽林枭在敌我最密集的区域生成时间领域，对其中的敌人造成伤害，并改变这片区域的时间流速，持续#.SArg5#秒。位于领域内的友军大部分正面效果的持续时间延长#.SArg6.Per#，敌人大部分正面效果的持续时间缩短#.SArg7.Per#。友方英雄对敌人造成伤害时，飘羽林枭可获得额外兽灵能量。

21.Description: 被动的，每隔一定时间，飘羽林枭使友方累计伤害最高的英雄短暂的免疫控制效果，并在后续#.SArg3#秒内韧性提高#.SArg2#点。
21.ShortDescription: 被动的，每隔一定时间，飘羽林枭使友方累计伤害最高的英雄短暂的免疫控制效果，并在后续#.SArg3#秒内韧性提高。

31.Description: Time zones now prolong the duration of allied buffs by #.SArg0.Per# and reduces the duration of enemy buffs by #.SArg1.Per#. If an enemy hero stays in a time zone for #.SArg2#s, they will be frozen in time for #.SArg3#s. Each enemy hero can only be frozen #.SArg4# time per time zone. Bosses cannot be frozen.
31.ShortDescription: Time zones now prolong the duration of allied buffs by #.SArg0.Per# and reduces the duration of enemy buffs by #.SArg1.Per#. If an enemy hero stays in a time zone for #.SArg2#s, they will be frozen in time for #.SArg3#s. This effect can only be triggered a limited number of times, and cannot be used against Bosses.

41.Description: Time zones now last #.SArg0#s. Time zones now increase the Haste of allied heroes in the zone by #.SArg1# points and decrease the Haste of enemy heroes in the zone by #.SArg2# points.
41.ShortDescription: Time zones now last #.SArg0#s. Time zones now increase the Haste of allied heroes in the zone and decrease the Haste of enemy heroes in the zone.

101.Description: 被动的，飘羽林枭始终在战场中勘察敌情，全体友方英雄洞察提升#.SArg0#点，造成的伤害提高#.SArg1.Per#。
101.ShortDescription: 被动的，飘羽林枭始终在战场中勘察敌情，全体友方英雄洞察提升，造成的伤害提高。

102.Description: 友方英雄如果在时间领域内停留满#.SArg0#秒，则会在接下来#.SArg2#秒内免疫伤害与控制效果，该效果每名友方英雄每#.SArg3#秒至多触发#.SArg4#次。
102.ShortDescription: 友方英雄如果在时间领域内停留满#.SArg0#秒，则会在接下来一定时间内免疫伤害与控制效果，该效果有触发间隔。

103.Description: After Flutterplume Owl uses Chrono Control #.SArg0# times in a single battle, the remaining duration of the battle will be prolonged by #.SArg1#s. Can trigger once per battle.
103.ShortDescription: After Flutterplume Owl uses Chrono Control #.SArg0# times in a single battle, the remaining duration of the battle will be prolonged by #.SArg1#s. Can trigger once per battle.

11.Description: 战斗开始时，伶俐巧虎会跟随布阵位置最靠前的友方英雄移动，提升其#.SArg5#点闪避和#.SArg6#点魔法抑制。跟随的英雄阵亡时，则会重新选择跟随目标。伶俐巧虎会优先选择辅助英雄跟随。主动使用时，伶俐巧虎跳跃至敌方最密集的区域，抖落鞭炮对周围敌人造成#.SArg8#次#.SArg7.Per#攻击力的兽灵伤害并使其致盲#.SArg9#秒，被致盲的敌人会大幅降低命中和魔法效能。跟随的英雄造成或受到伤害时，伶俐巧虎可获得额外兽灵能量。
11.ShortDescription: 战斗开始时，伶俐巧虎会跟随布阵位置最靠前的友方英雄移动，提升其闪避和魔法抑制。主动使用时，伶俐巧虎跳跃至敌方最密集的区域，抖落鞭炮对周围敌人造成兽灵伤害并大幅降低其命中和魔法效能。跟随的英雄造成或受到伤害时，伶俐巧虎可获得额外兽灵能量。

21.Description: After using this skill, Talismane will drop firecrackers along the way as it returns with its followed hero. Each drop deals beast damage equaling #.SArg0.Per# of its Attack Rating to enemies in a small area, and blinds them.
21.ShortDescription: After using this skill, Talismane will drop firecrackers along the way as it returns with its followed hero, dealing beast damage to enemies and blinding them.

31.Description: Every #.SArg0#s, Talismane grants the hero it follows a Longevity Lock, which will remain with the hero until they receive a single round of damage that exceeds #.SArg1.Per# of their max health or suffer fatal damage. At this point, the Longevity Lock will offset the damage and expire. Longevity Lock cannot be stacked.
31.ShortDescription: Every #.SArg0#s, Talismane grants the hero it follows a Longevity Lock. When the hero receives a single round of damage that exceeds a portion of their max health or suffers fatal damage, the Longevity Lock will offset the damage and expire.

41.Description: In addition to the hero it is following, Talismane also grants a Longevity Lock to the allied hero who has dealt the highest total damage. Heroes with a Longevity Lock take #.SArg0.Per# less damage and deal #.SArg1.Per# extra damage.
41.ShortDescription: 伶俐巧虎还会额外赋予除跟随的英雄外当前累计伤害最高的已方英雄长命锁，且拥有长命锁的英雄，受到的伤害降低，造成的伤害提升。额外的目标会优先选取尚未拥有长命锁的友方英雄。

101.Description: The first time the hero it follows uses their Ultimate, Talismane will immediately use its skill "A Blessed Year" #.SArg0# time, without consuming any beast energy. This effect can only be triggered once per battle.
101.ShortDescription: The first time the hero it follows uses their Ultimate, Talismane will immediately use its skill "A Blessed Year" #.SArg0# time, without consuming any beast energy.

102.Description: The damage caused by Talismane's firecrackers is increased further by #.SArg0.Per# of its Attack Rating, while Hypogean and Graveborn heroes are additionally terrified for #.SArg1#s.
102.ShortDescription: The damage caused by Talismane's firecrackers is increased further while Hypogean and Graveborn heroes are additionally terrified for #.SArg1#s.

103.Description: For the duration of a Longevity Lock, the Dodge and Magic Suppression received by the hero followed by Talismane will increase to #.SArg0# times their original value.
103.ShortDescription: For the duration of a Longevity Lock, the Dodge and Magic Suppression received by the hero followed by Talismane will increase to #.SArg0# times their original value.

11.Description: 幻鳞仙蛾轻盈地攀附于友方累计伤害最高的英雄身上，被附身的英雄使用普通攻击造成伤害时将为目标附加持续#.SArg1#秒的“坠梦”效果，至多叠加#.SArg2#层，每层坠梦效果将降低目标#.SArg3#点韧性。 附身期间每秒消耗#.SArg4#点兽灵能量，直至兽灵能量不足或被附身英雄处于不可选中状态时结束附身，每次附身至多持续#.SArg5#秒。友方英雄使用普攻时，幻鳞仙蛾将获得额外的兽灵能量。
11.ShortDescription: 幻鳞仙蛾轻盈地攀附于友方累计伤害最高的英雄身上，被附身的英雄使用普攻攻击造成伤害时将为目标附加“坠梦”效果，附身期间每秒消耗#.SArg4#点兽灵能量，直至兽灵能量不足或被附身英雄处于不可选中状态时结束附身，每次附身至多持续#.SArg5#秒。友方英雄使用普攻时，幻鳞仙蛾将获得额外的兽灵能量。

21.Description: Increases max Dreamtorn stacks to #.SArg0#. When a target reaches #.SArg0# or over #.SArg0# stacks of Dreamtorn, the normal attack damage they take will be increased by #.SArg1.Per#. So long as the most recently inflicted stack of Dreamtorn is still in effect, all older stacks of Dreamtorn will not expire and will continually refresh.
21.ShortDescription: Increases max Dreamtorn stacks. When an enemy reaches #.SArg0# stacks, the normal attack they take will be increased by #.SArg1.Per#.

31.Description: 坠梦效果的层数上限提升至#.SArg0#层，叠加至#.SArg0#层时，目标将陷入睡眠状态，持续#.SArg2#秒。当目标身上的坠梦效果处于#.SArg0#层时，目标受到来源于友方英雄普攻伤害的#.SArg1.Per#将以无视防御的形式进行结算。
31.ShortDescription: 提升坠梦效果的层数上限，叠加至#.SArg0#层时，目标受到来源于友方英雄普攻伤害的#.SArg1.Per#将以无视防御的形式进行结算，并且目标还将陷入睡眠状态，持续#.SArg2#秒。

41.Description: 幻鳞仙蛾结束附身时，挥舞巨大膜翅向周围挥洒鳞粉，驱散所有友军大部分的攻击力降低的负面效果，对所有敌人造成#.PlusRatio.Per#攻击力的兽灵伤害，并对其附加持续#.SArg0#秒的坠梦效果。同时坠梦效果叠加至#.SArg4#层时目标受到普攻伤害增加的幅度提升至#.SArg2.Per#，叠加至#.SArg5#层时，目标受到来源于友方英雄普攻的伤害以无视防御的形式进行结算的比例提升至#.SArg3.Per#。
41.ShortDescription: When Phantasmoth ends its bond with a hero, it scatters shimmering scales around it, dispelling any Attack Rating reduction effects from allies, dealing beast damage to all enemies, and inflicting Dreamtorn on the targets for #.SArg0#s. The effects of Dreamtorn after reaching #.SArg4# and #.SArg5# stacks are enhanced.

101.Description: Phantasmoth's bonded hero gains #.SArg0.Per# Attack Rating and #.SArg1.Per# Attack Speed. The bonus to Attack Rating cannot exceed #.SArg2.Per# of Phantasmoth's Attack Rating.
101.ShortDescription: Increases the Attack Rating and Attack Speed of Phantasmoth's bonded hero.

102.Description: The normal attacks of Phantasmoth's bonded hero will cause their target to take #.SArg0.Per# extra normal attack damage and reduce their Dissolve by #.SArg1# points for #.SArg2#s. This effect can stack up to #.SArg3# times.
102.ShortDescription: The normal attacks of Phantasmoth's bonded hero will cause their target to take #.SArg0.Per# extra normal attack damage and reduce their Dissolve.

103.Description: Every #.SArg0# times an enemy takes damage from Phantasmoth's bonded hero, Phantasmoth will damage the enemy for #.SArg1.Per# of the enemy's max health. This damage cannot exceed #.SArg2.Per# of Phantasmoth's max health. This effect can trigger once every #.SArg3#s.
103.ShortDescription: Every #.SArg0# times an enemy takes damage from Phantasmoth's bonded hero, Phantasmoth will deal additional damage to the enemy.

11.Description: 甜霜芙蕾召唤绵绵云朵，为所有友方英雄回复#.SArg1#点能量，并降下星落甜品，对所有敌人造成#.SArg2#次甜霜芙蕾#.SArg3.Per#攻击力的伤害。双方英雄消耗或损失能量时，甜霜芙蕾会获得额外的兽灵能量。
11.ShortDescription: 甜霜芙蕾召唤绵绵云朵，为所有友方英雄回复能量，对所有敌人造成#.SArg2#次伤害。双方英雄消耗或损失能量时，甜霜芙蕾会获得额外的兽灵能量。

21.Description: Savage Soufflé "cakefies" #.SArg0# enemy, turning them into strawberry cakes that cannot attack for #.SArg1#s. Savage Soufflé will prioritize enemy heroes that have dealt the most total damage and are not immune to control effects.
21.ShortDescription: Savage Soufflé "cakefies" #.SArg0# enemy, turning them into strawberry cakes that are unable to attack.

31.Description: Candy Clouds will drop #.SArg0# Boom-Boom Buns on the battlefield. Boom-Boom Buns will explode after #.SArg2#s or whenever a hero goes near it, damaging all nearby enemy heroes for #.SArg3.Per# of Savage Soufflé's Attack Rating and immobilizing them for #.SArg4#s.
31.ShortDescription: Candy Clouds will drop Boom-Boom Buns on the battlefield. Whenever a Boom-Boom Bun explodes, it damages and immobilizes all nearby enemy heroes.

41.Description: Cakefied targets take #.SArg1.Per# extra damage and have their Defense Ratings reduced by #.SArg0.Per# (up to #.SArg3.Per# of Savage Soufflé's Defense Rating) whether they change shape or not for #.SArg2#s.
41.ShortDescription: Cakefied targets take extra damage and have their Defense Ratings reduced.

101.Description: 召唤绵绵云朵时，为友方英雄回复的能量提升至#.SArg0#点。
101.ShortDescription: 绵绵云朵为友方英雄回复的能量提升。

102.Description: #.SArg0# additional target can be cakefied.

103.Description: 砰砰甜品爆炸时，为周围友方英雄清除大部分无法回复能量或能量回复速率降低的效果，并回复#.SArg0#点能量。
103.ShortDescription: 砰砰甜品爆炸时，为周围友方英雄清除无法回能或降低回能的效果，并回复能量。

11.Description: Slumber Seal can sleep soundly through any battle. It spawns #.SArg6# aquatic spirits every #.SArg0#s to attack the enemy with the lowest health, dealing beast damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of its Attack Rating. Each time an allied hero receives or resists a control or limitation effect, #.SArg1# aquatic spirits will drop around Slumber Seal, up to #.SArg3# every #.SArg2#s. It can also retrieve aquatic spirits from the battlefield, increasing damage dealt by them permanently by #.SArg4.Per#, up to #.SArg5.Per#.
11.ShortDescription: Slumber Seal is constantly asleep. It spawns aquatic spirits every #.SArg0#s to attack enemies, dealing a certain amount of damage. Each time an allied hero receives or resists a control or limitation effect, aquatic spirits will drop around Slumber Seal. It can also retrieve aquatic spirits from the battlefield, increasing damage dealt by them permanently.

21.Description: Slumber Seal moves quickly to the center of the battlefield, stirring up #.SArg0# waves to attack enemies. Each time an enemy is struck by the waves, they receive beast damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of its Attack Rating and are knocked back a short distance. Each time an allied hero receives or resists a control or limitation effect, Slumber Seal receives additional beast energy.
21.ShortDescription: Slumber Seal moves quickly to the center of the battlefield, stirring up multiple waves to attack and knock back enemies. Each time an allied hero receives or resists a control or limitation effect, Slumber Seal receives additional beast energy.

31.Description: The enemy hit by the last wave is trapped in a bubble for #.SArg0#s. Damage taken by the enemy while trapped is increased by #.SArg1.Per#; for beast damage, it is increased further by #.SArg2.Per#.
31.ShortDescription: The enemy hit by the last wave is trapped in a bubble for several seconds. Damage taken by the enemy while trapped is increased; for beast damage, it is increased further.

41.Description: Each time an enemy is trapped in a bubble, Slumber Seal spawns an additional #.SArg0# aquatic spirits to attack the enemy, dealing further damage equal to #.SArg1.Per# of the enemy's max health, up to #.SArg2.Per# of its Attack Rating.
41.ShortDescription: Each time an enemy is trapped in a bubble, Slumber Seal spawns additional aquatic spirits to attack the enemy, dealing further damage equal to a portion of the enemy's max health.

101.Description: 懒懒豹每次回收水生精灵会永久提升攻击力，数值为原英雄#.SArg0.Per#的当前攻击力，懒懒豹因此获得的属性至多为友方上阵英雄的初始攻击力之和的#.SArg1.Per#。
101.ShortDescription: Each time Slumber Seal retrieves aquatic spirits, its Attack Rating is permanently increased, and the attributes it receives as a result will not exceed a max limit.

102.Description: When any allied hero does not receive or resist a control or limitation effect for #.SArg0#s, Slumber Seal will receive extra beast energy while #.SArg1# aquatic spirit will drop at random places. This effect can only trigger once every #.SArg2#s.
102.ShortDescription: When any allied hero does not receive or resist a control or limitation effect for a given duration, Slumber Seal will receive extra beast energy while a number of aquatic spirits will drop randomly.

103.Description: 懒懒豹每次回收水生精灵会永久提升暴击率与暴伤增幅，数值为原英雄#.SArg0.Per#的当前暴击率与暴伤增幅。额外的，懒懒豹因此提升的各项属性至多为友方上阵英雄的对应初始属性之和的#.SArg1.Per#。
103.ShortDescription: Each time Slumber Seal retrieves aquatic spirits, its Crit Rating and Crit Damage Amplification are permanently increased, and the max limit of the attribute buffs it receives as a result is also increased.

11.Description: 绯韵狐对造成伤害最高的敌方英雄施加持续#.SArg0#秒的“沉沦”效果，处于沉沦效果下的敌人造成的伤害降低#.SArg1.Per#，沉沦效果不可叠加。随后以至多#.SArg2#名造成伤害最高的敌方英雄为目标，在目标之间跳跃使其迷失，绯韵狐离场前迷失的目标将持续跟随自己移动。友方英雄对处于沉沦效果下的敌人造成伤害时，绯韵狐会获得额外的兽灵能量。
11.ShortDescription: Fox Fatale inflicts a Degenerate effect for #.SArg0# seconds on the enemy hero that has dealt the highest damage. While suffering from a Degenerate effect, damage dealt by an enemy is reduced. Fox Fatale then targets multiple enemy heroes, bouncing between them and causing them to be lost. The targets that were lost before Fox Fatale leaves the battlefield continue to follow Fox Fatale.

21.Description: At the start of a battle, Fox Fatale inflicts a Degenerate effect for #.SArg0# seconds on the enemy hero with the highest Attack Rating.
21.ShortDescription: At the start of a battle, Fox Fatale inflicts a Degenerate effect for #.SArg0# seconds on the enemy hero with the highest Attack Rating.

31.Description: While leaving the battlefield, Fox Fatale jumps onto the area most dense with enemies, dealing beast damage to surrounding enemies for #.PlusRatio.Per# of its Attack Rating and charming them for #.SArg0# seconds. When charmed, the enemy can only use normal attack.
31.ShortDescription: While leaving the battlefield, Fox Fatale jumps onto the area most dense with enemies, dealing beast damage to surrounding enemies and charming them for #.SArg0# seconds. When charmed, the enemy can only use normal attack.

41.Description: 绯韵狐释放技能后，友方英雄的普通攻击和技能将优先以处于沉沦效果下的敌人为目标，并且友方英雄对其造成的伤害提升#.SArg1.Per#，持续#.SArg0#秒，该效果不可叠加。
41.ShortDescription: 绯韵狐释放技能后，友方英雄的普通攻击和技能将优先以处于沉沦效果下的敌人为目标，并且友方英雄对其造成的伤害提升，持续#.SArg0#秒。

101.Description: While suffering from a Degenerate effect, Energy Recovery received by an enemy in any way is reduced by #.SArg0.Per#.
101.ShortDescription: While suffering from a Degenerate effect, Energy Recovery received by an enemy in any way is reduced.

102.Description: While suffering from a Degenerate effect, an enemy has their Attack Rating reduced by #.SArg0.Per#, up to #.SArg1.Per# of Fox Fatale's Attack Rating. However, if the enemy is charmed by Fox Fatale at the same time, the enemy's Attack Rating will be increased by #.SArg2.Per# instead.
102.ShortDescription: While suffering from a Degenerate effect, an enemy has their Attack Rating reduced. However, if the enemy is charmed by Fox Fatale at the same time, the enemy's Attack Rating will be increased instead.

103.Description: The charm duration is increased to #.SArg0# seconds. Enemies that are charmed at the same time can use any skills other than their Ultimate.
103.ShortDescription: The charm duration is increased, and enemies that are charmed at the same time can use any skills other than their Ultimate.

11.Description: While using this skill, Shroom Spooder leaps into the area most densely populated with enemies and releases a hallucinogenic mist lasting #.SArg0#s. Every enemy within the range of the mist suffers beast damage equal to #.SArg2.Per# of Shroom Spooder's Attack Rating per #.SArg1#s. When an enemy hero suffers health loss from an ally's attack, Shroom Spooder receives additional energy.
11.ShortDescription: While using this skill, Shroom Spooder leaps into the area most densely populated with enemies and releases a hallucinogenic mist, inflicting continuous health loss on every enemy within range. When an enemy hero loses health from an ally's attack, Shroom Spooder receives additional health.

22.Description: For every total amount of Negative Energy Nightfall Pegasus absorbs equal to #.SArg4.Per# of its Attack Rating, the Attack Rating of all allied heroes will be increased by #.SArg5.Per# of Nightfall Pegasus' Attack Rating. 22.ShortDescription: For every certain total amount of Negative Energy Nightfall Pegasus absorbs, the Attack Rating of all allied heroes will be increased.

23.Description: When Nightfall Pegasus actively attacks, its Attack Rating is increased based on the amount of Negative Energy absorbed (capped at an increase of #.SArg3.Per# of its Attack Rating).
23.ShortDescription: When Nightfall Pegasus actively attacks, its Attack Rating is increased based on the amount of Negative Energy absorbed.

31.Description: At the start of battle, Nightfall Pegasus flies toward the enemy unit with the highest Attack Rating, dealing beast damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of its Attack Rating to the target and nearby enemy units while applying #.SArg0# stack of Melancholy for #.SArg1#s.
31.ShortDescription: At the start of battle, Nightfall Pegasus flies toward the enemy unit with the highest Attack Rating, dealing beast damage to the target and nearby enemy units while applying Melancholy.

32.Description: When an enemy unit attacks an allied hero protected by Nightfall Pegasus, #.SArg2# stack of Melancholy will be applied for #.SArg3#s.
32.ShortDescription: When an enemy unit attacks an allied hero protected by Nightfall Pegasus, Melancholy will be applied.

33.Description: Melancholy reduces the target's Vitality by #.SArg4# points and Healing by #.SArg5# points.
33.ShortDescription: Melancholy reduces the target's Vitality and healing.

41.Description: Active: Nightfall Pegasus unleashes its Negative Energy, dealing #.SArg0# strikes of beast damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of its Attack Rating to all enemies. During the #.SArg1#s before actively using this skill, for every amount of Negative Energy Nightfall Pegasus absorbs equal to #.SArg2.Per# of its Attack Rating, the skill's damage will be increased by #.SArg3.Per# (capped at an increase of #.SArg4.Per#).
41.ShortDescription: Active: Nightfall Pegasus unleashes its Negative Energy, dealing beast damage to all enemies. Before actively using this skill, for every amount of Negative Energy Nightfall Pegasus absorbs equal to a certain percentage of its Attack Rating, the skill's damage will be increased.

42.Description: When enemy units deal damage, the percentage reduced by Melancholy will also be absorbed by Nightfall Pegasus as Negative Energy.
42.ShortDescription: When enemy units deal damage, the percentage reduced by Melancholy will also be absorbed by Nightfall Pegasus as Negative Energy.

43.Description: Each stack of Melancholy increases the damage the enemy unit takes by #.SArg5.Per# and reduces the damage it deals by #.SArg6.Per#.
43.ShortDescription: Each stack of Melancholy further increases the damage the enemy unit takes and further reduces the damage it deals.

44.Description: Melancholy is also applied when an enemy beast attacks an allied hero protected by Nightfall Pegasus, but its effects are reduced by #.SArg7.Per# on beasts.
44.ShortDescription: Melancholy is also applied when an enemy beast attacks an allied hero protected by Nightfall Pegasus.

45.Description: Passive: Nightfall Pegasus descends into darkness, dealing beast damage equal to #.SArg9.Per# of its Attack Rating to nearby enemy units every #.SArg8#s.
45.ShortDescription: Passive: Nightfall Pegasus descends into darkness, dealing beast damage to nearby enemy units periodically.

11.Description: Every #.SArg0#s, Count Snickerfang summons #.SArg1# Carrot Pits at random locations near the center of the battlefield. When an enemy unit gets close to a Carrot Pit, it explodes, dealing beast damage equal to #.SArg2.Per# of Count Snickerfang's Attack Rating to all enemy units in range. At the same time, Little Carrots fly from the Carrot Pit, continuously dealing beast damage equal to #.SArg3.Per# of Count Snickerfang's Attack Rating to the enemy unit closest to Count Snickerfang for #.SArg4#s.
11.ShortDescription: Every #.SArg0#s, Count Snickerfang summons Carrot Pits at random locations near the center of the battlefield. When an enemy unit gets close to a Carrot Pit, it explodes, dealing beast damage to all enemy units in range. At the same time, Little Carrots fly from the Carrot Pit, continuously dealing beast damage to the enemy unit closest to Count Snickerfang for #.SArg4#s.

21.Description: Passive: Up to #.SArg0# Carrot Pits can exist at the same time. When this limit is exceeded, the Carrot Pit summoned earliest will explode. Carrot Pits will also explode automatically #.SArg1#s after being summoned.
21.ShortDescription: Passive: Up to #.SArg0# Carrot Pits can exist at the same time. When this limit is exceeded, the Carrot Pit summoned earliest will explode. Carrot Pits will also explode automatically #.SArg1#s after being summoned.

22.Description: When Little Carrots attack enemy units, #.SArg2.Per# of the damage dealt is converted into healing for the ally unit with the lowest health percentage. At the same time, the attacked enemy unit will inflict #.SArg3.Per# less damage and health loss for #.SArg4#s (capped at a max reduction of #.SArg5.Per#).
22.ShortDescription: When Little Carrots attack enemy units, the ally unit with the lowest health percentage is healed. The attacked enemy unit will also inflict reduced damage and health loss.

23.Description: After a Carrot Pit explodes, there is a #.SArg6.Per# chance of spawning #.SArg7# extra Little Carrot.
23.ShortDescription: After a Carrot Pit explodes, there is a chance of spawning an extra Little Carrot.

31.Description: At the start of battle, Count Snickerfang moves to the center of the battlefield and places a Gift Box on the ground, which explodes to deal beast damage equal to #.SArg0.Per# of Count Snickerfang's Attack Rating to nearby enemy units while summoning #.SArg1# Carrot Pits at random locations around the explosion.
31.ShortDescription: At the start of battle, Count Snickerfang moves to the center of the battlefield and places a Gift Box on the ground, which explodes to deal beast damage to nearby enemy units while summoning Carrot Pits at random locations around the explosion.

32.Description: Gift Box explosion damage is increased to #.SArg0.Per# of Count Snickerfang's Attack Rating, and the number of Carrot Pits summoned is increased to #.SArg1#.
32.ShortDescription: Gift Box explosion damage and the number of Carrot Pits summoned are both increased.

33.Description: Targets hit will also have their Defense Rating reduced by #.SArg2.Per# for #.SArg3#s. This effect cannot be stacked.
33.ShortDescription: Targets hit will also have their Defense Rating reduced. This effect cannot be stacked.

41.Description: Count Snickerfang moves to the area with the highest concentration of enemy units, unfurls its cape to terrify enemies in front of itself, then inflicts #.SArg0# of the following control effects at random on each enemy unit for #.SArg1#s: Stun, Charm, Entangle, Heal Prevention, and Silence. At the same time, all Carrot Pits on the battlefield explode, and another #.SArg2# Carrot Pits are summoned at random locations near the center of the battlefield.
41.ShortDescription: Count Snickerfang moves to the area with the highest concentration of enemy units, unfurls its cape to terrify enemies in front of itself, then inflicts #.SArg0# of the following control effects at random on each enemy unit for #.SArg1#s: Stun, Charm, Entangle, Heal Prevention, and Silence. At the same time, all Carrot Pits on the battlefield explode, and new Carrot Pits are summoned at random locations near the center of the battlefield.

42.Description: The number of control effects inflicted when Count Snickerfang terrifies enemies is increased to #.SArg0#, and their duration is increased to #.SArg1#s.
42.ShortDescription: The number of control effects inflicted when Count Snickerfang terrifies enemies is increased, and their duration is also increased.

43.Description: When Count Snickerfang terrifies an enemy, the target's Tenacity and Dissolve are reduced by #.SArg3# and #.SArg4# respectively for #.SArg5#s.
43.ShortDescription: When Count Snickerfang terrifies an enemy, the target's Tenacity and Dissolve are reduced for #.SArg5#s.

44.Description: The Attack Speed of Little Carrots is increased by #.SArg6.Per#.
44.ShortDescription: The Attack Speed of Little Carrots is increased.

45.Description: When a Little Carrot disappears, the Attack Rating of the ally hero with the highest initial Attack Rating is increased by #.SArg7.Per# for #.SArg8#s (capped at a max increase of #.SArg9.Per#).
45.ShortDescription: When a Little Carrot disappears, the Attack Rating of the ally hero with the highest initial Attack Rating is increased.

11.Description:
The Twinlum Spirit periodically summons a Nebula to protect allies or impair enemies.
Nebula Ward: Heals the target for health equal to #.SArg0.Per# of the Twinlum Spirit's Attack Rating and increases the effectiveness of their received healing by #.SArg2.Per# and received shields by #.SArg3.Per# for #.SArg1#s.
Nebula Curse: Deals damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of Attack Rating to the target while reducing their Crit Rating by #.SArg5# points and Energy Recovery Rate by #.SArg6# points for #.SArg4#s.
11.ShortDescription:
The Twinlum Spirit periodically summons a Nebula to protect allies or impair enemies.
Nebula Ward: Heals the target and increases the effectiveness of their received healing and shields.
Nebula Curse: Deals damage to the target while reducing their Crit Rating and Energy Recovery Rate.

21.Description: When an ally summon is affected by Nebula Ward, its summoner becomes a Shepherd for #.SArg0#s. Shepherds inflict an extra #.SArg1.Per# damage and health loss while gaining an Attack Rating boost of #.SArg2.Per# from the Shepherd's Moon.
21.ShortDescription: When an ally summon is affected by Nebula Ward, its summoner becomes a Shepherd. Shepherds inflict extra damage and health loss while gaining an Attack Rating boost from the Shepherd's Moon.

22.Description: The continuous effects of Nebula Ward can stack up to #.SArg3# times. Each stack restores #.SArg5# Energy to the target every #.SArg4#s.
22.ShortDescription: The continuous effects of Nebula Ward can stack. Each stack restores Energy to the target.

23.Description: The continuous effects of Nebula Curse can stack up to #.SArg6# times. Each stack reduces the damage and health loss the target inflicts by #.SArg7.Per#.
23.ShortDescription: The continuous effects of Nebula Curse can stack. Each stack reduces the damage and health loss the target inflicts.

31.Description: At the start of battle, the Twinlum Spirit summons a Shepherd's Moon that hovers above the battlefield until the battle ends. Whenever a Nebula protects or impairs a target, the Shepherd's Moon charges up permanently, increasing its Attack Rating. Each charge provides an increase equal to #.SArg0.Per# of the target's current Attack Rating. The Shepherd's Moon can be charged up to #.SArg1# times.
31.ShortDescription: At the start of battle, the Twinlum Spirit summons a Shepherd's Moon that hovers above the battlefield until the battle ends. Whenever a Nebula protects or impairs a target, the Shepherd's Moon charges up permanently, increasing its Attack Rating.

32.Description: Allied units are always inspired by the Shepherd's Moon, gaining an Attack Rating boost equal to #.SArg2.Per# of the Shepherd's Moon charge.
32.ShortDescription: Allied units are always inspired by the Shepherd's Moon, gaining an Attack Rating boost.

33.Description: For every #.SArg3# strikes of damage a Shepherd deals, the Shepherd's Moon will call down #.SArg4# Judgments and #.SArg5# Benedictions. This effect can trigger #.SArg7# time every #.SArg6#s.
33.ShortDescription: For every certain number of strikes of damage a Shepherd deals, the Shepherd's Moon will call down Judgments and Benedictions.

41.Description:
Active: Shepherd's Moon randomly calls down #.SArg0# Judgments and #.SArg0# Benedictions.
Judgments deal damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of Attack Rating to the target.
Benedictions heal the target for health equal to #.SArg1.Per# of the Twinlum Spirit's Attack Rating.
If the target is affected by Nebula Ward or Nebula Curse, the effects of Judgments and Benedictions are increased by #.SArg2.Per#.
41.ShortDescription:
Active: Shepherd's Moon randomly calls down Judgments and Benedictions:
Judgments deal damage to the target.
 Benedictions heal the target.
If the target is affected by Nebula Ward or Nebula Curse, the effects of Judgments and Benedictions are increased.

42.Description: Judgment reduces the target's Physical Resist by #.SArg3# points and Magic Resist by #.SArg3# points for #.SArg4#s (capped at a max of #.SArg5# stacks).
42.ShortDescription: Judgment reduces the target's Physical Resist and Magic Resist.

43.Description: The Shepherd's Moon calls down an extra Judgment every #.SArg6#s. Judgments also increase the damage and health loss the target takes by #.SArg7.Per# for #.SArg8#s.
43.ShortDescription: The Shepherd's Moon periodically calls down an extra Judgment. Judgments also increase the damage and health loss the target takes.

44.Description: When an allied unit affected by Nebula Ward attacks an enemy unit affected by Nebula Curse, both the allied unit and the Twinlum Spirit will inflict #.SArg10.Per# more damage and health loss for the next #.SArg9#s.
44.ShortDescription: When an allied unit affected by Nebula Ward attacks an enemy unit affected by Nebula Curse, both the allied unit and the Twinlum Spirit will inflict increased damage and health loss.

45.Description: When an enemy summon is hit with Nebula Curse, it falls into a Deep Slumber for 4s. It is difficult to wake from Deep Slumber. This effect can be triggered once every 10s per unit.
45.ShortDescription: When an enemy summon is hit with Nebula Curse, it falls into a Deep Slumber. It is difficult to wake from Deep Slumber.

11.Description:
Blazefang periodically alternates between using Firefall or Waxfall to attack enemy units, dealing damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of Attack Rating while applying the corresponding effects, respectively:
Singe: For the next #.SArg0#s, Vitality and Healing are reduced by #.SArg1# points, while Energy Recovery Rate is reduced by #.SArg2# points.
Waxen Rot: For the next #.SArg3#s, Movement Speed is reduced by #.SArg4.Per#, while damage taken is increased by #.SArg5.Per#.
As soon as Singe and Waxen Rot are stacked on the same enemy unit, #.SArg6# Melt Blast is triggered, dealing damage equal to #.SArg7.Per# of Attack Rating.
11.ShortDescription:
Blazefang periodically alternates between using Firefall or Waxfall to attack enemy units, dealing damage while applying the corresponding effects, respectively:
Singe: Vitality, Healing, and Energy Recovery Rate are reduced.
Waxen Rot: Movement Speed is reduced, while damage taken is increased.
As soon as Singe and Waxen Rot are stacked on the same enemy unit, a Melt Blast is triggered, dealing damage.

21.Description: For every #.SArg0# times Blazefang applies Waxen Rot on enemy units in total, all allies gain a shield for #.SArg1#s that blocks damage of up to #.SArg2.Per# of the holder's max health, increases their Attack Rating by #.SArg3.Per#, and reduces the health loss they take by #.SArg4.Per#. Can trigger up to #.SArg5# time per battle.
21.ShortDescription: For every certain number of times Blazefang applies Waxen Rot on enemy units in total, all allies gain a shield and an Attack Rating boost, while the health loss they take is reduced.

22.Description: Waxen Rot can stack up to 3 times. When an enemy unit reaches max stacks for the first time, it is transformed into a Wax Statue for #.SArg6#s, during which it takes #.SArg7.Per# more damage and health loss.
22.ShortDescription: Waxen Rot can stack a certain number of times. When an enemy unit reaches max stacks for the first time, it is transformed into a Wax Statue, during which it takes increased damage and health loss.

23.Description: Enemy units affected by Singe have their chance of being hit with a critical strike increased by #.SArg8.Per#, and each time they take a critical strike, the damage they take from subsequent critical strikes is increased by #.SArg10.Per# for #.SArg9#s (stacks up to 4 times).
23.ShortDescription: Enemy units affected by Singe have their chance of being hit with a critical strike increased, and each time they take a critical strike, the damage they take from subsequent critical strikes is increased for several seconds.

31.Description:
At the start of battle, Blazefang follows the allied hero with the highest initial Attack Rating, increasing that hero's Crit Damage Amplification by #.SArg0# points and allowing their critical strike damage multiplier to exceed its limit.
In addition, Blazefang periodically creates a Wax Pool that lasts #.SArg1#s and applies Waxen Rot to enemy units in range.
31.ShortDescription:
Blazefang follows an allied hero, increasing their Crit Damage Amplification and allowing their critical strike damage multiplier to exceed its limit.
In addition, Blazefang periodically creates a Wax Pool and applies Waxen Rot to enemy units in range.

32.Description: Enemy units affected by Waxen Rot take #.SArg3.Per# more damage from normal attacks. This effect stacks each time they're hit with a normal attack (up to a max increase of #.SArg4.Per#).
32.ShortDescription: Enemy units affected by Waxen Rot take increased damage from normal attacks. This effect stacks each time they're hit with a normal attack.

33.Description: The allied hero that Blazefang follows gains #.SArg5# points of Crit Damage Amplification, and their critical strikes trigger #.SArg6# Melt Blast, dealing normal attack damage equal to #.SArg7.Per# of the allied hero's Attack Rating. Can trigger up to #.SArg9# time every #.SArg8#s.
33.ShortDescription: The allied hero that Blazefang follows gains a Crit Damage Amplification boost, and their critical strikes trigger Melt Blasts.

41.Description: Active: Blazefang spews flames forward, dealing damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of Attack Rating. If the flames hit an enemy unit that is affected by Waxen Rot or inside a Wax Pool, then the damage is increased by #.SArg2.Per#. All enemy units hit will suffer the Singe effect, increasing the damage they take from normal attacks and critical strikes by #.SArg0.Per# for #.SArg1#s.
41.ShortDescription: Active: Blazefang spews flames forward, dealing damage. If the flames hit an enemy unit that is affected by Waxen Rot or inside a Wax Pool, then the damage is increased. All enemy units hit will suffer the Singe effect, increasing the damage they take from normal attacks and critical strikes.

42.Description: Enraged bosses will enhance the power of Singe, granting Blazefang a #.SArg3.Per# boost to all of the damage, attribute buffs, and damage buffs provided by Singe.
42.ShortDescription: Blazefang gains a boost to all of the damage, attribute buffs, and damage buffs provided by Singe.

43.Description: The shield that Blazefang creates when applying Waxen Rot has its attributes boosted by #.SArg4.Per#, while the limit on the number of times allies can receive the shield per battle is increased to #.SArg5#.
43.ShortDescription: The shield that Blazefang creates when applying Waxen Rot has its attributes boosted, while the limit on the number of times allies can receive the shield per battle is increased.

44.Description: Blazefang periodically attacks enemy units with both Firefall and Waxfall at the same time, which is guaranteed to trigger a Melt Blast, and each Melt Blast applies #.SArg6# more stack of Singe (max #.SArg7# stacks).
44.ShortDescription: Blazefang periodically attacks enemy units with both Firefall and Waxfall at the same time, which is guaranteed to trigger a Melt Blast, and each Melt Blast applies an extra stack of Singe.

45.Description: Each time an allied hero attacks an enemy unit affected by Waxen Rot, the hero gains #.SArg8# points of Crit Damage Amplification for #.SArg9#s (max #.SArg10# stacks).
45.ShortDescription: Each time an allied hero attacks an enemy unit affected by Waxen Rot, the hero gains a Crit Damage Amplification boost.

1.Description: The enemy hero directly opposite the holder will join the battle #.SArg0#s late.

2.Description: The first time the holder receives fatal damage, they are immune to the damage and revert to their position and status #.SArg1#s ago.

3.Description: When reverting, their health and energy return to their optimal state from within the last #.SArg1#s.

1.Description: When the holder uses their Ultimate skill, they enter the Phased status for #.SArg0#s, during which they receive #.SArg1# points of Attack Speed and #.SArg2# points of Crit Rating.

2.Description: While in the Phased status, when the holder deals critical strike damage, the phase inflicts additional damage equal to #.SArg3.Per# of the damage value.

3.Description: The holder recovers health equal to #.SArg4.Per# of the additional damage dealt.

1.Description: 完成入场后，持有者首次受到伤害时将时间停止#.SArg0#秒，期间只有持有者可以行动。每次触发该效果，使后续友方触发相同效果的持续时间降低#.SArg1.Per#。

2.Description: Every #.SArg2#s the time is stopped, Inertia inflicts damage equal to #.SArg3.Per# of the holder's max health on an enemy hero.

3.Description: Inertia reduces the energy of the damaged enemy hero by #.SArg4# points.

1.Description: Every #.SArg0#s, the enemy hero with the highest health is prioritized as the target, where #.SArg1.Per# of their max health is stolen and converted into the holder's shield for #.SArg3#s. When the shield ends, the remaining shield value is converted back into health of equal value to be returned to the target.

2.Description: While the shield is active, the target's Attack Rating and Defense Rating are reduced by #.SArg4.Per# and #.SArg5.Per# respectively.

3.Description: While the shield is active, the holder receives Attack Rating and Defense Rating lost by the target.

1.Description: Every #.SArg0# times the holder inflicts normal attack damage on a single enemy hero, the target suffers additional damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of the holder's Attack Rating.

2.Description: The enemy receiving additional damage is stunned for #.SArg1#s.

3.Description: Each time additional damage is triggered, the holder's normal attack damage is increased by #.SArg2.Per#, up to #.SArg3# stacks.

1.Description: When inflicting control effects, the holder slices the target for #.SArg0#s. The sliced target suffers health loss equal to #.SArg1.Per# of the holder's Attack Rating every #.SArg2#s. If the target's position changes within #.SArg2#s, their health loss is increased to #.SArg3.Per# of the holder's Attack Rating.

2.Description: When an enemy's health loss from being sliced exceeds #.SArg4.Per# of their max health, they become terrified for #.SArg5#s. This effect can only be triggered on a target once every #.SArg6#s.

3.Description: When the slice effect attempts to terrify an enemy target, the Twisted Fate is triggered and deals damage equaling #.PlusRatio.Per# of the holder's Attack Rating to enemies near the target.

1.Description: When the holder's Ultimate skill ends, they charm the nearest enemy hero for #.SArg0#s. The charmed enemy can only use their normal attack.

2.Description: Meanwhile, the holder summons a minion that continuously attacks the nearest enemy hero, dealing damage equaling #.PlusRatio.Per# of the holder's Attack Rating, while restoring the holder's health for #.SArg1.Per# of their damage value. The holder can possess up to #.SArg2# minion.

3.Description: When the holder takes a single instance of damage that exceeds #.SArg3.Per# of their max health, they sacrifice 1 minion to mitigate the damage.

1.Description: When the holder's Ultimate skill ends, they summon an alternate time-space above the enemy hero with the highest energy, dealing AoE damage equal to #.PlusRatio.Per# of the holder's Attack Rating and erasing #.SArg0# energy points of the damaged enemy hero.

2.Description: The enemy hero suffering damage from the alternate time-space will be marked with Eye of Evil. When they have been marked #.SArg1# times, Cuffs of Destruction are generated to erase #.SArg2# energy points of the target.

3.Description: When the target's energy is erased, their energy shortfall is converted into the holder's energy recovery, for at least #.SArg3# points.

1.Description: When the battle has progressed for #.SArg0#s, the holder sets up a Supplies Stall at its formation location, with #.SArg1# bottles of Health potion and #.SArg2# bottle of Energy potion, which can restore health for #.SArg4.Per# of the holder's Attack Rating as well as #.SArg6# energy points respectively.

2.Description: Each type of potion is replenished #.SArg7# seconds after it is finished, and can be replenished up to #.SArg8# times per battle.

3.Description: 道具摊额外放置1瓶神秘药水，供累计造成伤害最高的友方英雄使用，提升#.SArg9.Per#攻击力，持续#.SArg10#秒。

1.Description: The first time the holder receives fatal damage, they are immune to the damage, recover #.SArg0.Per# of their max health and flashes for #.SArg1#s. While flashing, the holder cannot be targeted.

2.Description: When the flashing ends, the enemy hero closest to the holder falls into a dream, and wakes up after #.SArg2#s or suffering cumulative damage equal to #.SArg3.Per# of their max health.

3.Description: Every #.SArg4#s, the enemy hero closest to the holder falls into a dream.

10.Description: Every attack prioritizes targets directly opposite.
10.ShortDescription: Every attack prioritizes targets directly opposite.

10.Description: Every attack deals 2 strikes of damage.
10.ShortDescription: Every attack deals 2 strikes of damage.

10.Description: Every #.SArg0# turn(s), after taking any action, the hero's Attack Rating and Defense Rating are granted to the next ally who takes an action. Lasts #.SArg1# turn(s).
10.ShortDescription: Every #.SArg0# turns, grants attributes to an ally.

10.Description: Every #.SArg0# attack(s), applies the Stilled status to the current target and the target in the next position, rendering them unable to move or take any action for #.SArg1# turn(s).
10.ShortDescription: Every #.SArg0# attacks, the Stilled effect will be applied on enemies.

10.Description: Only attacks enemies directly opposite. Every #.SArg0# attack(s), restores #.SArg1.Per# of the damage dealt as health.
10.ShortDescription: Only attacks enemies directly opposite. Every #.SArg0# attacks, restores health.

10.Description: For the first #.SArg0# turn(s), deals #.SArg1.Per# damage to the enemy directly opposite. Subsequent attacks follow the order of positioning and only deal #.SArg2.Per# damage.
10.ShortDescription: For the first #.SArg0# turns, the unit attacks the enemy directly opposite, dealing damage that decreases over time.

10.Description: Every #.SArg0# turn(s), #.SArg1.Per# of damage dealt is converted into healing for other allies.
10.ShortDescription: Every #.SArg0# turns, heals allies upon dealing damage.

10.Description: After defeating an enemy, the battlefield will turn hot, making all allies immune to the Chilled effect.
10.ShortDescription: After defeating an enemy, all allies will become immune to the Chilled effect.

10.Description: Not only is Mezoth thick-skinned with an incredibly high Defense Rating, he's also got an insatiable appetite. Every #.SArg0# turns, upon taking a ranged attack, he will devour anything that flies toward him, gaining immunity to that strike of damage.
Every #.SArg0# turns, Ezizh applies Mind Control on the enemy directly opposite, rendering them unable to move or take any action for #.SArg1# turn.

Every #.SArg0# turns, Lavatune brings forth echoes of the Void Tune, boosting the Attack Rating of all allies by #.SArg1.Per# of his own and reducing the Attack Rating of all enemies by #.SArg2.Per# of his own for #.SArg3# turns.
If the boss has not been Stilled for #.SArg0# turns, their next attack will deal #.SArg1# times more damage.
Every #.SArg0# turns, Zolrath wields the Hourglass of Time, returning to the state he was in at turn #.SArg1#.
The boss gains #.SArg0# points of Dodge. If the previous #.SArg1# attacks have all hit the enemy, then the boss and the ally in the next position gain invincibility for #.SArg2# turns.
Khazard spreads the Chilled effect, causing all units to lose #.SArg0.Per# of their current health every turn.
All allies gain an extra #.SArg0# points of Crit Rating.
All allies gain an extra #.SArg0# point(s) of Dodge.
Every #.SArg0# turn(s), restores #.SArg1.Per# of lost health.
The ally in 2nd position gains immunity to 1 strike of fatal damage.

11.Description: When equipped, every #.SArg0# turns, damage dealt is permanently increased by #.SArg1.Per#.

12.Description: When equipped by a dreaf, attacks deal damage to all enemies.

11.Description: When equipped, increases Crit Rating by #.SArg0# points.

12.Description: When equipped by a fiend, critical strikes ignore Defense Rating.

11.Description: When equipped, prioritizes attacking enemies directly opposite.

12.Description: When equipped by a Hypogean mage, grants immunity to Mind Control.

11.Description: When equipped, damage taken is reduced by #.SArg0.Per#.

12.Description: When equipped by Arkadios, grants immunity to all external noises, including Void Tune.

11.Description: When equipped, increases Dodge by #.SArg0# points.

12.Description: When equipped by Bloodsnarl, upon landing a critical strike, the attacked target will become Stilled, rendering them unable to move or take any action for #.SArg1# turn(s).

11.Description: When equipped, every #.SArg0# turns, the unit will take its action first, regardless of its position.

12.Description: When equipped by Steixius, he can take 2 actions in a row every #.SArg1# turn(s).

11.Description: When equipped, if the attacked enemy is invincible, their Defense Rating is reduced by #.SArg0.Per# for #.SArg1# turns.

12.Description: When equipped by a Hypogean Warrior, increases Dodge by #.SArg2# point(s).
